meanings.cn: 按照；根据（用于 according to）

confusables.diff: accordingly 是副词，意为“因此、相应地”；according 多用于 according to 短语中表示“根据”。

examples.quote: Fully 87% of their revenues came from advertising in 2008, according to the Organization for Economic Cooperation & Development (OECD).
According to the survey, most graduates prefer flexible working hours to high salaries.
examples.cn: 根据这项调查，大多数毕业生更青睐弹性工作时间，而非高薪。

examples.quote: The results were judged according to strict academic standards.
examples.cn: 这些结果是按照严格的学术标准来评判的。

confusables.diff: research 是名词或动词“研究”，researchers 是从事研究的人。
searchers 指搜寻者、寻找者，与学术研究无关。

examples.quote: The researchers from Ohio University used a database that covered more than 10,000 firms and more than 64,000 different directors between 1989 and 2004.
Researchers found that regular exercise can significantly improve memory in older adults.
examples.cn: 研究人员发现，规律锻炼能显著改善老年人的记忆力。

examples.quote: The researchers conducted a series of experiments to test their hypothesis.
examples.cn: 研究人员进行了一系列实验来验证他们的假设。

confusables.diff: economic 指与经济/经济学相关，economical 指省钱、节约的。
economic 是形容词，economy 是名词，指经济体系或节约。

examples.quote: A "southern" camp headed by France wants something different: "European economic government" within an inner core of euro-zone members.
The government has introduced new measures to promote sustainable economic growth.
examples.cn: 政府已出台新措施以促进可持续的经济增长。

examples.quote: Rising unemployment remains a major obstacle to the country's economic recovery.
examples.cn: 失业率上升仍是该国经济复苏的主要障碍。

confusables.diff: economics 指经济学这门学科，economy 指经济或节约行为。
economic 是形容词“经济的、经济上的”，economy 作名词指经济或作定语表“经济实惠的”。

examples.quote: They are energetic participants in a global economy driven by the flow of work, money and ideas.
The government has pledged to revive the sluggish economy through tax cuts and public investment.
examples.cn: 政府承诺通过减税和公共投资来重振疲软的经济。

examples.quote: Travelers on a tight budget often choose economy class to save money.
examples.cn: 预算紧张的旅客常选择经济舱以省钱。

confusables.diff: influence 多指潜移默化的影响，impact 常指强烈而直接的影响。
effect 强调结果或效应，impact 强调冲击力与作用过程。
impinge 常与 on 连用，指侵犯或影响，impact 可作名词且更常用。

examples.quote: Mies's signature phrase means that less decoration, properly organized, has more impact than a lot.
The new policy is likely to have a profound impact on small businesses.
examples.cn: 新政策可能会对小企业产生深远影响。

examples.quote: Researchers are assessing how climate change impacts agricultural productivity.
examples.cn: 研究人员正在评估气候变化如何影响农业生产力。

confusables.diff: society 指整体社会或社团组织，community 侧重共同地域或共同利益的群体。
commune 指公社或共同生活的小群体，community 指更广泛的社区。

examples.quote: This law abolished special educational requirements for federal jurors and required them to be selected at random from a cross section of the entire community.
The new policy is intended to strengthen ties between the university and the local community.
examples.cn: 这项新政策旨在加强大学与当地社区之间的联系。

examples.quote: Members of the scientific community have expressed concern about the reliability of the data.
examples.cn: 科学界人士对这些数据的可靠性表示了担忧。

confusables.diff: secrecy 强调有意保密、不让人知道，privacy 强调不受他人侵入或干扰的权利。
isolation 指被隔离、与外界隔绝的状态，privacy 指主动享有的私密空间。

examples.quote: The Internet affords anonymity to its users, a blessing to privacy and freedom of speech.
Users are increasingly concerned that their privacy may be violated by the collection of personal data.
examples.cn: 用户越来越担心个人数据的收集可能侵犯他们的隐私。

examples.quote: The new regulation requires companies to take privacy seriously when handling customer information.
examples.cn: 新规要求公司在处理客户信息时认真对待隐私问题。

confusables.diff: inspect 指仔细检查具体事物，survey 指对整体情况进行调查或审视。
scrutiny 是名词，指细致审查；survey 可作名词指范围较广的调查。

examples.quote: A big survey of Indian households in 2004 found that nearly 40% of emigrants had more than a high-school education, compared with around 3.3% of all Indians over the age 25.
A recent survey found that most graduates prefer flexible working hours.
examples.cn: 最近一项调查发现，大多数毕业生更偏好弹性工作时间。

examples.quote: The researchers surveyed two thousand consumers about their online shopping habits.
examples.cn: 研究人员就网购习惯调查了两千名消费者。

meanings.cn: 技术；科技（technology 的缩略形式）
技术的；科技的（多用于复合词）

confusables.diff: technique 指具体的技巧或方法，tech 泛指技术或科技领域。
technical 是形容词，指技术性的；tech 常作名词，指技术本身。

examples.quote: However, Google and other big tech providers monitor their efficiency closely and make improvements.
The tech sector has created millions of jobs over the past decade.
examples.cn: 过去十年，科技行业创造了数百万个就业岗位。

examples.quote: Many young graduates prefer to work for tech firms rather than traditional manufacturers.
examples.cn: 许多年轻毕业生更愿意去科技公司工作，而不是传统制造企业。

confusables.diff: manufacture 多指具体制造行为或动词，manufacturing 侧重制造业这一产业或作定语。
production 泛指一切生产（含农业、服务），manufacturing 特指工厂化的工业制造。

examples.quote: The decline in American manufacturing is a common refrain, particularly from Donald Trump.
The decline of manufacturing has reshaped the employment structure of many developed economies.
examples.cn: 制造业的衰退重塑了许多发达经济体的就业结构。

examples.quote: Governments are investing heavily in advanced manufacturing to boost competitiveness.
examples.cn: 各国政府正大力投资先进制造业以提升竞争力。

meanings.cn: 阴性的；（医学检验）阴性的

confusables.diff: passive 强调被动、不主动作为，negative 强调态度消极或结果不利。
pessimistic 指对未来悲观，negative 泛指否定或负面，不限于对未来的预期。

examples.quote: We become defensive when criticised, and apply negative stereotypes to others to boost our own esteem.
The report warns that excessive screen time may have a negative impact on children's academic performance.
examples.cn: 该报告警告说，过多的屏幕时间可能对儿童的学业表现产生负面影响。

examples.quote: Rather than focusing on negative feedback, managers should help employees turn criticism into concrete improvement plans.
examples.cn: 管理者不应只关注负面反馈，而应帮助员工将批评转化为具体的改进计划。

confusables.diff: guilt 侧重因做错事而自责，shame 侧重因自身缺陷或失态而羞耻。
guilt 指有罪的客观事实或内疚感，blame 指对过错应负的责任或指责。
guilt 是内疚的状态，remorse 是对所做之事的深切悔恨。

examples.quote: You may feel guilt over your past, but you are poisoning the present with the things and circumstances you cannot change.
Many working parents feel a lingering sense of guilt about spending too little time with their children.
examples.cn: 许多在职父母因陪伴孩子太少而怀着挥之不去的负罪感。

examples.quote: The court acquitted him because the prosecution failed to establish his guilt beyond reasonable doubt.
examples.cn: 法庭宣判他无罪，因为控方未能排除合理怀疑地证明其有罪。

meanings.cn: 越来越多地；日益；不断增加地

confusables.diff: increasing 是形容词，表示“增长的”；increasingly 是副词，修饰动词或形容词。
gradually 强调“逐渐、缓慢”，increasingly 强调程度“越来越”。

examples.quote: This new focus on personal fulfillment can help keep employees motivated amid increasingly loud debates over work-life balance.
Consumers are increasingly aware of the environmental impact of their purchasing decisions.
examples.cn: 消费者越来越意识到其购买决策对环境的影响。

examples.quote: It has become increasingly difficult for graduates to find jobs that match their qualifications.
examples.cn: 毕业生越来越难以找到与其资历相符的工作。

confusables.diff: participants 是其复数形式，单数指一个参加者。
competitors 强调竞争对手，participants 仅指参与活动的人。

examples.quote: They are energetic participants in a global economy driven by the flow of work, money and ideas.
Researchers found that participants who exercised regularly reported lower levels of stress.
examples.cn: 研究人员发现，定期锻炼的参与者报告的壓力水平较低。

examples.quote: All participants are required to complete the questionnaire before the experiment begins.
examples.cn: 所有参与者须在实验开始前完成问卷。

confusables.diff: significative 意为“有含义的、指示性的”，多用于符号或迹象，不如 significant 常用。
important 泛指“重要”，significant 更强调因意义或影响而值得注意。

examples.quote: Conversely, if homework matters, it should account for a significant portion of the grade.
The study found a significant correlation between sleep quality and academic performance.
examples.cn: 该研究发现睡眠质量与学业成绩之间存在显著相关性。

examples.quote: Few people grasped the significant implications of the new policy for rural households.
examples.cn: 很少有人理解这项新政策对农村家庭的重大影响。

confusables.diff: cooperate 是动词“合作”，corporate 是形容词“公司的；共同的”。
corporal 意为“身体的”或“下士”，与 corporate 拼写相近但含义无关。

examples.quote: In particular, the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly until women are part of senior management decisions, and Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male.
The scandal damaged the company's corporate image and prompted a reshuffle of its board.
examples.cn: 这起丑闻损害了公司的企业形象，并促使董事会进行重组。

examples.quote: Managers must balance corporate interests against the long-term welfare of local communities.
examples.cn: 管理者必须在公司利益与当地社区的长远福祉之间取得平衡。

confusables.diff: fiscal 多指政府财政、税收年度，financial 泛指金融财务。
monetary 专指货币的，financial 范围更广，含财务金融。

examples.quote: If you're not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices.
The company's financial position has improved considerably over the past year.
examples.cn: 过去一年里，该公司的财务状况已大幅改善。

examples.quote: Many students rely on financial aid to cover their tuition and living costs.
examples.cn: 许多学生依靠助学金来支付学费和生活费。

confusables.diff: juror 指陪审团中的一名成员，jury 指整个陪审团。
judge 是主持审判的法官，jury 是裁定事实的陪审团。

examples.quote: The jury is also said to be the best surviving example of direct rather than representative democracy.
The jury took three days to reach a unanimous verdict in the complex fraud case.
examples.cn: 陪审团花了三天时间才在这起复杂的欺诈案中达成一致裁决。

examples.quote: Members of the jury were instructed to disregard the witness's last remark.
examples.cn: 陪审团成员被指示不要理会证人最后的那句话。

confusables.diff: currant 指葡萄干或醋栗，与 current 拼写相近但意义完全不同。
currency 是名词，指货币或通用；current 可作形容词指当前或名词指水流/电流。

examples.quote: The current downturn in the art market is the worst since the Japanese stopped buying Impressionists at the end of 1989.
The current economic climate has forced many small businesses to close.
examples.cn: 当前的经济环境迫使许多小企业倒闭。

examples.quote: She swam against the strong current to reach the shore.
examples.cn: 她逆着强劲的水流游向岸边。

meanings.cn: 风景，景色；（特定类型的）自然风光

confusables.diff: scenery 指某地区整体的自然风光，不可数；landscape 可指具体的一片风景或风景画，也可喻指局势。
seascape 专指海景；landscape 泛指陆地风景。

examples.quote: Aesthetic effect came from the landscape, new materials and forthright detailing.
The digital revolution has transformed the landscape of higher education.
examples.cn: 数字革命改变了高等教育的格局。

examples.quote: From the summit, visitors can enjoy a breathtaking landscape of rolling hills.
examples.cn: 从山顶上，游客可以欣赏到连绵起伏的丘陵的壮丽景色。

confusables.diff: obese 是形容词，描述“肥胖的”；obesity 是名词形式。
fatness 为普通用词，偏口语；obesity 为医学、正式用语。

examples.quote: They argue that government action is necessary to curb Britain's addiction to unhealthy food and help halt spiraling rates of obesity, diabetes and heart disease.
Researchers link the rise in childhood obesity to sugary drinks and sedentary lifestyles.
examples.cn: 研究人员将儿童肥胖率上升与含糖饮料和久坐的生活方式联系起来。

examples.quote: Public health campaigns aimed at reducing obesity have met with limited success.
examples.cn: 旨在减少肥胖的公共卫生宣传活动收效有限。

confusables.diff: depression 指更严重、持续时间更长的经济大萧条，recession 指程度较轻的短期衰退。
recede 是动词，意为后退、减弱；recession 是其名词形式，常指经济衰退。

examples.quote: The recession threatened to remove the advertising and readers that had not already fled to the internet.
The economy slipped into recession as consumer spending fell sharply.
examples.cn: 随着消费支出急剧下降，经济滑入了衰退。

examples.quote: Many small businesses struggled to survive during the long recession.
examples.cn: 在漫长的经济衰退期间，许多小企业艰难求生。

confusables.diff: become 是原形/现在式，became 是其过去式，仅用于过去时语境。
begin 意为“开始”，与 became 拼写相近但语义完全不同。

examples.quote: In the weeks and months that followed Mr. Hirst's sale, spending of any sort became deeply unfashionable.
What began as a small experiment soon became a nationwide movement.
examples.cn: 起初只是一个小实验，很快便演变成一场全国性运动。

examples.quote: She became increasingly skeptical of the official explanation.
examples.cn: 她对官方解释越来越怀疑。

confusables.diff: boom 指经济等的繁荣、激增，强调状态；boost 指人为的推动或提高，强调动作。
enhance 侧重提升质量或价值；boost 侧重提升数量、水平或信心。
promote 指促进发展或晋升；boost 更强调短期内有力地提振。

examples.quote: He said that manufacturers of crisps and candies could play a central role in the Change4Life campaign, the centrepiece of government efforts to boost healthy eating and fitness.
The new policy is expected to boost consumer spending in the coming quarter.
examples.cn: 这项新政策预计将在下一季度提振消费者支出。

examples.quote: Winning the award gave her a much-needed boost in confidence.
examples.cn: 获得该奖项给了她亟需的信心提升。

confusables.diff: employee 指受雇的雇员（人），employment 指就业状态或工作本身。
employer 指雇主（人或机构），employment 是就业这一抽象概念。
unemployment 是失业，与 employment 意义相反。

examples.quote: Therefore, everyone needs to find their extra – their unique value contribution that makes them stand out in whatever is their field of employment.
The rapid growth of the digital economy has created new forms of employment for young graduates.
examples.cn: 数字经济的快速发展为年轻毕业生创造了新的就业形式。

examples.quote: Many workers fear that automation will threaten their long-term employment prospects.
examples.cn: 许多工人担心自动化会威胁到他们的长期就业前景。

confusables.diff: property 泛指任何财产或房产，estate 侧重土地庄园或遗产整体
asset 指有价资产，常作复数；estate 指遗产或地产整体

examples.quote: Younger children should feel like they're choosing their home – without actually getting a choice in the matter, said Adam Bailey, real estate attorney based in New York.
His entire estate was divided among his three children after the funeral.
examples.cn: 葬礼之后，他的全部遗产被分给了他的三个孩子。

examples.quote: The old family estate has been converted into a museum open to the public.
examples.cn: 这座古老的家族庄园已被改造成对公众开放的博物馆。

confusables.diff: curricular 指课内的、课程设置的，与 extracurricular 正相反。

examples.quote: However, college admissions experts say that the quality of a college hopeful's extracurricular activities matters more than the number of activities he or she participates in.
Universities increasingly value extracurricular involvement as evidence of leadership and teamwork.
examples.cn: 大学越来越看重课外参与，把它视为领导力和团队合作的体现。

examples.quote: Too many extracurricular commitments may leave students little time for serious academic work.
examples.cn: 过多的课外事务可能使学生几乎没有时间从事严肃的学业。

confusables.diff: altogether 意为“完全地；总共”，强调程度或数量总和，而 overall 作副词时意为“总体而言”，用于总结评价。
generally 侧重“通常、普遍地”，指一般情况下；overall 侧重“从整体看”，用于综合考量后下结论。

examples.quote: That was bad for my overall fitness goals.
Overall, the study suggests that moderate exercise benefits mental health more than intense training.
examples.cn: 总体而言，该研究表明适度运动比高强度训练更有利于心理健康。

examples.quote: The overall cost of the project has risen by 20 percent since last year.
examples.cn: 自去年以来，该项目的总成本已上涨了20%。

meanings.cn: 退役；退出（某项活动或职业）

confusables.diff: retreat 指撤退、退却或静修处，不指因年龄离职。
resignation 是主动辞职，多指中途离开职位，不限于到龄退休。
pension 指退休金、养老金，是 retirement 后领取的钱，非状态本身。

examples.quote: More Americans are opting to work well into retirement, a growing trend that threatens to upend the old workforce model.
Many workers postpone retirement because they fear their savings will not cover living costs.
examples.cn: 许多劳动者推迟退休，因为他们担心积蓄无法覆盖生活开支。

examples.quote: Since his retirement, he has devoted himself to volunteer work in the community.
examples.cn: 自退休以来，他一直投身于社区志愿服务。

confusables.diff: applications 更正式，常指桌面软件或申请；apps 多指移动应用，口语化。
programs 泛指计算机程序，不限于移动端；apps 特指移动或网页应用。

examples.quote: For instance, one of the apps the students are developing suggests movies based on your mood.
Many students use language-learning apps to practice vocabulary on their phones.
examples.cn: 许多学生使用语言学习应用在手机上练习词汇。

examples.quote: The company develops apps that help users track their daily spending habits.
examples.cn: 该公司开发帮助用户追踪日常消费习惯的应用程序。

confusables.diff: emergency 指突发的、需立即应对的紧急事件，crisis 强调发展中的危险转折期。
climax 指高潮或顶点，crisis 指危险的不稳定关头。

examples.quote: In much of the world there is little sign of crisis.
The global financial crisis forced many firms to rethink their long-term strategies.
examples.cn: 全球金融危机迫使许多公司重新思考其长期战略。

examples.quote: When the crisis came, the government responded with a series of bold measures.
examples.cn: 危机来临时，政府以一系列大胆措施予以应对。

meanings.cn: （机器、系统等）高效能的，不浪费的

confusables.diff: effective 强调能达到预期效果，efficient 强调以最少耗费取得效果。
efficacious 多指药物、方法等产生预期疗效，较正式；efficient 侧重效率与资源节约。
proficient 指人技能熟练、精通，efficient 指做事或运作高效。

examples.quote: It remains to be seen how weather conditions affect the air flows that make formation flight more efficient.
The new system is far more efficient at processing data than the old one.
examples.cn: 新系统处理数据的效率远高于旧系统。

examples.quote: Managers are under pressure to find more efficient ways of working.
examples.cn: 管理者面临压力，需要找到更高效的工作方式。

meanings.cn: 易动感情的；情绪激动的
引起情感共鸣的；感人至深的

confusables.diff: emotive 多指词语或话题本身带有强烈情感色彩，emotional 侧重人的情绪或情感本身。
sentimental 常含多愁善感、感伤怀旧之意，emotional 更中性，泛指与情感有关。

examples.quote: It is deeply uncomfortable – it's the emotional equivalent of wearing a jacket weighted with stones.
Children who receive consistent emotional support tend to handle stress more effectively.
examples.cn: 持续获得情感支持的孩子往往能更有效地应对压力。

examples.quote: The film's emotional ending left many viewers in tears.
examples.cn: 这部电影感人的结局让许多观众落泪。

confusables.diff: employees 指雇员，employers 指雇主，二者互为对应关系。
employment 是名词，指就业或雇用这一状态，不指人。

examples.quote: There are concerns that government, employers, and marketers might be able to access these data, thereby violating our privacy.
Many employers now offer flexible working arrangements to attract skilled workers.
examples.cn: 许多雇主现在提供弹性工作安排以吸引技术工人。

examples.quote: Employers are legally required to provide a safe working environment for their staff.
examples.cn: 法律要求雇主为员工提供安全的工作环境。

confusables.diff: worldwide 侧重空间上遍及世界，global 更强调作为一个整体的全球性。
overall 指总体、综合的，常修饰数量或状况；global 指涉及整个范围或全体。

examples.quote: The outbreak of swine flu that was first detected in Mexico was declared a global epidemic on June 11, 2009.
The company has expanded its operations into the global market over the past decade.
examples.cn: 过去十年间，该公司已将其业务拓展至全球市场。

examples.quote: Governments must cooperate to address global challenges such as climate change and inequality.
examples.cn: 各国政府必须合作应对气候变化和不平等等全球性挑战。

confusables.diff: personal 强调与个人私事相关，individual 强调相对于群体而言的单个个体
private 指私密的、非公开的，individual 无隐私含义，仅指单个的

examples.quote: For example, it is unclear whether the sequencing of a whole genome violates the patents of individual genes within it.
Each individual is expected to take responsibility for the choices he or she makes.
examples.cn: 每个个体都应为自己所做的选择负责。

examples.quote: The study found that individual behavior varies greatly within the same social group.
examples.cn: 研究发现，同一社会群体内部的个体行为差异很大。

confusables.diff: matter 泛指需要处理的事情或麻烦，issue 侧重公众讨论或需解决的重要议题。
problem 强调需解决的困难或难题，issue 更中性，常指有争议的议题。
publish 多指出版书籍或发表文章，issue 常指官方发布声明、证件或发行货币。

examples.quote: Their success may be determined by a suit related to this issue, brought by the Mayo Clinic, which the Supreme Court will hear in its next term.
The government has come under pressure to address the issue of rising tuition fees.
examples.cn: 政府面临压力，需解决学费上涨的问题。

examples.quote: The bank issued a new credit card to each qualified applicant.
examples.cn: 银行为每位符合条件的申请人发放了一张新信用卡。

confusables.diff: chance 更强调偶然性，opportunity 多指有利的、可把握的时机。
occasion 指某一时刻或场合，opportunity 指可供行动的机会。

phrases.en: take the opportunity to do sth

examples.quote: They prefer to come and go as opportunity calls them.
The new policy offers young graduates an opportunity to gain practical experience abroad.
examples.cn: 新政策为年轻毕业生提供了到国外获得实践经验的机会。

examples.quote: She took every opportunity to improve her English before the entrance examination.
examples.cn: 入学考试前，她抓住一切机会提高英语水平。

meanings.cn: show 的过去分词：展示，显示，表明

confusables.diff: shown 是 show 的过去分词，而 showed 是过去式；完成时和被动语态须用 shown。
shone 是 shine 的过去式/过去分词，意为“发光”，与 show 的屈折形式形近易混。

examples.quote: Teachers, employers, and health professionals have been shown to harbor biases against the obese.
Studies have shown that regular exercise can significantly reduce the risk of heart disease.
examples.cn: 研究表明，经常锻炼能显著降低患心脏病的风险。

examples.quote: As shown in the chart, the number of graduates rose sharply after 2015.
examples.cn: 如图所示，2015 年之后毕业生人数急剧上升。

confusables.diff: capability 侧重完成某项任务的潜在本领，capacity 侧重容纳或产出能力
ability 多指人的技能，capacity 还可指物体容量或系统产能

examples.quote: We still have the imaginative capacity to rise above temptation and reverse the high-speed trend.
The stadium has a seating capacity of 60,000, making it the largest in the region.
examples.cn: 这座体育场可容纳六万名观众，是该地区最大的。

examples.quote: Many employees underestimate their capacity to adapt to rapid technological change.
examples.cn: 许多员工低估了自己适应技术快速变化的能力。

confusables.diff: curious 是形容词，表示好奇的；curiosity 是名词，表示好奇心。
curio 指古董或珍品，curiosity 含义更广，可指好奇心或奇物。

examples.quote: Instead of saying: "If we set an end-of-quarter deadline, we will never make it," say, "This is just my opinion, but I don't see how we will make that deadline." Having asserted your opinion (as a position, not as a fact), demonstrate equal curiosity about other views.
Her curiosity about distant cultures led her to pursue a career in anthropology.
examples.cn: 她对遥远文化的好奇心促使她从事人类学职业。

examples.quote: The museum displayed a collection of curiosities brought back from the expeditions.
examples.cn: 博物馆展出了一批从探险中带回的珍奇物品。

confusables.diff: although 是连词，后接从句；despite 是介词，后接名词或动名词。
两者意义相同，但 in spite of 后必须接名词或动名词，despite 更正式，可单独使用。

phrases.cn: 不由自主地，不知不觉地

examples.quote: But despite common misconceptions, a gap year does not hinder the success of academic pursuits – in fact, it probably enhances it.
Despite the heavy rain, the researchers continued their fieldwork in the remote village.
examples.cn: 尽管大雨倾盆，研究人员仍继续在偏远村庄进行实地考察。

examples.quote: Despite his lack of experience, he managed to solve the problem efficiently.
examples.cn: 尽管缺乏经验，他还是高效地解决了问题。

confusables.diff: insure 主要指“给…保险”，而 ensure 是“确保（某事发生）”。
assure 强调“向某人保证/使某人确信”，宾语通常是人；ensure 强调“确保某事”。

examples.quote: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?
The new regulations are designed to ensure that all employees receive adequate training.
examples.cn: 新规旨在确保所有员工接受充分培训。

examples.quote: Strict inspections ensure the quality of the products before they leave the factory.
examples.cn: 严格的检查确保产品出厂前的质量。

meanings.cn: 环境的；有关环境（保护）的

confusables.diff: environment 是名词“环境”，environmental 是其形容词形式。
environmentalism 是名词“环保主义”，environmental 是形容词。

examples.quote: Some Congress members are trying to block the plan, and at least a dozen industry groups, four states, and three environmental groups are challenging it in federal court.
The report warns that environmental damage from industrial expansion may be irreversible.
examples.cn: 报告警告说，工业扩张造成的环境破坏可能不可逆转。

examples.quote: Consumers are increasingly willing to pay more for products with low environmental costs.
examples.cn: 消费者越来越愿意为环境成本低的产品支付更高价格。

confusables.diff: counterfeit 多指仿造货币、文件等以假乱真，fake 更口语化、适用范围更广。
false 强调与事实不符或不真实的状态，fake 强调人为伪造冒充。

examples.quote: But don't overdo it or be fake about it.
Consumers are increasingly wary of fake reviews that distort online ratings.
examples.cn: 消费者对扭曲网络评分的虚假评论越来越警惕。

examples.quote: He was accused of faking his academic credentials to obtain the position.
examples.cn: 他被指控伪造学历以获取该职位。

confusables.diff: formulation 指系统阐述或配方制取，formation 指自然或人为的形成过程。
framework 指支撑性结构框架，formation 强调形成的动作或结果。

examples.quote: Since 1914, scientists have known that birds flying in formation – a V-shape – expend less energy.
The formation of a stable government depends on broad public trust.
examples.cn: 一个稳定政府的形成有赖于广泛的公众信任。

examples.quote: Scientists studied how the rock formation evolved over millions of years.
examples.cn: 科学家研究了这处岩层在数百万年间是如何演变的。

meanings.cn: 复杂难懂的；错综复杂的

confusables.diff: evolved 意为“进化、演变”，强调发展变化；involved 意为“卷入、参与”，强调关联或复杂。
involve 是动词，意为“涉及、包含”；involved 是形容词，描述状态或特征。

phrases.cn: 与……有关联；与……有密切关系

examples.quote: Indeed, there is something a little absurd in the state getting involved in the planning of such a fundamentally "grassroots" concept as community sports associations.
The complicated procedure involved several departments and took months to complete.
examples.cn: 这一复杂的程序涉及多个部门，耗时数月才完成。

examples.quote: She was deeply involved in the community project and devoted most of her spare time to it.
examples.cn: 她深度参与了该社区项目，并投入了大部分业余时间。

meanings.cn: （英）连锁商店；多家分店的企业

confusables.diff: manifold 强调种类繁多且相互关联，较正式；multiple 仅指数量上不止一个。
multiply 是动词“乘；繁殖”；multiple 是形容词或名词。

examples.quote: A century ago, few people regularly brushed their teeth multiple times a day.
The report identifies multiple factors behind the decline in consumer spending.
examples.cn: 该报告指出了消费者支出下降背后的多种因素。

examples.quote: Twelve is a multiple of three and four.
examples.cn: 12 是 3 和 4 的倍数。

confusables.diff: online 表示联网在线，offline 表示离线不联网，二者反义。
online 是形容词或副词，表示处于联网状态；internet 是名词，指互联网本身。

examples.quote: If you have no friends or relatives, try to participate in several online communities, full of people who are always willing to share advice and encouragement.
More consumers now prefer to shop online because it saves both time and money.
examples.cn: 如今更多消费者倾向于网上购物，因为这样既省时又省钱。

examples.quote: The university offers a range of online courses for students who cannot attend in person.
examples.cn: 这所大学为无法到校上课的学生提供了一系列在线课程。

confusables.diff: easy 是形容词，easily 是对应副词，修饰动词而非名词。
readily 强调乐意或迅速，easily 强调难度低或不费力。

phrases.cn: 易于获得的；容易到达的

examples.quote: But with homework counting for no more than 10% of their grades, students can easily skip half their homework and see very little difference on their report cards.
Such problems cannot be solved easily without cooperation between the two sides.
examples.cn: 没有双方的配合，这类问题很难轻易解决。

examples.quote: She is easily the most experienced candidate for the position.
examples.cn: 她无疑是这个职位上最有经验的候选人。

meanings.cn: 主管；行政人员；（企业或机构的）管理人员

confusables.diff: execution 是名词，指“执行、处决”；executive 作名词指“主管”，作形容词指“行政的”。
executor 指“遗嘱执行人”或“执行者”，是具体执行人；executive 多指决策层管理人员。

examples.quote: But Edward Dolman, Christie's chief executive, says: "I'm pretty confident we're at the bottom."
The board appointed a new chief executive to lead the company through its restructuring.
examples.cn: 董事会任命了一位新的首席执行官，带领公司完成重组。

examples.quote: Senior executives were criticized for failing to respond to the market changes.
examples.cn: 高管们因未能对市场变化作出反应而受到批评。

meanings.cn: 投资物；被投资的企业或资产

confusables.diff: investment 指投入的资金或行为结果，investing 侧重投资这一持续动作。
investment 强调为获利而投入的资本，asset 泛指拥有的任何有价财产。

examples.quote: Although electric cars are still a rarity on roads now, this massive investment could change the picture rapidly in coming years.
Firms that neglect long-term investment in research may lose their competitive edge.
examples.cn: 忽视研究领域长期投资的企业可能会失去竞争优势。

examples.quote: The government hopes to attract foreign investment by simplifying approval procedures.
examples.cn: 政府希望通过简化审批程序来吸引外资。

confusables.diff: passion 强调强烈、近乎炽热的情感，enthusiasm 侧重对事物的热忱与兴趣。
emotion 泛指各种情绪，passion 指强烈而难以抑制的情感。

examples.quote: But the market generates interest far beyond its size because it brings together great wealth, enormous egos, greed, passion and controversy in a way matched by few other industries.
She pursued her passion for music despite her parents' opposition.
examples.cn: 尽管父母反对，她仍执着于对音乐的热爱。

examples.quote: His speech was delivered with such passion that the audience rose to applaud.
examples.cn: 他的演讲如此充满激情，以致听众起立鼓掌。

confusables.diff: premium 指保险费或额外费用，payment 泛指支付的款项。
installment 指分期付款的一期，payment 可指任何一次付款。

examples.quote: In the early 2010s, a wide range of businesses started processing purchases with iPads and other digital payment systems.
The company offers flexible payment options to customers who cannot afford a lump sum.
examples.cn: 该公司为无法一次性付清的客户提供灵活的付款方式。

examples.quote: Late payment of the rent may result in an additional charge.
examples.cn: 逾期支付房租可能会产生额外费用。

confusables.diff: psychiatrist 指可开具处方、治疗精神疾病的精神科医生，psychologist 侧重心理研究与心理咨询，通常无处方权。
psychology 是“心理学”这一学科，psychologist 指从事该学科的人。

examples.quote: Radesky cites the "still face experiment" devised by developmental psychologist Ed Tronick in the 1970s.
The psychologist argued that early childhood experiences shape adult behavior more than genes do.
examples.cn: 这位心理学家认为，童年早期经历对成年行为的影响比基因更大。

examples.quote: Before drawing conclusions, the researchers consulted a psychologist about the reliability of the test.
examples.cn: 在得出结论之前，研究人员就测试的可靠性咨询了一位心理学家。

confusables.diff: tactic 指为达成某一步目标的具体战术或手段，strategy 指全局性的战略部署。
stratagem 多指为欺骗对手而设的计谋，含诡计色彩，strategy 为中性词。

examples.quote: AT&T is often given as the gold standard of a company who decided to do a massive reskilling program rather than go with a fire-and-hire strategy.
Companies must develop a clear strategy to remain competitive in an increasingly global market.
examples.cn: 企业必须制定清晰的战略，以便在日益全球化的市场中保持竞争力。

examples.quote: The government's new strategy for reducing unemployment has been widely criticized by economists.
examples.cn: 政府降低失业率的新策略受到了经济学家的广泛批评。

meanings.cn: 卡住的；陷住的；无法移动的
stick 的过去式和过去分词：粘贴；刺；卡住

confusables.diff: strike 意为“打、罢工”，过去式为 struck，与 stuck 形近但义异。
stack 意为“堆叠、堆放”，与 stuck 拼写仅一字母之差。

examples.quote: Yet the debate about how to save Europe's single currency from disintegration is stuck.
Many graduates feel stuck in low-paid jobs that offer little chance of promotion.
examples.cn: 许多毕业生感到被困在几乎无晋升机会的低薪工作中。

examples.quote: The researchers were stuck for an explanation when the data contradicted their hypothesis.
examples.cn: 当数据与假设相矛盾时，研究人员一时找不到解释。

meanings.cn: 数千；成千上万（thousand 的复数形式，表示大量）

confusables.diff: thousand 是数词“千”，thousands 用于泛指“成千上万”且常与 of 连用。
millions 表示“数百万”，数量级为百万，thousands 为千级。

examples.quote: The average supermarket, according to the Food Marketing Institute, carries some 44,000 different items, and many carry tens of thousands more.
Thousands of graduates apply for the position every year, but only a few are selected.
examples.cn: 每年有成千上万的毕业生申请这个职位，但只有少数人被录用。

examples.quote: The new policy is expected to benefit thousands of low-income families across the country.
examples.cn: 这项新政策预计将惠及全国数千个低收入家庭。

meanings.cn: （某机构或国家的）全体员工，工作人员

confusables.diff: workload 指工作量或负担，workforce 指劳动力群体。
staff 指具体机构的全体职员，workforce 更宏观，常指劳动力总体。

examples.quote: As fewer such workers enter the country, the characteristics of the agricultural workforce are changing.
As automation spreads, companies must retrain their workforce to meet new demands.
examples.cn: 随着自动化普及，企业必须重新培训员工以适应新的需求。

examples.quote: Women now make up nearly half of the country's workforce.
examples.cn: 女性目前占该国劳动力的近一半。

meanings.cn: 更坏的；更差的；病情加重的

confusables.diff: worse 是较坏（比较级），worst 是最坏（最高级），二者不可混用。
worse 表“更差”，worth 表“值得”，拼写相近但词义无关。

examples.quote: The likelihood of being named in a federal class-action lawsuit also increases, and the stock is likely to perform worse.
The situation may get worse before it gets better, so we must act now.
examples.cn: 情况可能在好转之前变得更糟，因此我们必须立即行动。

examples.quote: There is nothing worse than making a promise you cannot keep.
examples.cn: 没有什么比许下无法兑现的承诺更糟糕的了。

confusables.diff: alarm 多指令人惊恐的警报或恐慌情绪，alert 作名词时侧重警戒状态或预警信号。
vigilant 强调长期保持警惕的状态，alert 更强调反应灵敏、随时准备应对。

examples.quote: Jealousy and anger, for example, may have evolved to alert us to important inequalities.
Teachers should remain alert to signs of stress among students during exam season.
examples.cn: 考试季期间，教师应警惕学生出现压力迹象。

examples.quote: The system alerts users to suspicious login attempts within seconds.
examples.cn: 该系统会在几秒内提醒用户注意可疑的登录尝试。

confusables.diff: core 指事物的中心或本质部分；corps 指军团或团体，拼写相近但词义无关。

examples.quote: A "southern" camp headed by France wants something different: "European economic government" within an inner core of euro-zone members.
Trust is at the core of any lasting partnership between nations.
examples.cn: 信任是国家间任何持久伙伴关系的核心。

examples.quote: The report ignores the core issue: who will pay for the reform.
examples.cn: 该报告忽略了核心问题：谁来为改革买单。

confusables.diff: inventive 强调善于发明新事物，creative 更侧重想象与表达上的独创性
innovative 强调引入新方法或新观念，creative 更强调产生原创想法的能力

examples.quote: They're more productive, more creative, and willing to take greater risks.
A creative approach to problem-solving often yields results that conventional methods cannot achieve.
examples.cn: 创造性的解决问题方法往往能取得传统方法无法达到的效果。

examples.quote: The company encourages employees to take creative risks rather than follow established routines.
examples.cn: 公司鼓励员工承担创造性的风险，而不是墨守成规。

meanings.cn: 有定义的；明确的；界限清楚的
定义；界定（define 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: definite 强调确定无疑、不容置疑；defined 强调已被清楚界定或界限分明。
definitive 指最终的、权威的；defined 仅指已界定清楚的。

examples.quote: First generation was defined as not having a parent with a four-year college degree.
The role of the state in the economy is less clearly defined than it once was.
examples.cn: 国家在经济中的角色不像以往那样界定得那么清楚了。

examples.quote: Success is often defined by the standards of the society in which one lives.
examples.cn: 成功往往由一个人所处社会的标准来定义。

meanings.cn: 有教育意义的；起教育作用的

confusables.diff: educative 更强调“有教育效果的”，educational 侧重“与教育相关的”
educationalist 是名词，指教育家或教育学者，educational 是形容词

examples.quote: This law abolished special educational requirements for federal jurors and required them to be selected at random from a cross section of the entire community.
The government has pledged to increase spending on educational programs in rural areas.
examples.cn: 政府已承诺增加农村地区教育项目的支出。

examples.quote: The documentary is highly educational, offering viewers a vivid picture of ancient civilization.
examples.cn: 这部纪录片极具教育意义，为观众生动展现了古代文明。

confusables.diff: effective 强调达到预期效果，efficient 强调以最少投入高效完成。
effective 泛指有效，effectual 更强调确实产生预期结果，较正式。

phrases.cn: 生效（注：为 effect 搭配，此处 effect 名词形式相关）

examples.quote: Stop laughing: it's not just cost effective but helps you balance your diet.
The new policy proved effective in reducing air pollution in major cities.
examples.cn: 新政策在减少大城市空气污染方面被证明是有效的。

examples.quote: Only when the two sides trust each other can effective cooperation be achieved.
examples.cn: 只有双方互相信任，才能实现有效合作。

meanings.cn: 情绪；情感（emotion 的复数形式）

confusables.diff: feelings 更侧重主观感受与身体感觉，emotions 更强调心理层面的强烈情绪反应。
mood 指持续一段时间的心境状态，emotion 指较短暂而强烈的情绪。

examples.quote: Powerful memory doesn't make my emotions any more acute or vivid.
People who can regulate their emotions tend to cope better with stress and setbacks.
examples.cn: 能够调节情绪的人往往能更好地应对压力和挫折。

examples.quote: The study found that music can evoke strong emotions even in listeners who claim to be indifferent.
examples.cn: 研究发现，音乐甚至能唤起那些自称无动于衷的听众的强烈情感。

meanings.cn: 伦理；道德规范（复数形式，常作单数用）

confusables.diff: morals 侧重个人品德与行为规范，ethics 更强调系统性的伦理原则或职业准则。
ethos 指某群体或文化的核心精神气质，ethics 指道德准则体系。

examples.quote: But a new study published in Cognition found that, in at least one real-world situation, a single ethics lesson may have had lasting effects.
The committee questioned the ethics of conducting research on vulnerable populations without their consent.
examples.cn: 委员会质疑在未征得弱势群体同意的情况下对其进行研究的伦理正当性。

examples.quote: A strong code of ethics is essential for maintaining public trust in journalism.
examples.cn: 严格的道德准则是维持公众对新闻业信任的关键。

confusables.diff: finding 为单数，指单个发现或裁决；findings 为复数，常指研究或调查的系列结果。
results 泛指结果，findings 强调经调查或研究后得出的发现。

examples.quote: "I don't think the findings that we have are any evidence of personal delusion," says Epley.
The findings suggest that regular exercise can significantly reduce stress levels.
examples.cn: 研究结果表明，经常锻炼能显著降低压力水平。

examples.quote: Researchers presented their findings at the annual conference.
examples.cn: 研究人员在年会上展示了他们的研究结果。

meanings.cn: （对某职位或任务的）胜任能力

confusables.diff: suitability 强调是否合乎特定要求或场合，fitness 更侧重健康状态或胜任能力。
该词本身无常见形近易混词，注意不要与 fitting（配件；试穿）混淆。

examples.quote: He said that manufacturers of crisps and candies could play a central role in the Change4Life campaign, the centrepiece of government efforts to boost healthy eating and fitness.
Regular exercise improves physical fitness and helps reduce the risk of chronic disease.
examples.cn: 经常锻炼能增强体能，并有助于降低患慢性病的风险。

examples.quote: The committee questioned his fitness for the position after the scandal.
examples.cn: 丑闻发生后，委员会质疑他是否胜任该职位。

confusables.diff: gasp 意为“喘气、倒吸一口气”，与 gaps 发音相近但词义无关。
gape 意为“目瞪口呆地凝视”或“裂开”，与 gaps 拼写相近但词性常为动词。

examples.quote: As a result, farms have grown increasingly reliant on temporary guest workers using the H-2A visa to fill the gaps in the workforce.
Widening income gaps have fueled public concern about social inequality.
examples.cn: 不断扩大的收入差距加剧了公众对社会不平等的担忧。

examples.quote: Researchers identified several gaps in the existing data that require further investigation.
examples.cn: 研究人员发现现有数据中存在几处空白，需要进一步调查。

confusables.diff: inhabit 是动词“居住于”，habitat 是名词“栖息地”。
habit 指个人习惯，habitat 指生物赖以生存的自然环境。

examples.quote: The fund will also be used to compensate landowners who set aside habitat.
Rapid urban expansion has destroyed the natural habitat of many endangered species.
examples.cn: 城市的快速扩张破坏了许多濒危物种的自然栖息地。

examples.quote: Scientists are studying how climate change alters the habitat of migratory birds.
examples.cn: 科学家正在研究气候变化如何改变候鸟的栖息地。

meanings.cn: （国家或机构的）基础体系，支撑系统

confusables.diff: facility 指具体的设施、设备或场所，常可数；infrastructure 指道路、电网等整体基础系统，通常不可数。
structure 泛指任何结构或构造物；infrastructure 特指支撑社会运行的基础性系统。

examples.quote: When the government talks about infrastructure contributing to the economy the focus is usually on roads, railways, broadband and energy.
The government plans to invest heavily in infrastructure to boost economic growth in rural areas.
examples.cn: 政府计划大力投资基础设施，以促进农村地区的经济增长。

examples.quote: Poor infrastructure often hinders the development of small businesses in remote regions.
examples.cn: 薄弱的基础设施常常阻碍偏远地区小企业的发展。

confusables.diff: instance 强调具体事例或情况，example 更泛指典型例子或榜样。
case 侧重个案、案件或情形，instance 多指可引证的实例。
instant 意为瞬间或立即的，与 instance 形近但词义无关。

examples.quote: For instance, one of the apps the students are developing suggests movies based on your mood.
In many instances, technological innovation has reduced the demand for unskilled labor.
examples.cn: 在许多情况下，技术创新减少了对非熟练劳动力的需求。

examples.quote: Her reluctance to speak in public is a notable instance of her lack of confidence.
examples.cn: 她不愿公开发言是她缺乏自信的一个明显例子。

confusables.diff: sustain 强调支撑、承受或使持续不断，maintain 侧重使保持原有状态。
retain 指保留、留住（不失去），maintain 指维持现状或保养。
contain 意为包含、容纳，与 maintain 拼写相近但含义无关。

examples.quote: To deliver results to its users quickly, then, Google has to maintain vast data centres around the world, packed with powerful computers.
The company has managed to maintain its lead in the smartphone market despite fierce competition.
examples.cn: 尽管竞争激烈，该公司仍设法保持了在智能手机市场的领先地位。

examples.quote: Critics maintain that the new policy will do little to reduce unemployment.
examples.cn: 批评者坚称这项新政策对降低失业率作用甚微。

confusables.diff: producers 泛指生产或出产者（含农产品、能源等），manufacturers 特指通过加工制造工业品的厂商。
makers 多用于品牌或手工制造语境（如 film-maker），manufacturers 强调规模化工业制造。

examples.quote: He said that manufacturers of crisps and candies could play a central role in the Change4Life campaign, the centrepiece of government efforts to boost healthy eating and fitness.
Many manufacturers have shifted production overseas to cut labor costs.
examples.cn: 许多制造商已将生产转移到海外以降低劳动力成本。

examples.quote: The new regulations require manufacturers to disclose detailed information about product safety.
examples.cn: 新规要求制造商披露有关产品安全的详细信息。

meanings.cn: 肥胖的，臃肿的（尤指医学上体重超标）

confusables.diff: overweight 指轻度超重，obese 指严重肥胖、达到医学诊断标准

examples.quote: Teachers, employers, and health professionals have been shown to harbor biases against the obese.
Studies show that children who consume sugary drinks daily are more likely to become obese.
examples.cn: 研究表明，每天饮用含糖饮料的儿童更容易变得肥胖。

examples.quote: The government has launched a campaign to tackle the growing number of obese teenagers.
examples.cn: 政府已发起一项运动，以应对日益增多的肥胖青少年。

meanings.cn: 保险费；附加费，额外费用

confusables.diff: bonus 指额外奖励、红利，premium 指额外加收的费用或保险金。
price 泛指价格，premium 特指超出常规价格的部分或高端定位。

examples.quote: The egg industry's push is the first major test of whether animal products from regenerative farms can become the next premium offering.
Consumers are often willing to pay a premium for products that are environmentally friendly.
examples.cn: 消费者通常愿意为环保产品支付溢价。

examples.quote: The company raised its insurance premium after the accident.
examples.cn: 事故发生后，该公司提高了保险费。

meanings.cn: 反叛的，叛逆的；难控制的

confusables.diff: 拼写相似但词性不同：rebellious是形容词，rebellion是名词。
defiant强调公然违抗的态度，rebellious更侧重有反叛倾向或参与叛乱。

examples.quote: At the same time, once cheerful and compliant children become rebellious teenage risk-takers.
As a rebellious teenager, she often challenged her parents' authority.
examples.cn: 作为一个叛逆的青少年，她经常挑战父母的权威。

examples.quote: The government struggled to suppress the rebellious provinces.
examples.cn: 政府努力镇压那些反叛的省份。

confusables.diff: scope 指活动的范围或机会，scale 强调规模大小或等级。
scale 单数可指规模或刻度，scales 复数常特指天平或鳞片。

examples.quote: In fact, those who thought that the images higher up the attractiveness scale were real directly corresponded with those who showed other markers for having higher self-esteem.
The government has launched a large-scale campaign to promote renewable energy.
examples.cn: 政府已发起一项大规模运动来推广可再生能源。

examples.quote: The company plans to scale up production to meet the growing demand.
examples.cn: 公司计划扩大生产以满足日益增长的需求。

confusables.diff: scarcity 强调资源稀缺的客观状态，shortage 侧重供应量与需求量之间的缺口。
deficiency 多指营养、能力等方面的缺乏或缺陷，shortage 多指物资、人力等供应不足。

examples.quote: When the recovery began, worker shortages first appeared in the high-skilled trades.
Severe labor shortages have forced many firms to raise wages and automate production.
examples.cn: 严重的劳动力短缺迫使许多公司提高工资并实现生产自动化。

examples.quote: The report warns that water shortages could trigger regional conflicts in the coming decades.
examples.cn: 报告警告说，水资源短缺可能在未来几十年引发地区冲突。

confusables.diff: signal 指传递信息或指令的信号（如手势、灯光），sign 指标志或迹象
symptom 专指疾病的症状或不良现象的征兆，sign 含义更广

examples.quote: In much of the world there is little sign of crisis.
The survey found that a growing number of graduates are showing signs of anxiety about employment.
examples.cn: 调查发现，越来越多的毕业生表现出对就业的焦虑迹象。

examples.quote: Both parties signed the agreement after months of negotiations.
examples.cn: 经过数月谈判，双方签署了协议。

confusables.diff: resolution 指决心或正式决议，solution 指解决问题的办法。
dissolution 指解散、终止或溶解过程，solution 侧重解决或溶液本身。

examples.quote: Our perception of the problem and of what the solution is becomes very limited."
The government is under pressure to come up with a practical solution to the housing crisis.
examples.cn: 政府面临压力，需要拿出解决住房危机的切实办法。

examples.quote: Scientists hope the new chemical solution can break down pollutants more efficiently.
examples.cn: 科学家希望这种新化学溶液能更高效地分解污染物。

confusables.diff: share 侧重股份份额，stock 可指股票总称或库存。
bond 是债券，代表债权；stock 是股票，代表股权。

examples.quote: The likelihood of being named in a federal class-action lawsuit also increases, and the stock is likely to perform worse.
Retailers often stock up on goods before the holiday season to meet demand.
examples.cn: 零售商常在假日季前囤积货物以满足需求。

examples.quote: Investors who hold too much stock in one company face considerable risk.
examples.cn: 在一家公司持有过多股票的投资者面临相当大的风险。

confusables.diff: stuff 多指不具体的杂物，material 指制作某物的原材料。
stuff 为“东西”，staff 指“全体职员”，拼写相近。

examples.quote: The problem with being a grownup is that there's an awful lot of serious stuff to deal with – work, mortgage payments, figuring out what to cook for dinner.
Most of the stuff in the attic is old furniture nobody wants anymore.
examples.cn: 阁楼里大多数东西都是没人再想要的旧家具。

examples.quote: She stuffed the receipts into her bag and hurried out of the office.
examples.cn: 她把收据塞进包里，匆匆走出办公室。

meanings.cn: 威胁（threaten 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: threatened 指自身受到威胁，threatening 指带有威胁性的、令人害怕的。
endangered 多指物种濒临灭绝，threatened 范围更广，泛指受威胁。

examples.quote: The recession threatened to remove the advertising and readers that had not already fled to the internet.
Many species are threatened with extinction as their habitats shrink.
examples.cn: 随着栖息地缩小，许多物种面临灭绝的威胁。

examples.quote: Employees who feel threatened by change tend to resist it.
examples.cn: 对变革感到受威胁的员工往往抵制变革。

meanings.cn: （经济、社会等）不健全的，不良的

confusables.diff: unhealthful 更强调“对健康有害的”且多用于美式书面语，unhealthy 更常用且还可指人或状况本身不健康。
sickly 侧重“体弱多病的、病态的”，unhealthy 泛指不健康或有害健康。

examples.quote: As this new science of habit has emerged, controversies have erupted when the tactics have been used to sell questionable beauty creams or unhealthy foods.
A growing body of evidence links an unhealthy diet to a higher risk of chronic disease.
examples.cn: 越来越多的证据表明，不健康的饮食与慢性病风险升高有关。

examples.quote: Experts warn that an unhealthy attachment to social media can harm young people's mental health.
examples.cn: 专家警告，对社交媒体的病态依赖可能损害年轻人的心理健康。

confusables.diff: workshop 指车间或研讨会，workplace 泛指任何工作场所。
workforce 指劳动力、全体员工，workplace 指工作地点。

examples.quote: "Thirty years ago, it would have been inconceivable to have imagined a ban on smoking in the workplace or in pubs, and yet that is what we have now.
New technology has transformed the workplace, making remote collaboration increasingly common.
examples.cn: 新技术改变了工作场所，使远程协作日益普遍。

examples.quote: Employers are legally required to ensure a safe workplace for all staff.
examples.cn: 法律要求雇主为所有员工确保安全的工作场所。

confusables.diff: additive 指添加物、添加剂（名词），或“添加的”，强调加入以改变性质；additional 强调在原物之外额外增加的。
extra 更口语化，指超出常规的额外部分；additional 更正式，强调在已有基础上再增添。

examples.quote: As more states consider promulgating additional regulations, there is a need for greater accountability from within the business community.
Employees who work overtime will receive additional pay for the hours they put in.
examples.cn: 加班的员工将按其投入的时间获得额外报酬。

examples.quote: The company requires additional funding to expand its research and development efforts.
examples.cn: 该公司需要额外资金来扩大研发工作。

meanings.cn: 生物多样性；生物多样化

confusables.diff: diversity 泛指任何种类的多样性，biodiversity 特指生物物种层面的多样性。
ecology 指生态学或生态关系，biodiversity 指物种的丰富与差异程度。

examples.quote: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
The destruction of rainforests poses a serious threat to global biodiversity.
examples.cn: 雨林的破坏对全球生物多样性构成严重威胁。

examples.quote: Scientists argue that protecting biodiversity is essential to human survival.
examples.cn: 科学家认为，保护生物多样性对人类生存至关重要。

meanings.cn: 集体的；共同的；集体主义的

confusables.diff: individual 强调个人或单个的，与 collective 的集体性相对。
collectivism 是名词，指集体主义思想体系；collective 作名词指集体本身。

examples.quote: We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.
Addressing climate change requires a collective effort rather than isolated actions by individual nations.
examples.cn: 应对气候变化需要集体努力，而非各国各自为政的孤立行动。

examples.quote: The workers formed a collective to negotiate better wages and working conditions.
examples.cn: 工人们成立了一个合作社，以争取更好的工资和工作条件。

meanings.cn: 委员会；佣金，回扣；委托，任务

confusables.diff: commit 指犯（罪）、承诺投入；commission 作动词指正式委托。
committee 是常设的委员会（集体）；commission 多为专项调查或行政委员会。
mission 指使命、任务或使团；commission 强调受委托办理的事务及佣金义。

examples.quote: Facebook promised the European commission then that it would not link phone numbers to Facebook identities, but it broke the promise almost as soon as the deal went through.
The government has set up a commission to investigate the causes of the financial crisis.
examples.cn: 政府已成立一个委员会调查这场金融危机的起因。

examples.quote: He works on commission, so his income depends entirely on how much he sells.
examples.cn: 他靠提成工作，因此收入完全取决于销售业绩。

confusables.diff: clue 指帮助破案的线索或解题提示；cue 指行动或反应的信号、暗示。
queue 意为队伍或排队，与 cue 拼写形近但读音和意义不同。

phrases.cn: 效仿某人/某事物；按…的暗示行事

examples.quote: These habits have helped companies earn billions of dollars when customers eat snacks or wipe counters almost without thinking, often in response to a carefully designed set of daily cues.
Teachers should use verbal and visual cues to help students grasp abstract concepts.
examples.cn: 教师应运用言语和视觉提示来帮助学生理解抽象概念。

examples.quote: Taking his cue from the audience's silence, the speaker shifted to a lighter topic.
examples.cn: 他从观众的沉默中得到暗示，转而谈了个更轻松的话题。

confusables.diff: detail 是单数原形，details 是复数形式，指多个细节或整体详情。
particulars 更强调逐项列出的具体条目，details 泛指细节信息。

examples.quote: California is leading the way, as it does on so many climate efforts, in figuring out the details.
The report omits several crucial details that could alter the conclusion.
examples.cn: 这份报告遗漏了几个可能改变结论的关键细节。

examples.quote: Please contact the office for further details about the application procedure.
examples.cn: 欲了解申请程序的更多详情，请与办公室联系。

confusables.diff: efficiency 强调以最少投入完成某事，effectiveness 强调是否达到预期效果。
efficacy 多用于药物、方法的效力，efficiency 侧重投入产出的比率。

examples.quote: Both Boeing and Airbus have trumpeted the efficiency of their newest aircraft, the 787 and A350 respectively.
Advances in technology have greatly increased the efficiency of industrial production.
examples.cn: 技术进步极大地提高了工业生产的效率。

examples.quote: Managers are under pressure to cut costs and improve efficiency.
examples.cn: 管理者面临降低成本和提高效率的压力。

confusables.diff: exclude 指把某人或某物排除在外，不使其进入；eliminate 强调彻底清除或消灭。
remove 指移走、去掉，语气中性；eliminate 更强调根除或使不复存在。
diminish 指数量或程度减少但依然存在；eliminate 指彻底消除。

examples.quote: If the district finds homework to be unimportant to its students' academic achievement, it should move to reduce or eliminate the assignments, not make them count for almost nothing.
New technology may eliminate the need for workers to perform repetitive tasks.
examples.cn: 新技术可能使工人不再需要从事重复性工作。

examples.quote: The team was eliminated from the competition after losing its second match.
examples.cn: 该队在输掉第二场比赛后被淘汰出局。

meanings.cn: 拥抱；欣然接受（观点、变革等）

confusables.diff: include 仅表示部分包含在内，embrace 强调把某事物作为整体的一部分纳入。
embarrass 意为使尴尬，与 embrace 拼写相近但意义无关。

examples.quote: In order to make the most of our focus and energy, we also need to embrace downtime, or as Newport suggests, "be lazy".
Rather than resisting technological change, rural communities should learn to embrace it.
examples.cn: 农村社区不应抵制技术变革，而应学会拥抱它。

examples.quote: The new policy embraces a wide range of environmental concerns.
examples.cn: 这项新政策涵盖了广泛的环境问题。

confusables.diff: elements 指构成整体的基本组成部分，常含自然元素之意；factors 指影响结果的条件或原因。
causes 强调直接导致结果的原因；factors 可为间接、多方面的促成条件。

examples.quote: But we need more time to assess other factors.
Several factors, including rising costs and weak demand, contributed to the company's decline.
examples.cn: 包括成本上升和需求疲软在内的几个因素导致了该公司的衰落。

examples.quote: Researchers must control for factors such as age and income before drawing conclusions.
examples.cn: 研究者在得出结论前必须控制年龄和收入等因素。

confusables.diff: style 侧重个人或时代的独特风格，fashion 侧重一时流行的风尚。
manner 指行为举止或方式，fashion 作“方式”时更书面、更强调方法。

examples.quote: My dream has always been to work somewhere in an area between fashion and publishing.
The fashion for organic food has spread rapidly among urban consumers.
examples.cn: 有机食品的时尚在城市消费者中迅速传播。

examples.quote: He fashioned a crude shelter from branches and leaves.
examples.cn: 他用树枝和树叶勉强搭了一个简陋的棚子。

confusables.diff: found 是动词“创立、建立”或 find 的过去式，与 fund 形近但词义无关。
finance 泛指筹措和提供资金，作名词指财政、金融；fund 多指专项基金或具体资金。

examples.quote: Ministers should also look at creating greater certainty in the rental environment, which would have a significant impact on the ability of registered providers to fund new developments from revenues.
The government has set up a special fund to help small businesses survive the recession.
examples.cn: 政府已设立一项专项基金，帮助小企业渡过经济衰退期。

examples.quote: The research was funded by a grant from the national science foundation.
examples.cn: 这项研究由国家科学基金会的一笔拨款资助。

confusables.diff: give 是原形/现在式，gave 仅用于一般过去时。
given 是过去分词或形容词/介词，gave 是过去式。

examples.quote: It gave me the validation and confidence that I'd lost.
The new policy gave rise to a heated debate among economists.
examples.cn: 新政策在经济学家中引发了激烈的争论。

examples.quote: She gave up her stable job to pursue a career in research.
examples.cn: 她放弃了稳定的工作去从事研究工作。

confusables.diff: sex 侧重生理性别，gender 侧重社会文化层面的性别
genre 指文学艺术作品的体裁或类型，与性别无关

examples.quote: And one of the easiest ways to segment a market is to magnify gender differences – or invent them where they did not previously exist.
Policies aimed at closing the gender gap in wages have gained wide support.
examples.cn: 旨在缩小性别工资差距的政策已获得广泛支持。

examples.quote: In many languages, the gender of a noun affects the form of its modifiers.
examples.cn: 在许多语言中，名词的性会影响其修饰语的形式。

confusables.diff: traits 指可观察的性状或特征，由基因决定；genes 是遗传物质本身。
alleles 是基因的不同变异形式，位于同一基因座；genes 是 DNA 片段的总称。

examples.quote: Companies had won patents for isolated DNA for decades – by 2005 some 20% of human genes were patented.
Researchers have identified genes that influence susceptibility to the disease.
examples.cn: 研究人员已经识别出影响该疾病易感性的基因。

examples.quote: Environmental factors can alter how genes are expressed without changing the DNA sequence.
examples.cn: 环境因素可以在不改变DNA序列的情况下改变基因的表达方式。

meanings.cn: 巨人；巨物；巨头（giant的复数形式）

confusables.diff: giant是单数形式，指一个巨人或巨头；giants是复数，指多个巨人或巨头。
gigantic是形容词，意为“巨大的”；giants是名词，指“巨人”或“巨头”。

examples.quote: The product they're selling is data, and we, the users, convert our lives to data for the benefit of the digital giants.
Tech giants like Apple and Google have reshaped the way we communicate.
examples.cn: 像苹果和谷歌这样的科技巨头已经重塑了我们的沟通方式。

examples.quote: The company competes with industry giants for a larger market share.
examples.cn: 该公司与行业巨头竞争以获取更大的市场份额。

confusables.diff: include 强调包含某物作为整体的一部分，involve 强调必然涉及或需要某事物。
entail 强调必然导致或需要（后果、条件），involve 更侧重涉及或使参与。

phrases.cn: 需要做某事；涉及做某事

examples.quote: Finally, there is perspective, which involves acknowledging that in the grand scheme of life, one lecture really doesn't matter.
Any policy that involves raising taxes is likely to meet with strong opposition.
examples.cn: 任何涉及增税的政策都可能遭到强烈反对。

examples.quote: The job involves frequent travel, so candidates must be flexible.
examples.cn: 这份工作需要频繁出差，因此应聘者必须灵活。

meanings.cn: 涉及；包含（involve 的现在分词）
需要投入大量精力（或时间）的；复杂费神的

confusables.diff: evolving 意为“逐渐演变、进化”，强调变化过程；involving 强调包含、牵涉或需要投入。
involved 是过去分词或形容词，常指“卷入的、复杂的”；involving 是现在分词，多表主动涉及或令人费神。

phrases.cn: 牵涉到；正在涉及（较少用，多见于进行时）

examples.quote: The authors of the paper are from different universities, and their findings are based on a study involving 147 students (who completed the project) at an unnamed private university.
The new regulation, involving several government departments, will take effect next month.
examples.cn: 这项涉及多个政府部门的新规定将于下月生效。

examples.quote: Jobs involving frequent communication with clients demand strong interpersonal skills.
examples.cn: 需要频繁与客户沟通的工作要求很强的人际交往能力。

confusables.diff: landlords 多指出租房屋或土地收租的房东，landowners 强调拥有土地产权本身。
farmers 指从事耕作的农民或农场经营者，未必拥有土地；landowners 侧重土地所有权。

examples.quote: The fund will also be used to compensate landowners who set aside habitat.
The new tax policy was strongly opposed by wealthy landowners who feared losing part of their income.
examples.cn: 这项新税收政策遭到富有的土地所有者的强烈反对，他们担心会损失部分收入。

examples.quote: In many rural areas, local landowners play a decisive role in determining how land is used.
examples.cn: 在许多农村地区，当地土地所有者在决定土地如何使用方面起着决定性作用。

confusables.diff: legislature 指立法机关（机构），legislation 指立法行为或制定的法律本身。
regulation 多指行政部门制定的规章，legislation 指立法机关通过的法律。

examples.quote: The key messages that have been put together for World Environment Day do include a call for governments to enact legislation to curb single-use plastics.
The new legislation is intended to protect consumers from unfair trade practices.
examples.cn: 这项新立法旨在保护消费者免受不公平贸易行为的侵害。

examples.quote: Critics argue that environmental legislation may impose heavy burdens on small businesses.
examples.cn: 批评者认为，环境立法可能会给小企业带来沉重负担。

confusables.diff: administration 侧重行政事务与政府/机构管理，management 侧重企业运营与人员调配。
manager 指管理者个人，management 指管理行为或管理层整体。

examples.quote: In particular, the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly until women are part of senior management decisions, and Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male.
Effective management requires both clear goals and the flexibility to adjust them.
examples.cn: 有效的管理既需要明确的目标，也需要调整目标的灵活性。

examples.quote: The company's management has agreed to negotiate with the union over pay.
examples.cn: 公司管理层已同意就薪酬问题与工会谈判。

meanings.cn: 千禧一代（指1980年代至1990年代末出生的人）

confusables.diff: generation 泛指一代人（约30年），millennials 特指特定出生年份区间的人群。
centennials 指2000年前后出生的人（Z世代），millennials 出生更早。

examples.quote: If "entitled" is the most common adjective, fairly or not, applied to millennials (those born between 1981 and 1995), the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious.
Employers are adapting their management styles to attract and retain millennials in the workforce.
examples.cn: 雇主正在调整管理风格，以吸引和留住职场中的千禧一代。

examples.quote: Millennials are often characterized as tech-savvy and valuing work-life balance over high salaries.
examples.cn: 千禧一代常被描述为精通技术，且更看重工作与生活的平衡而非高薪。

meanings.cn: 正确判断事物轻重的能力

confusables.diff: prospect 指前景、可能性，perspective 指看待问题的角度。
perception 强调感知、认知结果，perspective 强调观察立场。

examples.quote: Finally, there is perspective, which involves acknowledging that in the grand scheme of life, one lecture really doesn't matter.
Viewed from a historical perspective, the reform was inevitable rather than accidental.
examples.cn: 从历史的角度看，这场改革是必然的，而非偶然的。

examples.quote: Traveling abroad helped her put her own problems into perspective.
examples.cn: 出国旅行帮助她客观看待自己的问题。

meanings.cn: 大草原； prairies（尤指北美）无树的大草原

confusables.diff: plain 泛指平原，也可含树木；prairie 特指北美无树的大草原。
plateau 指海拔较高、地势平坦的高原；prairie 指低平的大草原。

phrases.cn: 草原犬鼠（北美草原的穴居动物）

examples.quote: "The lesser prairie chicken is in a desperate situation," said USFWS Director Daniel Ashe.
The vast prairie stretched for miles, broken only by a few isolated farmhouses.
examples.cn: 辽阔的大草原绵延数英里，只有几座孤零零的农舍点缀其间。

examples.quote: Early settlers on the prairie had to cope with harsh winters and scarce water.
examples.cn: 早期草原拓荒者不得不应对严酷的冬季和稀缺的水源。

confusables.diff: psychological 泛指心理与心理学的，psychiatric 专指精神病学与精神疾病治疗的。
mental 侧重心智或精神状态，psychological 更强调与心理学相关的心理过程。

examples.quote: I had not realised how profoundly marketing trends dictated our perception of what is natural to kids, including our core beliefs about their psychological development.
Prolonged exposure to social media may have a negative psychological effect on teenagers.
examples.cn: 长时间接触社交媒体可能对青少年产生负面的心理影响。

examples.quote: The study examines the psychological factors that influence consumer decisions.
examples.cn: 该研究考察了影响消费者决策的心理因素。

confusables.diff: quotas 是复数形式，quota 是单数，指单个定额或限额。
quotient 指数学中的商或比率，与配额无关。

examples.quote: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?
The government imposed strict quotas on imported cars to protect domestic manufacturers.
examples.cn: 政府对进口汽车实施了严格的配额以保护国内制造商。

examples.quote: Companies that fail to meet their production quotas may face penalties.
examples.cn: 未能完成生产定额的公司可能面临处罚。

confusables.diff: respond 是动词，response 是对应名词。
reply 多指口头或书面的直接回答，response 更强调对刺激或请求的反应。

examples.quote: These habits have helped companies earn billions of dollars when customers eat snacks or wipe counters almost without thinking, often in response to a carefully designed set of daily cues.
The government's response to the crisis was criticized as slow and inadequate.
examples.cn: 政府对该危机的反应被批评为迟缓且不够充分。

examples.quote: In response to rising demand, the company plans to expand its production capacity.
examples.cn: 为回应不断增长的需求，该公司计划扩大产能。

meanings.cn: 负有责任的；应承担责任的

confusables.diff: responsible 指负有责任，responsive 指反应迅速、回应积极。
responsible 泛指担责，accountable 强调须向他人交代、接受问责。

examples.quote: The homework rules should be put on hold while the school board, which is responsible for setting educational policy, looks into the matter and conducts public hearings.
Parents should be held responsible for the safety of their children on campus.
examples.cn: 父母应当对子女在校园内的安全负责。

examples.quote: A responsible manager never shifts blame onto his subordinates when problems arise.
examples.cn: 出现问题时，一位负责任的经理绝不会把责任推给下属。

meanings.cn: 为……安排路线；按指定路线发送

confusables.diff: roads 指供车辆行驶的道路，routes 强调从起点到终点的选定路径。
routines 指固定程序或惯例，routes 指空间或途径上的路线。

examples.quote: Contributors offer a wide array of stories, from little-known new shortcuts to long-established alternate routes.
The new rail link offers faster routes between the two cities.
examples.cn: 这条新铁路连接为两座城市之间提供了更快的路线。

examples.quote: Researchers are exploring alternative routes to reducing carbon emissions.
examples.cn: 研究人员正在探索减少碳排放的其他途径。

confusables.diff: change 泛指任何变化；shift 强调方向、位置或重心的转移。
transform 指彻底改变形态或性质；shift 多指程度有限的位置或态度转变。

examples.quote: Such a view would require a corresponding shift in the way US society today views fire, researchers say.
Public attention has shifted from economic growth to environmental protection.
examples.cn: 公众的注意力已从经济增长转向环境保护。

examples.quote: The company decided to shift its focus to overseas markets.
examples.cn: 该公司决定将重心转向海外市场。

confusables.diff: available 指可获得、可用的，affordable 强调价格在承受范围内。
reasonable 泛指合理、公道，affordable 特指价格能负担得起。

examples.quote: While the government's commitment to long-term funding may have changed, the very pressing need for more affordable housing is real and is not going away.
The government has pledged to build more affordable housing for young families in urban areas.
examples.cn: 政府承诺为城市地区的年轻家庭建造更多经济适用房。

examples.quote: Online courses have made higher education more affordable for students from low-income backgrounds.
examples.cn: 网络课程使低收入背景的学生更能负担得起高等教育。

confusables.diff: automated 是形容词，指“自动化的（系统/设备）”；automatically 是副词，修饰动作。
automatic 是形容词或名词，automatically 是对应的副词形式。
mechanically 强调“机械地、呆板地”，automatically 强调“自动地、无需人为干预”。

examples.quote: "We wanted to learn from private industry how to create new behaviors that happen automatically."
Once the account is verified, the system will automatically grant you access to the database.
examples.cn: 一旦账户通过验证，系统将自动授予你访问该数据库的权限。

examples.quote: Many people automatically assume that higher prices mean better quality, which is not always true.
examples.cn: 许多人会不假思索地认为价格越高品质越好，但事实并非总是如此。

confusables.diff: calendar 指日历或日程记录载体，schedule 指具体的时间安排表
calender 是轧光机，形近但词义完全不同

examples.quote: Once on the calendar, I protect this time like I would a doctor's appointment or important meeting", he writes.
The university publishes its academic calendar well before the semester begins.
examples.cn: 大学在学期开始前很早就公布了校历。

examples.quote: She marked the deadline on her calendar to avoid forgetting it.
examples.cn: 她把截止日期标在日历上以免忘记。

meanings.cn: 主张；声称；索赔；权利要求
声称；要求；索赔；夺去（生命）

confusables.diff: clams 意为蛤蜊，与 claims 拼写相近但读音不同。
claimant 指提出索赔或主张的人，是 claims 的同根名词。

examples.quote: The opposition claims primary school pupils doing at least two hours of sport a week have nearly halved.
The company claims that its new product can cut energy costs by half.
examples.cn: 该公司声称其新产品能将能源成本削减一半。

examples.quote: Several passengers filed claims for compensation after the flight was delayed.
examples.cn: 航班延误后，几名乘客提出了赔偿要求。

confusables.diff: code 是原形动词或名词，coding 是动名词/名词，指编码行为或过程。
encoding 强调按规则转换信息的过程，coding 更泛指编写代码或编码。

examples.quote: It's true that high-school coding classes aren't essential for learning computer science in college.
Learning coding at an early age can help children develop logical thinking.
examples.cn: 从小学习编程有助于培养孩子的逻辑思维。

examples.quote: The company has strict coding standards to ensure software quality.
examples.cn: 公司有严格的编码规范以保证软件质量。

meanings.cn: 通勤者；上下班往返的人

confusables.diff: commuters 指日常通勤者；commuter 是其单数形式，词义相同。

examples.quote: In one series of studies, researchers instructed Chicago-area commuters using public transportation to strike up a conversation with someone near them.
The new rail line is expected to save thousands of commuters an hour each day.
examples.cn: 这条新铁路预计每天能为数千名通勤者节省一小时。

examples.quote: Many commuters prefer cycling to driving as fuel prices continue to rise.
examples.cn: 随着油价持续上涨，许多通勤者更愿意骑自行车而不是开车。

confusables.diff: confidant 指可吐露秘密的知己（人），confidence 指信心或信任（抽象）。
assurance 侧重从容笃定或明确保证，confidence 更强调对自身能力的信念。
faith 多指无须证据的信念或信仰，confidence 常基于经验或判断。

examples.quote: But anyone who does not have to sell is keeping away, waiting for confidence to return.
Many graduates lack confidence in their ability to compete in a crowded job market.
examples.cn: 许多毕业生对自己在竞争激烈的就业市场中胜出的能力缺乏信心。

examples.quote: She told me in confidence that she was considering quitting her job.
examples.cn: 她私下告诉我她正考虑辞职。

confusables.diff: compare 侧重比较相似与不同，contrast 专指对照差异、形成反差。
contrary 意为相反的（事物），是形容词或名词；contrast 指对比或差异。

examples.quote: Cargo aircraft, in contrast, might be easier to reschedule, as might routine military flights.
In contrast to previous studies, the new research finds no link between the two factors.
examples.cn: 与以往研究不同，这项新研究未发现这两个因素之间存在关联。

examples.quote: The quiet countryside contrasts sharply with the noisy city where she grew up.
examples.cn: 宁静的乡村与她成长的喧嚣城市形成鲜明对比。

confusables.diff: colleagues 更正式，多指同一机构或专业领域的同事；coworkers 较口语化，泛指一起工作的人。
partners 强调合作或合伙关系，常涉及共同利益或股权；coworkers 仅指同处工作场所的人。

examples.quote: Those are all valid, but you need to take time to hear out your coworkers, too.
Building trust with coworkers can significantly improve team productivity and job satisfaction.
examples.cn: 与同事建立信任能显著提高团队生产力和工作满意度。

examples.quote: She often seeks feedback from her coworkers before finalizing important proposals.
examples.cn: 在最终确定重要提案前，她经常征求同事的意见。

confusables.diff: 动词，意为“使民主化”；democratic 是形容词，描述民主性质。
名词，指民主制度或国家；democratic 是形容词，修饰名词。
形容词/名词，指共和制的或共和党人；与 democratic 政治含义不同。

examples.quote: But as recently as in 1968, jury selection procedures conflicted with these democratic ideals.
The country has made significant progress in building a democratic society.
examples.cn: 该国在建设民主社会方面取得了显著进展。

examples.quote: Democratic elections are essential for ensuring that citizens' voices are heard.
examples.cn: 民主选举对于确保公民的声音被听到至关重要。

confusables.diff: recession 指经济活动的短期下滑，depression 指更严重、更持久的经济萧条。
despair 指完全绝望的情绪，depression 指持续的抑郁或沮丧状态。

examples.quote: Other reasons, according to the study, include personal fulfillment such as staying mentally fit, preventing boredom or avoiding depression.
The Great Depression of the 1930s forced millions of workers into unemployment and poverty.
examples.cn: 20世纪30年代的大萧条迫使数百万工人陷入失业和贫困。

examples.quote: Researchers found that regular exercise can help relieve symptoms of mild depression.
examples.cn: 研究人员发现，规律运动有助于缓解轻度抑郁症的症状。

confusables.diff: devices 是 device 的复数形式，单数指一个装置或手段，注意拼写中 c 在 s 前。
devise 是动词，意为“设计、发明”，与名词 devices 词性不同。
devise 为动词“策划、发明”，devices 为名词复数“装置、手段”。

examples.quote: Parents, he says, can get a lot out of using their devices to speak to a friend or get some work out of the way.
The company produces portable devices designed to monitor air quality in real time.
examples.cn: 该公司生产用于实时监测空气质量的便携式设备。

examples.quote: Teachers should limit students' use of digital devices during class hours.
examples.cn: 教师应限制学生在课堂时间内使用数字设备。

confusables.diff: somewhere 指不确定的某处，elsewhere 强调另外的地方（非此处）。
anywhere 指任何地方（多用于否定/疑问），elsewhere 指其他地方。

examples.quote: Having made their wealth and their reputations elsewhere, they presumably have enough independence to disagree with the chief executive's proposals.
If the item is not available locally, customers may be advised to look elsewhere.
examples.cn: 如果当地没有该商品，可能会建议顾客去别处看看。

examples.quote: Much of the research on this issue has been conducted elsewhere, with mixed results.
examples.cn: 关于这一问题的许多研究是在别处进行的，结果不一。

meanings.cn: 电子邮件；电子邮件系统

confusables.diff: mail 泛指信件或邮政系统，email 特指通过网络发送的电子信件。
message 泛指任何形式的信息，email 特指以电子邮件形式发送的信息。

examples.quote: "No college will expect that a student has a huge laundry list of extracurriculars that they have been passionately involved in each for an extended period of time," Rexford wrote in an email.
Please email me the report before Friday so that I can review it over the weekend.
examples.cn: 请在周五前把报告用电子邮件发给我，以便我周末审阅。

examples.quote: She received an email from the university confirming her acceptance of the program.
examples.cn: 她收到大学发来的电子邮件，确认她被该项目录取。

meanings.cn: entitle 的过去式和过去分词：使有资格；给……命名

confusables.diff: titled 仅指“有头衔的”或“有标题的”，不含有权要求之意
eligible 强调符合条件而具备资格，常与 for 连用；entitled 强调享有应得的权利

examples.quote: If "entitled" is the most common adjective, fairly or not, applied to millennials (those born between 1981 and 1995), the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious.
Employees are entitled to a paid holiday after one year of service.
examples.cn: 员工工作满一年后有权享受带薪假期。

examples.quote: He published an article entitled “The Future of Work.”
examples.cn: 他发表了一篇题为《工作的未来》的文章。

confusables.diff: epidemic 指一定地区内流行的疾病，pandemic 指跨国跨洲的大流行。
epidemic 是短期爆发流行，endemic 指某地区长期固有存在的。

examples.quote: The outbreak of swine flu that was first detected in Mexico was declared a global epidemic on June 11, 2009.
Health officials warned that the flu epidemic could spread rapidly in crowded cities.
examples.cn: 卫生官员警告说，流感疫情可能在拥挤的城市中迅速蔓延。

examples.quote: The epidemic of misinformation online has undermined public trust in science.
examples.cn: 网络虚假信息的泛滥削弱了公众对科学的信任。

confusables.diff: Europe 指欧洲（地理/政治实体），euro 指欧元（货币单位）。
European 是形容词“欧洲的”或名词“欧洲人”，euro 仅指货币。

examples.quote: It is stuck because the euro zone's dominant powers, France and Germany, agree on the need for greater harmonisation within the euro zone, but disagree about what to harmonise.
The value of the euro has fluctuated against the dollar in recent months.
examples.cn: 近几个月来，欧元兑美元汇率出现波动。

examples.quote: Some economists argue that the euro's strength may hurt exporters in the euro zone.
examples.cn: 一些经济学家认为，欧元走强可能损害欧元区出口商的利益。

confusables.diff: exemption 指被免除（义务、税费等），exception 指不符合一般规律的人或事。
exclusion 强调被排除在外，exception 强调作为特例不受一般规则约束。

examples.quote: Unified has produced an inflexible policy which mandates that with the exception of some advanced courses, homework may no longer count for more than 10% of a student's academic grade.
All students must take the exam, with the exception of those who have medical certificates.
examples.cn: 所有学生都必须参加考试，持医学证明者除外。

examples.quote: Few writers are as productive as he is; he is an exception rather than the rule.
examples.cn: 很少有作家像他那样多产，他是个例外而非常态。

confusables.diff: elasticity 多指物体受力后恢复原状的物理弹性，flexibility 更强调可调整、可变化的适应能力。
versatility 强调多才多艺、用途广泛，flexibility 强调可灵活变通、随机应变。

examples.quote: But Ashe and others argued that the "threatened" tag gave the federal government flexibility to try out new, potentially less confrontational conservation approaches.
Employers increasingly value flexibility, expecting staff to adapt quickly to changing demands.
examples.cn: 雇主越来越看重灵活性，期望员工能迅速适应不断变化的需求。

examples.quote: The new policy gives companies greater flexibility in how they allocate resources.
examples.cn: 新政策使公司在资源配置方式上拥有更大的灵活性。

meanings.cn: 使沮丧；挫败（frustrate 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: frustrating 形容事情令人沮丧，frustrated 形容人感到沮丧。
disappointed 指因期望落空而失望，frustrated 强调因受阻无法达成目标而懊恼。
discouraged 指失去信心和勇气，frustrated 侧重因受阻而烦躁。

examples.quote: Think about the times you felt tricked or frustrated by a membership or subscription that had a seamless sign-up process but was later difficult to cancel.
Many graduates feel frustrated when their efforts to land a job meet with repeated rejection.
examples.cn: 许多毕业生在求职努力屡遭拒绝时感到沮丧。

examples.quote: Frustrated by the slow progress of the negotiations, the two sides agreed to bring in a mediator.
examples.cn: 由于对谈判进展缓慢感到懊恼，双方同意引入调解人。

meanings.cn: 履行；实现（承诺、义务、目标等）

confusables.diff: achievement 侧重已取得的成就或成绩，fulfillment 侧重实现目标或需求后内心的满足感。
satisfaction 泛指需求被满足时的满意，fulfillment 更强调自我实现带来的深层满足。

examples.quote: If she hopes her new-found fortune will yield lasting feelings of fulfillment, she could do worse than read Happy Money by Elizabeth Dunn and Michael Norton.
Many employees value a sense of fulfillment at work more than a higher salary.
examples.cn: 许多员工在工作中看重成就感胜过更高的薪水。

examples.quote: The fulfillment of these ambitious goals depends on close international cooperation.
examples.cn: 这些宏伟目标的实现有赖于紧密的国际合作。

meanings.cn: 授予；同意；承认（grant 的第三人称单数）

confusables.diff: subsidy 多指政府为降低物价或扶持行业提供的补贴，grant 多指为特定项目或研究提供的拨款。
allowance 常指定期发放的津贴或零用钱，grant 通常是一次性或项目性的资助。

examples.quote: The housing sector needs to accept that we are very unlikely to ever return to the era of large-scale public grants.
The university receives federal grants to support its basic research programs.
examples.cn: 这所大学获得联邦拨款以支持其基础研究项目。

examples.quote: The government granted temporary permits to workers affected by the new policy.
examples.cn: 政府向受新政策影响的工人发放了临时许可证。

confusables.diff: 分写形式常作泛指概念，合写healthcare多作定语或指行业体系。
medical care侧重医生提供的诊疗服务，healthcare涵盖预防、保健等整个体系。

examples.quote: As demand for healthcare continues to grow, pressures on the workforce—which is already near breaking point—will only become more acute.
The government is under pressure to improve healthcare in rural areas.
examples.cn: 政府面临改善农村地区医疗保健的压力。

examples.quote: Rising healthcare costs have become a major concern for ordinary families.
examples.cn: 不断上涨的医疗费用已成为普通家庭的一大忧虑。

meanings.cn: 历史上发生过的，历史性的

confusables.diff: historic 强调有重大历史意义的；historical 指与历史有关或历史上存在的。
historically 是副词，表示历史上地；historical 是形容词。

examples.quote: Suddenly, Britain looks to have fallen out with its favorite historical form.
The novel is set against a historical background of social upheaval.
examples.cn: 这部小说以社会动荡的历史背景为背景。

examples.quote: Historical evidence suggests that the city was abandoned in the 5th century.
examples.cn: 历史证据表明这座城市在5世纪被废弃。

confusables.diff: imaginary 是形容词，指“想象中的、虚构的”；imagination 是名词，指想象的能力。
imaginative 是形容词，指“富有想象力的”；imagination 是名词，指想象力本身。
image 是名词，指“形象、图像”；imagination 指心理上创造形象的能力。

phrases.cn: 激发某人的想象；引起某人的兴趣

examples.quote: Looking around, I despaired at the singular lack of imagination about girls' lives and interests.
Children who read widely tend to develop a richer imagination than those who spend hours in front of screens.
examples.cn: 与长时间面对屏幕的孩子相比，广泛阅读的孩子往往能培养出更丰富的想象力。

examples.quote: The architect's design went far beyond anything the committee had expected, showing remarkable imagination.
examples.cn: 这位建筑师的设计远远超出委员会的预期，展现出非凡的想象力。

confusables.diff: instant 强调瞬间完成、几乎无时间间隔，immediate 更通用，可指立即或直接关系
imminent 指（坏事）即将发生，immediate 指此刻立即或直接

examples.quote: 13 electronic payments are immediate, they eliminate the float for the consumer.
The government took immediate action to curb the spread of the virus.
examples.cn: 政府立即采取行动遏制病毒传播。

examples.quote: The immediate cause of the accident remains unclear to investigators.
examples.cn: 事故的直接原因对调查人员来说仍不清楚。

confusables.diff: emigrant 指移出本国的人，immigrant 指移入他国定居的人，方向相反。
migrant 泛指迁徙者（含国内迁移或候鸟），immigrant 特指跨国迁入并定居者。

examples.quote: A century ago, the immigrants from across the Atlantic included settlers and sojourners.
Many immigrants struggle to adapt to the local culture while preserving their own traditions.
examples.cn: 许多移民在努力适应当地文化的同时，也设法保留自己的传统。

examples.quote: The government has tightened its policy on immigrants seeking permanent residency.
examples.cn: 政府收紧了针对寻求永久居留权的移民的政策。

confusables.diff: improve 是动词，表示“改进”；improvement 是名词，表示“改进”这一行为或结果。
advancement 侧重地位、等级或进程的推进；improvement 侧重质量、状况的变好。

examples.quote: When there is rapid improvement in the price and performance of technology, jobs that were once thought to be immune from automation suddenly become threatened.
The report suggests that further improvements in public transport are necessary to reduce congestion.
examples.cn: 报告指出，为缓解拥堵，公共交通需要进一步改善。

examples.quote: There is still considerable room for improvement in the accuracy of the data.
examples.cn: 数据的准确性仍有相当大的提升空间。

meanings.cn: 不可避免的；必然发生的
必然发生的事（常与 the 连用）

confusables.diff: 语义最接近，但更强调主观上无法回避，inevitable 更侧重客观规律上的必然性。
同源副词，意为“不可避免地”，词性不同，修饰动词或全句而非名词。

examples.quote: It is hard to shove for attention among multibillion-pound infrastructure projects, so it is inevitable that the attention is focused elsewhere.
Some conflict is inevitable when a company grows as fast as this one has.
examples.cn: 当一家公司以如此速度扩张时，一些冲突是不可避免的。

examples.quote: Rather than resist the inevitable shift to digital services, the bank chose to lead it.
examples.cn: 这家银行没有抵制向数字服务转型这一必然趋势，而是选择引领它。

meanings.cn: 主动性；积极性；首创精神

confusables.diff: initiation 指“开始、入门仪式”，而 initiative 指“主动性、倡议”。
innovation 侧重“创新的事物或方法”，initiative 侧重“主动采取的行动或倡议”。

examples.quote: Hagel says we have designed jobs in the U.S. that tend to be "tightly scripted" and "highly standardized" ones that leave no room for "individual initiative or creativity".
Employers increasingly value graduates who can take the initiative and solve problems independently.
examples.cn: 雇主越来越看重能够主动采取行动并独立解决问题的毕业生。

examples.quote: The government launched a new initiative aimed at reducing plastic waste in coastal cities.
examples.cn: 政府发起了一项旨在减少沿海城市塑料垃圾的新倡议。

meanings.cn: 有创新精神的，善于创新的

confusables.diff: inventive 强调有发明创造的才能，innovative 侧重带来新方法或新事物。
novel 强调新颖、前所未有，innovative 强调具有创新性和实用改进。

examples.quote: To Microsoft's critics, the fates of Wunderlist and Sunrise are examples of a remorseless drive by Big Tech to chew up any innovative companies that lie in their path.
The company owes its success to an innovative approach to product design.
examples.cn: 这家公司的成功归功于其产品设计上的创新方法。

examples.quote: Small firms are often more innovative than large corporations.
examples.cn: 小公司往往比大企业更具创新精神。

confusables.diff: intension 指逻辑上的内涵，与表示强度的 intensity 形近但义异。
density 侧重密度或稠密程度，intensity 侧重力量、感情或活动的强烈程度。

examples.quote: Increase time, distance, and intensity gradually.
The intensity of the debate surprised even the most experienced observers.
examples.cn: 这场辩论的激烈程度连最有经验的观察者都感到惊讶。

examples.quote: Scientists measured the intensity of light at different distances from the source.
examples.cn: 科学家测量了距光源不同距离处的光强度。

confusables.diff: 同义，但为单数形式，指单次互动或抽象概念
形近，意为“交叉路口；交集”，与“互动”无关

phrases.cn: A 与 B 之间的相互作用

examples.quote: "The human systems and the landscapes we live on are linked, and the interactions go both ways," he says.
Researchers found that frequent social interactions can significantly reduce stress among older adults.
examples.cn: 研究者发现，频繁的社交互动能显著减轻老年人的压力。

examples.quote: The study examines the complex interactions between genes and environment in shaping behavior.
examples.cn: 该研究考察基因与环境在塑造行为方面的复杂相互作用。

meanings.cn: 投资；投入（invest 的过去式及过去分词）

confusables.diff: invested 是动词过去式/形容词，investment 是名词，指投资行为或投资额。
devoted 强调情感上的忠诚与献身，invested 强调时间、金钱或精力的投入。

examples.quote: Much more needs to be invested in communities and primary care to reduce our reliance on hospitals.
She has invested considerable time and effort in improving her English writing skills.
examples.cn: 她投入了大量时间和精力来提高英语写作能力。

examples.quote: Investors who invested heavily in the housing market suffered serious losses.
examples.cn: 在房地产市场大量投资的投资者遭受了严重损失。

confusables.diff: 强调主观上不愿意，而 involuntary 强调非出于本意或不受意志控制。
指机械般无意识地发生，involuntary 更强调违背或不受意志支配。

examples.quote: An increase in involuntary part-time work is evidence of weakness in the labor market and it means that many people will be having a very hard time making ends meet.
Blinking is an involuntary response that protects the eyes from harm.
examples.cn: 眨眼是一种保护眼睛免受伤害的无意识反应。

examples.quote: Many workers faced involuntary unemployment when the factory closed down.
examples.cn: 工厂倒闭后，许多工人面临非自愿失业。

confusables.diff: include 仅表示包含在内，involve 强调作为必要部分或必然结果。
implicate 常指牵连进罪行或错误，involve 为中性词，仅指使参与。

examples.quote: Fantasies of great wealth often involve visions of fancy cars and extravagant homes.
The new policy is likely to involve considerable changes in the way companies report their earnings.
examples.cn: 新政策很可能涉及公司在报告收益方式上的重大变化。

examples.quote: Any project of this scale inevitably involves a certain degree of risk.
examples.cn: 任何这种规模的项目都不可避免地包含一定程度的风险。

meanings.cn: 启动，发起（launch 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: lunched 意为“吃了午饭”，与 launched 仅一字母之差，词义完全不同。
started 泛指数开始某事物，launched 强调正式、大规模地推出或发起。

examples.quote: America's Federal Trade Commission launched a round of talks about how to save newspapers.
The company launched a new advertising campaign to attract younger customers.
examples.cn: 该公司发起了一场新的广告活动以吸引年轻顾客。
