examples.quote: The rapid expansion of the suburbs has put pressure on local infrastructure.
examples.cn: 郊区的快速扩张给当地基础设施带来了压力。

meanings.cn: 策略；手段；战术（tactic 的复数形式）

confusables.diff: strategy 指全局性战略，tactics 指实现战略的具体战术或手段。
tact 指交际中的得体、圆通，tactics 指为达目的的战术手段。

examples.quote: As this new science of habit has emerged, controversies have erupted when the tactics have been used to sell questionable beauty creams or unhealthy foods.
The company changed its marketing tactics after sales fell sharply last year.
examples.cn: 去年销量大幅下滑后，公司改变了营销策略。

examples.quote: Critics accused the government of using delay tactics to avoid the issue.
examples.cn: 批评者指责政府采用拖延战术来回避这一问题。

meanings.cn: teach 的过去式和过去分词：教，讲授；教导

confusables.diff: taut 意为“拉紧的、紧张的”，与 taught 发音相同但拼写和词义不同
taught 是过去式/过去分词，teach 是原形，注意时态区别

examples.quote: Professor Dinesh Bhugra, president of the Royal College of Psychiatrists, said: "If children are taught about the impact that food has on their growth, and that some things can harm, at least information is available up front."
Students are taught to question assumptions rather than accept them uncritically.
examples.cn: 学生们被教导要质疑各种假设，而不是不加批判地接受它们。

examples.quote: The experience taught him that patience matters more than talent.
examples.cn: 这段经历让他明白，耐心比天赋更重要。

meanings.cn: 青少年的，十几岁的（13至19岁）

confusables.diff: teenager 是名词指青少年本人，teenage 是形容词修饰年龄或相关事物。
youthful 泛指年轻有活力，可指各年龄段；teenage 特指13至19岁。

examples.quote: At the same time, once cheerful and compliant children become rebellious teenage risk-takers.
Many parents worry that excessive screen time may harm their teenage children's mental health.
examples.cn: 许多家长担心过多的屏幕时间可能损害他们青少年子女的心理健康。

examples.quote: The survey found that teenage boys spend more time playing video games than girls do.
examples.cn: 调查发现十几岁的男孩比女孩花更多时间玩电子游戏。

meanings.cn: 很有诱惑力的东西；引起诱惑的事物

confusables.diff: attraction 指事物本身具有的吸引力，temptation 侧重使人违背理智去追求或占有的诱惑。
tempting 是形容词，意为“诱人的”；temptation 是名词，指诱惑本身。

examples.quote: We still have the imaginative capacity to rise above temptation and reverse the high-speed trend.
Consumers often yield to the temptation to buy things they do not really need.
examples.cn: 消费者常常屈服于诱惑，去买自己并不真正需要的东西。

examples.quote: The temptation to take shortcuts in research must be resisted at all costs.
examples.cn: 无论如何都必须抵制在研究上走捷径的诱惑。

confusables.diff: tenths 意为“十分之一”，与 tens 形近但含义不同。
tense 可作形容词“紧张的”或名词“时态”，与 tens 拼写相近。

examples.quote: The average supermarket, according to the Food Marketing Institute, carries some 44,000 different items, and many carry tens of thousands more.
The number of applicants rose by tens of thousands last year.
examples.cn: 去年申请人数增加了数万。

examples.quote: He learned to code in his early tens.
examples.cn: 他十几岁出头就学会了编程。

meanings.cn: 棘手的，麻烦的，难以解决的

confusables.diff: tricky 强调需要技巧、容易出差错，thorny 多指问题本身敏感难办。
prickly 指物体表面有刺或人易怒，thorny 多用于抽象问题的棘手。

examples.quote: At the same time, the policy addresses none of the truly thorny questions about homework.
The government has yet to tackle the thorny issue of pension reform.
examples.cn: 政府尚未着手解决养老金改革这一棘手问题。

examples.quote: Negotiators avoided the thorny question of who should bear the costs.
examples.cn: 谈判者回避了应由谁承担费用这一难题。

confusables.diff: timetable 多指课程表、列车时刻表等具体安排表，timeline 侧重事件先后顺序或进度时间线。
schedule 强调按计划排定的时间安排，timeline 强调从始到终的时间脉络与节点。

examples.quote: Your senior colleague outlines a project timeline you believe is unrealistic.
The project manager presented a detailed timeline for the next six months.
examples.cn: 项目经理展示了未来六个月的详细时间表。

examples.quote: Historians constructed a timeline of events leading up to the war.
examples.cn: 历史学家梳理了导致这场战争的各事件时间线。

meanings.cn: 学步的儿童，蹒跚学步的孩子（通常指1至3岁）

confusables.diff: infant 指婴儿（尤指未满周岁的），toddler 指已会走路的一至三岁幼儿。
child 是泛指儿童，年龄范围更广；toddler 特指刚学会走路的幼儿。

examples.quote: It was only after "toddler" became a common shoppers' term that it evolved into a broadly accepted developmental stage.
Parents often find it exhausting to keep up with an energetic toddler.
examples.cn: 父母常常觉得跟上精力充沛的幼儿让人筋疲力尽。

examples.quote: The study suggests that screen time may affect a toddler's language development.
examples.cn: 该研究表明，看屏幕的时间可能会影响幼儿的语言发展。

confusables.diff: tolerable 意为“可忍受的、尚可的”，tolerant 指人“宽容的”或“有耐受力的”。
tolerance 是名词“宽容、耐受力”，tolerant 是对应形容词。

examples.quote: In many respects, the U.S. was more socially tolerant entering this recession than at any time in its history, and a variety of national polls on social conflict since then have shown mixed results.
A tolerant society benefits from open dialogue among people with different views.
examples.cn: 一个宽容的社会受益于持不同观点的人之间的公开对话。

examples.quote: These crops are tolerant of poor soil and require little water.
examples.cn: 这些作物耐贫瘠土壤，且需水量很少。

meanings.cn: 使有某种色调；使（身体）强健

confusables.diff: tone 指说话的语气或声音的调子，intonation 特指语调的升降模式。
tone 泛指音调或色调，tonality 指音乐中的调性或色调的整体效果。

examples.quote: That might seem rather an obscure point, but it sets the tone for an exhibition that contains a lot of black-and-white photographs and relatively few natural objects.
The manager’s tone suggested that further discussion would be pointless.
examples.cn: 经理的语气暗示进一步讨论毫无意义。

examples.quote: Regular exercise can tone up your muscles and improve your overall health.
examples.cn: 定期锻炼能使肌肉强健并改善整体健康。

meanings.cn: 小路，小径；（拖曳的）痕迹，踪迹

confusables.diff: track 指车辆行驶的轨道或较宽的路径，trail 多指乡间人踩出的小径
trace 强调遗留的细微痕迹，trail 强调一路留下的连续踪迹

examples.quote: The Wickquasgeck Trail is an example of a historical desire path, created by Native Americans to cross the forests of Manhattan and move between settlements quickly.
The hikers followed a narrow trail through the forest to the lake.
examples.cn: 徒步者沿着穿过森林的狭窄小径来到湖边。

examples.quote: Despite his early lead, he began to trail behind in the final lap.
examples.cn: 尽管他一开始领先，但在最后一圈开始落后。

confusables.diff: transport 侧重运输行为或运输系统，英式英语中更常用；transportation 更强调运输业或运输工具，美式英语常用。
transmission 指信息、信号或疾病的传播传递；transportation 指人或货物的空间位移。

examples.quote: New research on transportation biofuels is already under way.
The city has invested heavily in public transportation to reduce traffic congestion and air pollution.
examples.cn: 该市大力投资公共交通，以减少交通拥堵和空气污染。

examples.quote: Cheap transportation costs have enabled companies to distribute goods across the country efficiently.
examples.cn: 低廉的运输成本使公司能够高效地在全国范围内配送货物。

confusables.diff: eventually 强调经过一系列过程后的结果，ultimately 更强调最终的根本结论或归宿。
finally 常指次序上的最后一点或历经曲折后终于，ultimately 更书面、更强调根本性。

examples.quote: And ultimately, it is likely to reshape our politics, our culture, and the character of our society for years.
The success of the policy will ultimately depend on whether the public is willing to accept short-term costs.
examples.cn: 该政策的成败最终将取决于公众是否愿意接受短期代价。

examples.quote: What ultimately matters is not how much we know but how well we can use what we know.
examples.cn: 归根结底重要的不是我们知识多少，而是我们能否善用所知。

meanings.cn: 不清楚的；不清楚的；不明确的

confusables.diff: ambiguous 强调可有两种以上解释而含糊，unclear 仅指信息不明了或不确定。
vague 指表达或思想模糊、不具体，unclear 常指事实、原因等不明确。

examples.quote: For example, it is unclear whether the sequencing of a whole genome violates the patents of individual genes within it.
It remains unclear whether the new policy will benefit small businesses.
examples.cn: 新政策是否会使小企业受益仍不清楚。

examples.quote: The instructions were so unclear that many users gave up.
examples.cn: 说明太不清楚，许多用户放弃了。

confusables.diff: rare 强调稀有珍贵，uncommon 仅指不常发生，语气更中性
unusual 侧重与常态不同，uncommon 侧重出现频率低

phrases.en: uncommon for sb to do sth

examples.quote: Experts say it is tougher to distinguish oneself in a school-affiliated extracurricular activity that is common among high school students than it is to stand out while doing an uncommon activity.
It is not uncommon for graduates to change careers several times.
examples.cn: 毕业生多次转行并不罕见。

examples.quote: The species is uncommon in this region and rarely seen by locals.
examples.cn: 该物种在这一地区并不常见，当地人很少见到。

confusables.diff: unconventional 强调有意背离常规做法，unusual 仅指不常见、少见。
nontraditional 侧重不属于传统范畴，unconventional 更强调主动打破常规、标新立异。

phrases.cn: 非主流观点；反常规的见解

examples.quote: Joseph Adegboyega-Edun, a Maryland high school guidance counselor, says unconventional extracurricular activities can help students impress college admissions offices, assuming they demonstrated serious commitment.
Her unconventional approach to problem-solving often yields surprising results.
examples.cn: 她解决问题的非传统方法常常带来出人意料的结果。

examples.quote: The company owes much of its success to its unconventional marketing strategies.
examples.cn: 这家公司的成功很大程度上归功于其非传统的营销策略。

meanings.cn: 削价竞争；以低于（竞争对手）的价格销售

confusables.diff: undermine 侧重逐渐削弱信心或地位，undercut 侧重以低价抢生意或直接破坏效果。
undersell 强调以低于应有价格出售，undercut 常指针对竞争对手压价。

phrases.cn: 以低价与竞争者抢生意

examples.quote: "An economy of tech millionaires or billionaires and gig workers, with middle-income jobs undercut by automation, will not be politically sustainable."
Online retailers can undercut traditional stores by keeping overheads low.
examples.cn: 网络零售商可以通过保持低运营成本以低于传统商店的价格销售。

examples.quote: Constant criticism may undercut employees' confidence and motivation.
examples.cn: 不断的批评可能削弱员工的信心和积极性。

confusables.diff: graduate 指已获学位的毕业生或研究生，undergraduate 指尚未获学位的在读本科生。
postgraduate 指本科毕业后的研究生，undergraduate 指本科阶段学生。

examples.quote: Experts say demonstrating talent in at least one extracurricular activity can help in the college admissions process, especially at top-tier undergraduate institutions.
Many undergraduates take on part-time jobs to ease the financial burden on their families.
examples.cn: 许多本科生做兼职以减轻家庭的经济负担。

examples.quote: The university offers undergraduates a wide range of research opportunities.
examples.cn: 这所大学为本科生提供广泛的研究机会。

meanings.cn: understand 的过去式和过去分词：理解；明白；懂得
（作定语，置于名词后或用于固定表达）已达成谅解的；被理解的

confusables.diff: understandable 是形容词“可理解的”，而 understood 是动词过去分词或表“已取得共识的”形容词。
understate 意为“轻描淡写、少报”，与 understand 词形相近但意义完全不同。

phrases.cn: 使自己的意思被理解；表达清楚

examples.quote: While it probably wasn't apparent at the time, much of this work is permeated by a spirit of romantic escapism that the likes of Wordsworth would have readily understood.
He spoke slowly and clearly so that his instructions could be fully understood by everyone present.
examples.cn: 他讲得缓慢而清晰，以便在场的每个人都能完全理解他的指示。

examples.quote: Although the terms had been agreed upon, the precise scope of the agreement was never clearly understood.
examples.cn: 尽管条款已经商定，但协议的确切范围从未被清楚地理解。

confusables.diff: 强调不知不觉、未意识到，而 unintentionally 侧重并非出于本意
多指偶然、意外发生，unintentionally 强调行为者无主观故意

examples.quote: Something that should be simple and transparent can be complicated, intentionally or unintentionally, in ways that impair consumer choice.
The company unintentionally violated privacy rules by sharing user data with third parties.
examples.cn: 该公司因向第三方分享用户数据而无意中违反了隐私规定。

examples.quote: His remarks were interpreted as criticism, though he had spoken unintentionally.
examples.cn: 他的话被理解为批评，尽管他并非有意如此。

meanings.cn: 未知的；不详的；不出名的

confusables.diff: unbeknown 多作表语或后接 to sb，表示“不为某人所知”，不直接修饰名词。
anonymous 强调身份不明或不署名，常修饰作者、来信；unknown 泛指未知或不熟悉。

phrases.cn: 未知数；难以预测的人或事物

examples.quote: Then, unknown to the students, the researchers studied their anonymized meal-card purchases for that semester—nearly 14,000 receipts for almost 500 students.
The virus was previously unknown to scientists and spread rapidly across the region.
examples.cn: 这种病毒此前不为科学家所知，并迅速在该地区传播。

examples.quote: For reasons still unknown, the company abandoned the project halfway through.
examples.cn: 出于仍不清楚的原因，公司中途放弃了这个项目。

meanings.cn: 被释放的； unleashed 放纵的，不受约束的
释放；发动（unleash 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: released 强调从拘禁或束缚中放出，unleashed 常含突然释放强大力量或情绪的意味。
unleaded 指无铅的（燃油），与 unleashed 拼写相近但词义无关。

examples.quote: Intuition's special powers are unleashed only in certain circumstances.
The new policy unleashed a wave of innovation across the industry.
examples.cn: 新政策在整个行业引发了一波创新浪潮。

examples.quote: Once unleashed, the forces of globalization proved hard to control.
examples.cn: 全球化力量一旦释放，便难以控制。

meanings.cn: 令人不快的；使人不舒服的

confusables.diff: unpleased 表示“不满意的”，指人的感受；unpleasant 指事物令人不快。
displeasing 强调使人不高兴，较正式；unpleasant 更通用，可指感官上的不适。

examples.quote: The manager's unpleasant remarks left the whole team feeling demoralized.
examples.cn: 经理那些令人不快的话让整个团队士气低落。

examples.quote: Living near the factory exposed residents to unpleasant noise throughout the night.
examples.cn: 住在工厂附近使居民整夜饱受恼人的噪音之苦。

meanings.cn: 退休后重返职场的人；复出工作的退休者

confusables.diff: retirees 指已退休者，unretirees 特指退休后又重新工作的人。
rehires 指被重新雇用的员工，不限于退休者；unretirees 强调退休后复出。

phrases.cn: 越来越多的退休返岗者

examples.quote: Even more surprising is that more than half of "unretirees"—those who plan to work in retirement or went back to work after retiring—said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down, the survey showed.
A growing number of unretirees are returning to work, driven by inflation and a desire to stay active.
examples.cn: 受通货膨胀和保持活力的愿望驱使，越来越多的退休者重返工作岗位。

examples.quote: Employers increasingly value unretirees for their experience and reliability.
examples.cn: 雇主越来越看重退休返岗者的经验和可靠性。

confusables.diff: unsafe 强调客观危险，insecure 侧重缺乏保障或心理不安全感。
risky 指有风险但未必危险，unsafe 指明确不安全、可能造成伤害。

examples.quote: One of the biggest challenges in keeping unsafe aging drivers off the road is convincing them that it's time to turn over the keys.
The report warns that many buildings in the area remain unsafe after the earthquake.
examples.cn: 报告警告说，地震后该地区许多建筑仍不安全。

examples.quote: Critics argue that the new policy leaves young workers in an unsafe position.
examples.cn: 批评者认为新政策使年轻工人处于不安全的境地。

confusables.diff: updates 指信息或软件的更新，upgrades 强调性能或等级的提升。
upheavals 指剧变、动荡，与 upgrades 的“升级改进”含义不同。

examples.quote: Frequent flyers often receive free upgrades to business class on long-haul flights.
examples.cn: 常旅客在长途航班上常获得免费升舱至商务舱的待遇。

examples.quote: The company postponed several system upgrades until the busy season ended.
examples.cn: 公司将几项系统升级推迟到旺季结束后进行。

meanings.cn: （气流）上洗，向上洗流；气流上洗现象

confusables.diff: downwash 指气流下洗，方向与 upwash 相反
backwash 指（船桨、波浪的）回流或尾流，与气流上洗无关

examples.quote: The air flowing over a bird's wings curls upwards behind the wingtips, a phenomenon known as upwash.
The engineers measured the upwash generated by the wing, which affects the lift of the following aircraft.
examples.cn: 工程师们测量了机翼产生的上洗气流，它会影响后方飞机的升力。

examples.quote: An increase in upwash can reduce drag on the tail plane under certain flight conditions.
examples.cn: 在某些飞行条件下，上洗气流的增强可以减小尾翼的阻力。

confusables.diff: variable 强调易变、可变的；various 强调多种多样的。
variable 是形容词；fluctuate 是动词，指波动、起伏。

examples.quote: Psychologist Nina Strohminger at the University of Pennsylvania, who was not involved in the study, says she wants the effect to be real but cannot rule out some unknown confounding variable.
The study found that sleep quality is highly variable among college students.
examples.cn: 研究发现，大学生的睡眠质量差异很大。

examples.quote: Researchers must control every variable that could affect the experiment's outcome.
examples.cn: 研究人员必须控制可能影响实验结果的每一个变量。

confusables.diff: vocal 强调发声、直抒己见，verbal 强调用言辞表达而非书面。
oral 专指口头（与书面相对），verbal 还可指词语本身或动词的。

examples.quote: "Parents don't have to be exquisitely present at all times, but there needs to be a balance and parents need to be responsive and sensitive to a child's verbal or nonverbal expressions of an emotional need," says Radesky.
Employers should not rely solely on verbal promises when drafting a contract.
examples.cn: 雇主在起草合同时不应只依赖口头承诺。

examples.quote: A significant part of the message is conveyed through non-verbal cues.
examples.cn: 信息中有相当一部分是通过非言语线索传达的。

confusables.diff: fragility 强调物体易碎的物理特性，vulnerability 更泛指易受攻击或伤害的状态。
weakness 指力量或能力上的不足，vulnerability 侧重易受外部伤害的暴露性。

examples.quote: Among other things, she says, all cities should create a vulnerability map to help focus responses on the populations most at risk.
The report highlights the vulnerability of coastal cities to rising sea levels.
examples.cn: 该报告强调了沿海城市面对海平面上升的脆弱性。

examples.quote: Researchers found a vulnerability in the software that could expose users' data.
examples.cn: 研究人员发现该软件存在一个可能泄露用户数据的漏洞。

meanings.cn: 易受攻击的；易受指责的

confusables.diff: fragile 强调物体易碎或身体虚弱，vulnerable 强调易受伤害或攻击的外部风险。
susceptible 多指易受疾病或影响感染，常与 to 连用；vulnerable 还含情感与安全上的脆弱。

examples.quote: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable.
Children and the elderly are especially vulnerable to extreme heat.
examples.cn: 儿童和老人尤其容易受到极端高温的伤害。

examples.quote: Without proper regulation, the financial system remains vulnerable to sudden shocks.
examples.cn: 缺乏适当监管，金融体系仍易受突发冲击的影响。

meanings.cn: （精神或文化上的）荒芜领域，贫乏状态

confusables.diff: wilderness 指未经开垦的自然荒野，强调原始状态；wasteland 强调贫瘠荒废、无法利用。
desert 指干旱少雨的沙漠，是地理概念；wasteland 泛指荒废贫瘠之地，不限于气候原因。

examples.quote: Years of careless mining have turned the valley into a barren wasteland.
examples.cn: 多年粗放开采已使这个山谷变成一片贫瘠的荒原。

examples.quote: Without adequate funding, the region risks becoming a cultural wasteland.
examples.cn: 若缺乏足够资金，该地区有沦为文化荒漠的风险。

meanings.cn: 产生，带来（收益、结果等）；屈服，让步

confusables.diff: submit 强调顺从、提交，多用于人或申请；yield 强调在压力下让步或产出收益。
surrender 指投降、放弃，语气更强；yield 让步意味较弱，还可表产出。

examples.quote: If she hopes her new-found fortune will yield lasting feelings of fulfillment, she could do worse than read Happy Money by Elizabeth Dunn and Michael Norton.
The new farming techniques have yielded a substantial increase in crop production.
examples.cn: 新的耕作技术使农作物产量大幅提高。

examples.quote: Despite mounting pressure, the committee refused to yield to demands for a public apology.
examples.cn: 尽管压力越来越大，委员会仍拒绝屈从于公开道歉的要求。

confusables.diff: acronym 仅指由首字母组成的缩略词，而 abbreviation 泛指任何形式的缩短形式。
abridgment 指书籍等的删节本，abbreviation 指词语的缩写形式。

examples.quote: The abbreviation "e.g." is commonly used in academic writing to introduce examples.
examples.cn: 缩写“e.g.”在学术写作中常用来引出例子。

examples.quote: Many students find it hard to remember the abbreviation of long chemical terms.
examples.cn: 许多学生觉得很难记住冗长化学术语的缩写。

confusables.diff: academic 是形容词或名词（学者、大学教师），academically 是副词，修饰动词或形容词。
形近词 academic 指“学术的”，而 academically 强调“在学业/学术方面”的方式。

examples.quote: Schools in the family of vocational education "have that stereotype…that it's for kids who can't make it academically," he says.
Students who are academically strong often find it easier to adapt to the rigorous demands of graduate study.
examples.cn: 学业优秀的学生往往更容易适应研究生学习的严格要求。

examples.quote: The program is designed to support children who struggle academically but show great potential in other areas.
examples.cn: 该项目旨在帮助那些学业上有困难但在其他方面潜力巨大的孩子。

confusables.diff: accelerator是名词，指加速器或油门踏板；acceleration指加速过程或加速度。
accession意为就职、加入或增加（藏品）；acceleration强调速度的提升。

examples.quote: But there's been an acceleration.
The acceleration of technological change has transformed the way we work and communicate.
examples.cn: 技术变革的加速已经改变了我们工作和交流的方式。

examples.quote: Economists warn that the acceleration of inflation could prompt the central bank to raise interest rates.
examples.cn: 经济学家警告，通胀的加速可能促使央行加息。

meanings.cn: 适应（气候、环境）； acclimatization 的变体
（对高原、高温等新条件的）服习，驯化

confusables.diff: 英式拼写更常用 acclimatization，acclimation 多用于美式英语，二者同义。
adaptation 泛指任何适应或改编，acclimation 特指生物对气候、海拔等自然条件的逐步生理适应。
accommodation 指住宿或调节妥协，与 acclimation 拼写相近但词义无关。

examples.quote: Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders.
Proper acclimation to high altitude can reduce the risk of acute mountain sickness.
examples.cn: 对高海拔的良好适应可以降低急性高山症的风险。

examples.quote: The athletes underwent a two-week heat acclimation program before the competition.
examples.cn: 运动员在比赛前进行了为期两周的热适应训练。

meanings.cn: 一致，符合；依照，根据（常用于 in accordance with）

confusables.diff: accord 意为一致、协议或给予，而 accordance 仅用于短语 in accordance with 表示依照。
according 是副词，常用于 according to 表示根据，而 accordance 是名词，用于 in accordance with。

examples.quote: There could be liability and penalties if a physician does not act in accordance with state laws on reporting and confidentiality," she counseled.
All employees must act in accordance with the company’s safety regulations.
examples.cn: 所有员工必须按照公司的安全规定行事。

examples.quote: The research was conducted in accordance with ethical guidelines.
examples.cn: 该研究是按照伦理准则进行的。

meanings.cn: 可完成的；可达到的；可实现的

confusables.diff: 侧重经努力可达到（目标、标准），语义较正式；achievable 更强调任务或计划可被成功完成。
指方案、计划在现实条件下可行；achievable 侧重结果能否被达成。

examples.quote: Schwitzgebel suspects the greatest impact came from social influence—classmates or teaching assistants leading the discussions may have shared their own vegetarianism, showing it as achievable or more common.
Setting achievable goals helps students maintain motivation throughout the long preparation period.
examples.cn: 设定可实现的目标有助于学生在漫长的备考期保持动力。

examples.quote: The plan is ambitious but achievable if the whole team works together.
examples.cn: 这项计划雄心勃勃，但只要全队齐心协力是可以实现的。

meanings.cn: 面积（以英亩计）；耕地面积

confusables.diff: acrid 意为“辛辣的、刺鼻的”，与 acreage 拼写相近但词义无关。
acre 是面积单位“英亩”，acreage 指以英亩计算的总面积。

examples.quote: That's only a small share of the total acreage that could benefit, about half a million acres in all, so it will be vital to prioritize areas at greatest risk of fire or drought.
The company owns a large acreage of farmland in the Midwest.
examples.cn: 该公司在中西部拥有大片农田。

examples.quote: Reduced acreage has driven up the price of staple crops.
examples.cn: 耕地面积减少推高了大宗作物的价格。

confusables.diff: adaptation 指适应或改编的过程、结果，adaptability 强调具备适应的能力。
flexibility 侧重可弯曲或可变更的弹性，adaptability 强调对新环境的适应能力。

examples.quote: Animal desire paths, such as ducks forging trails through frozen ponds or dogs carving direct routes in gardens, highlight the adaptability of these trails in both human and animal experiences.
Employers increasingly value adaptability, since workers must cope with rapidly changing technologies.
examples.cn: 雇主越来越看重适应能力，因为员工必须应对快速变化的技术。

examples.quote: The adaptability of the species enabled it to survive in a wide range of environments.
examples.cn: 该物种的适应能力使它在多种环境中得以存活。

meanings.cn: 形容词的；不独立的，辅助的

confusables.diff: adverb 是副词，修饰动词或形容词；adjective 是形容词，修饰名词。
adjunct 指附属物或附加成分；adjective 主要指形容词这一词类。

examples.quote: If "entitled" is the most common adjective, fairly or not, applied to millennials (those born between 1981 and 1995), the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious.
In English, an adjective usually precedes the noun it modifies, which can be difficult for some learners.
examples.cn: 在英语中，形容词通常位于其所修饰的名词之前，这对某些学习者来说可能较难。

examples.quote: The author's choice of adjectives reveals her attitude toward the subject more clearly than the facts themselves.
examples.cn: 作者对形容词的选择比事实本身更清晰地揭示了其对主题的态度。

confusables.diff: administration 指管理机构或行政事务本身，administrators 指具体任职的人。
managers 侧重企业经营中的经理，administrators 侧重行政、制度或公共事务的管理者。

examples.quote: District administrators say that homework will still be a part of schooling; teachers are allowed to assign as much of it as they want.
University administrators are under pressure to cut costs without weakening academic quality.
examples.cn: 大学管理者面临压力，需要在削减成本的同时不削弱教学质量。

examples.quote: The new policy requires administrators to report any misuse of funds promptly.
examples.cn: 新政策要求管理者及时报告任何资金滥用行为。

meanings.cn: 装饰；点缀（adorn 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: decorated 强调添加装饰物使美观，adorned 更书面，常指佩戴或点缀饰物。
ornamented 多指用装饰品点缀建筑或器物，adorned 可用于人、场所等更广对象。

examples.quote: A Reddit webpage devoted to the phenomenon, boasting nearly 50,000 members, showcases images of local desire paths adorned with signs instructing pedestrians to adhere to designated walkways, underscoring the rebellious nature inherent in these human-made tracks.
The ancient temple was adorned with intricate carvings that attracted numerous visitors.
examples.cn: 这座古庙饰有精美的雕刻，吸引了众多游客。

examples.quote: Her plain dress was adorned with a single pearl brooch.
examples.cn: 她朴素的连衣裙上点缀着一枚珍珠胸针。

confusables.diff: beneficial 强调带来好处或益处，advantageous 更强调在比较中占据有利地位。
favorable 侧重表达赞同或条件有利，advantageous 侧重能带来优势。

examples.quote: "There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve," says Amrisha Vaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary – feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another.
Smaller firms may find it advantageous to cooperate with larger ones in research and development.
examples.cn: 小公司在研发方面与较大公司合作可能是有利的。

examples.quote: The agreement offers advantageous terms to both parties involved in the long-term project.
examples.cn: 该协议为参与这一长期项目的双方提供了优惠条件。

meanings.cn: 冒险主义（指外交、政治上的鲁莽冒进行为）
冒险作风；铤而走险的做法

confusables.diff: adventure 指冒险经历本身，adventurism 指鲁莽冒进的政策或作风。
venturesomeness 偏中性，指爱冒险的性格；adventurism 多含贬义，指不负责任的冒进行为。

examples.quote: Joe as a mindless war toy, the symbol of American military adventurism, but that's not how it used to be.
Critics warned that such military adventurism would only deepen the regional crisis.
examples.cn: 批评者警告说，这种军事冒险主义只会加深地区危机。

examples.quote: The party condemned the government's diplomatic adventurism as reckless and costly.
examples.cn: 该党谴责政府的外交冒险主义既轻率又代价高昂。

confusables.diff: advisable 意为“明智的、可取的”，advisory 意为“咨询的”或“公告”。
advice 是名词“建议”，advisory 是形容词或名词“公告”。

examples.quote: Denay, MD, lead author of a recent American College of Sports Medicine advisory that encourages Americans to not overlook the benefits of activity during the pandemic.
The government issued a travel advisory warning citizens of the rising security risks.
examples.cn: 政府发布旅行警告，提醒公民注意日益上升的安全风险。

examples.quote: She serves on an advisory committee that provides guidance on environmental policy.
examples.cn: 她在一个为环境政策提供指导的咨询委员会中任职。

confusables.diff: astronautics 指航天学（研究太空飞行），而 aeronautics 指航空学（研究大气层内飞行）。

examples.quote: Advances in aeronautics have significantly reduced the cost of air travel.
examples.cn: 航空学的进步显著降低了航空旅行的成本。

examples.quote: She decided to pursue a career in aeronautics after earning her engineering degree.
examples.cn: 获得工程学位后，她决定从事航空学方面的职业。

meanings.cn: 美学（研究美与艺术本质的哲学学科）

confusables.diff: esthetic 是美式拼写的形容词“审美的”，aesthetics 是名词“美学”。
aesthetic 多为形容词“审美的”，作名词时指“审美观”，而 aesthetics 指学科“美学”。

examples.quote: Yet, reluctance persists among other planners to integrate desire paths into formal plans, citing concerns about safety, environmental impact, or primarily, aesthetics.
The course explores the aesthetics of film and how visual style shapes meaning.
examples.cn: 这门课程探讨电影美学以及视觉风格如何塑造意义。

examples.quote: Her design reflects a minimal aesthetics that appeals to young consumers.
examples.cn: 她的设计体现了一种吸引年轻消费者的极简审美。

meanings.cn: 表示关爱的；充满深情的

confusables.diff: affection 是名词，指喜爱之情；affectionate 是形容词，指表现出关爱的。
affective 指情感方面的（如 affective disorder），与情感相关而非表达爱意。

examples.quote: They even had an affectionate nickname, "uccelli di passaggio," birds of passage.
She gave her younger brother an affectionate hug before he boarded the train.
examples.cn: 在弟弟登上火车前，她给了他一个充满深情的拥抱。

examples.quote: Despite his stern appearance, the professor was remarkably affectionate towards his students.
examples.cn: 尽管教授外表严厉，他对学生却格外亲切关爱。

confusables.diff: affirmable 意为“可断言的、可证实的”，而 affirmative 意为“肯定的”。
positive 语气更宽泛，指积极或确信的；affirmative 特指对提问作肯定答复。

examples.quote: The FTC alleged in a complaint that "despite express privacy claims, the company took control of users' sensitive fertility data and shared it with third parties." Flo Health and the FTC settled the matter with a Consent Order requiring the company to get app users' express affirmative consent before sharing their health information as well as to instruct the third parties to delete the data they had obtained.
She gave an affirmative nod when asked whether she agreed with the proposal.
examples.cn: 当被问及是否同意该提议时，她肯定地点了点头。

examples.quote: Those in favor should answer in the affirmative, and those against in the negative.
examples.cn: 赞成者应作肯定回答，反对者作否定回答。

meanings.cn: （企业等）不欠债的，维持下去的

confusables.diff: afoot 意为“在进行中、酝酿中”，与“漂浮”无关，仅拼写相近。
float 是动词“漂浮”，afloat 是形容词/副词，表示状态。

examples.quote: Many papers stayed afloat by pushing journalists overboard.
The company struggled to stay afloat during the economic downturn.
examples.cn: 经济低迷期间，这家公司艰难维持经营。

examples.quote: A wooden raft was still afloat after the storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨过后，一只木筏仍漂浮在水面上。

meanings.cn: 后果，余波（尤指战争、灾难等不幸事件之后）

confusables.diff: consequence 泛指各种结果，中性；aftermath 特指灾难、战争等不幸事件后的余波。
outcome 指最终结果，常含中性或积极意味；aftermath 强调负面事件的遗留影响。

examples.quote: From career to community and family, these contrasts suggest that in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession, those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics.
In the aftermath of the financial crisis, many small firms struggled to survive.
examples.cn: 金融危机之后，许多小公司艰难求生。

examples.quote: The government faced widespread criticism in the aftermath of the disaster.
examples.cn: 灾难发生后，政府遭到广泛批评。

confusables.diff: irritated 指因受刺激而恼怒，agitated 指内心焦躁不安、难以平静。
aggressive 意为好斗的、有攻击性的，agitated 侧重情绪激动不安。

examples.quote: Executives were violently agitated.
She grew visibly agitated when the interviewer raised the question of her previous employer.
examples.cn: 当面试官提到她前雇主的问题时，她明显变得焦躁不安。

examples.quote: The agitated crowd demanded an immediate explanation from the officials.
examples.cn: 激动的人群要求官员立即作出解释。

meanings.cn: 极度痛苦的（指感受、决定等）

confusables.diff: painful 泛指引起身体或精神疼痛的，agonizing 强调痛苦剧烈且持续煎熬。
distressing 侧重使人苦恼忧虑，agonizing 更强调难以忍受的剧痛或煎熬。

examples.quote: For the families involved, the wait for news was agonizing.
examples.cn: 对相关家庭而言，等待消息的过程令人煎熬。

examples.quote: She was faced with the agonizing decision of whether to give up her career.
examples.cn: 她面临着一个痛苦的决定：是否放弃自己的事业。

meanings.cn: 漫不经心的；不切实际的

confusables.diff: airy 指通风或轻盈的，aerial 指航空的或天线。
注意拼写为 airy，而非 airey。

examples.quote: But they were popular because of their airy glass walls, the views they afforded and the elegance of the buildings' details and proportions, the architectural equivalent of the abstract art so popular at the time.
The new library is bright and airy, with large windows letting in plenty of natural light.
examples.cn: 新图书馆明亮通风，大窗户让充足的自然光透进来。

examples.quote: She dismissed the criticism in an airy manner, as if it hardly mattered.
examples.cn: 她以一种漫不经心的态度否定了批评，仿佛那无关紧要。

meanings.cn: 算法（algorithm 的复数形式）；计算机解题步骤或规则系统

confusables.diff: logarithms 指对数（数学运算），algorithms 指算法（计算步骤），拼写相近但含义迥异。
rhythms 指节奏、韵律，algorithms 指算法，二者拼写形近但词义无关。

examples.quote: Avoiding dangers posed by all those human drivers would require too many algorithms, she said.
Social media platforms rely on sophisticated algorithms to decide which posts users see first.
examples.cn: 社交媒体平台依靠复杂的算法来决定用户首先看到哪些帖子。

examples.quote: Researchers are developing algorithms that can detect anomalies in medical images more accurately than humans.
examples.cn: 研究人员正在开发能比人类更准确地检测医学图像异常的算法。

confusables.diff: foreigners 指外国公民，aliens 在法律语境中特指非本国公民，且另有外星人之义。
immigrants 强调移居并长期居留者，aliens 仅指非本国国籍者，不涉及居留意图。

examples.quote: We hail them as Americans in the making, or brand them as aliens to be kicked out.
The law requires all aliens to register with the government upon arrival.
examples.cn: 法律规定所有外侨须在抵达时向政府登记。

examples.quote: Scientists are searching for signals that might be sent by intelligent aliens.
examples.cn: 科学家正在搜寻可能由智慧外星生命发出的信号。

confusables.diff: allied 强调结盟、同盟关系，aligned 更强调立场或利益上的一致与协调。
alike 意为相似的，作形容词时多作表语，aligned 强调对齐或立场一致。

examples.quote: College students' ratings of strawberry jams and college courses aligned better with experts' opinions when the students weren't asked to analyze their rationale.
The company's policies are aligned with the government's long-term goals.
examples.cn: 该公司的政策与政府的长期目标保持一致。

examples.quote: Countries aligned with major powers often face difficult diplomatic choices.
examples.cn: 与大国结盟的国家往往面临艰难的外交抉择。

meanings.cn: 减轻，缓解（恐惧、疑虑、痛苦等）

confusables.diff: alleviate 更正式、常指缓解痛苦或问题；allay 多指平息恐惧、疑虑等情绪。
relieve 强调解除或减轻负担、痛苦；allay 侧重使情绪平静下来。

examples.quote: They could even be detrimental, satisfying a need to have "done our bit" without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions – a kind of "moral licensing" that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge.
The government's prompt response did much to allay public fears about the safety of the vaccine.
examples.cn: 政府的迅速回应在很大程度上缓解了公众对疫苗安全性的担忧。

examples.quote: Nothing he said could allay her doubts about the sincerity of the offer.
examples.cn: 他说什么都无法消除她对这一提议诚意的怀疑。

meanings.cn: 据称的；据传的（未经证实）

confusables.diff: accused 指已被正式起诉/控告的人（常作 the accused），alleged 强调“据称”而未经证实。
reputed 侧重“有名声的、被普遍认为的”，不一定含违法指控意味，alleged 常与罪行、不当行为搭配。
supposed 语气更泛，仅表“据认为的”，alleged 更正式且常暗示有争议或指控。

examples.quote: The FTC alleged in a complaint that "despite express privacy claims, the company took control of users' sensitive fertility data and shared it with third parties." Flo Health and the FTC settled the matter with a Consent Order requiring the company to get app users' express affirmative consent before sharing their health information as well as to instruct the third parties to delete the data they had obtained.
The alleged fraud involved millions of dollars and several offshore accounts.
examples.cn: 这起涉嫌欺诈案涉及数百万美元和多个离岸账户。

examples.quote: He denies the alleged misconduct, and the case is still under investigation.
examples.cn: 他否认了被指控的不当行为，此案仍在调查中。

meanings.cn: 忠诚，效忠（尤指对君主、国家、组织或事业的忠诚）

confusables.diff: loyalty 泛指对人、团体或信念的忠实，感情色彩更宽泛；allegiance 强调正式、公开的效忠义务，常与宣誓、国家、君主连用。
fidelity 强调信守承诺、忠实原貌或忠于配偶；allegiance 强调对主权者或政治实体的臣属与效忠关系。

examples.quote: These terms are also intended to infuse work with meaning – and, as Rakesh Khurana, another professor, points out, increase allegiance to the firm.
New citizens must pledge allegiance to the country before receiving their passports.
examples.cn: 新公民在领取护照前必须宣誓效忠这个国家。

examples.quote: The party demanded absolute allegiance from its members, leaving little room for dissent.
examples.cn: 该党要求党员绝对效忠，几乎不给异议留有余地。

confusables.diff: relieving 强调解除或缓解不适感，alleviating 更强调使痛苦、问题变得不那么严重。
elevating 意为提升、提高，与 alleviating 拼写相近但含义相反。

examples.quote: We recommend using real grass because of its environmental benefits, which include supporting wildlife, alleviating flooding and cooling the environment."
The new policy is aimed at alleviating the financial burden on low-income families.
examples.cn: 这项新政策旨在减轻低收入家庭的经济负担。

examples.quote: Measures taken to alleviate traffic congestion have so far produced mixed results.
examples.cn: 为缓解交通拥堵所采取的措施迄今效果不一。

meanings.cn: 改变，更改（大小、形状、性质等）

confusables.diff: alter 指部分改变，change 可指完全改变或替换。
alter 强调改变本身，adapt 强调适应新用途或情况。

phrases.cn: 改变……的事实（常用于否定）

examples.quote: The new policy could alter the way companies report their earnings.
examples.cn: 新政策可能改变公司报告收益的方式。

examples.quote: Nothing can alter the fact that he was responsible for the accident.
examples.cn: 什么也无法改变他对这场事故负有责任的事实。

confusables.diff: alternative 强调可替代的选择或非传统的，而 alternate 强调交替或轮流的动作或状态。

examples.quote: Contributors offer a wide array of stories, from little-known new shortcuts to long-established alternate routes.
The two candidates alternate in giving speeches during the campaign.
examples.cn: 两位候选人在竞选期间轮流发表演讲。

examples.quote: She visits her parents on alternate weekends.
examples.cn: 她每隔一个周末去看望父母。

confusables.diff: altruism 是名词，指利他主义；altruistic 是形容词，指利他的。
egoistic 意为利己的，与 altruistic 意义相反。

examples.quote: The participants filled out questionnaires about how often they did things that were altruistic and positive, like sacrificing their own interests to help a friend, or rebellious and negative, like getting drunk or staying out late.
Her altruistic efforts to help the homeless won widespread admiration.
examples.cn: 她帮助无家可归者的无私努力赢得了广泛赞誉。

examples.quote: Some scholars argue that seemingly altruistic acts may ultimately serve self-interest.
examples.cn: 一些学者认为，看似利他的行为最终可能服务于自身利益。

meanings.cn: 积累，积聚（财富、知识、证据等）

confusables.diff: accumulated 强调逐步、连续地累积，amassed 更强调大量地聚集或收集。
assembled 指把人或物集合到一起，amassed 多指财富、资料等大量积聚。

examples.quote: Social psychologists have amassed oceans of research into what they call the "above average effect", or "illusory superiority", and shown that, for example, 70% of us rate ourselves as above average in leadership, 93% in driving and 85% at getting on well with others – all obviously statistical impossibilities.
Over the years, the scholar amassed a vast collection of rare manuscripts.
examples.cn: 多年来，这位学者收集了大量珍稀手稿。

examples.quote: The company amassed enormous profits before regulators began to take notice.
examples.cn: 在监管机构开始注意之前，这家公司已经积聚了巨额利润。

meanings.cn: 模棱两可的话；含糊之处

confusables.diff: 指对某事的矛盾心理（既爱又恨），与语义模糊无关。
强调表达笼统、不具体，ambiguity 强调可作多种解释。

examples.quote: Lawmakers and regulators are slowly starting to address the ambiguity around dark patterns, most recently at the state level.
The ambiguity of the contract's wording led both parties to interpret it in their own favor.
examples.cn: 合同措辞的模糊性使双方都做出了对自己有利的解释。

examples.quote: Writers should avoid ambiguity if they want their arguments to be understood clearly.
examples.cn: 若想让论点被清晰理解，作者应避免歧义。

confusables.diff: among 侧重处于同类人或物之间，amid 更强调被某环境、气氛或事件包围。
during 指在某段时间内，amid 指在某情形或氛围之中，不强调时间跨度。

examples.quote: This new focus on personal fulfillment can help keep employees motivated amid increasingly loud debates over work-life balance.
The company announced the layoffs amid growing concerns about its financial stability.
examples.cn: 在对公司财务稳定日益加剧的担忧中，该公司宣布了裁员。

examples.quote: She remained calm amid the chaos that followed the sudden power outage.
examples.cn: 在突然停电后的混乱中，她保持了镇定。

meanings.cn: 放大；增强（amplify 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: enlarged 指体积或尺寸变大，amplified 指声音、信号或效果被增强。
magnified 强调视觉上放大或夸大，amplified 强调信号、声音等的增强。

examples.quote: But the effects of the heat were amplified by humidity—an often neglected factor in heat alert systems—and the lack of shade at the late-morning outdoor ceremony.
The researchers found that the effect was amplified when the two factors combined.
examples.cn: 研究人员发现，当这两个因素结合时，效果被放大了。

examples.quote: Social media has amplified public concern about the issue.
examples.cn: 社交媒体加剧了公众对该问题的担忧。

confusables.diff: magnify 侧重光学或视觉上的放大、夸大，amplify 侧重声音、信号或效果的增强。
expand 指体积、范围或规模的扩大，amplify 指强度、音量或影响的增强。

examples.quote: It was not until the mid-1980s, when amplifying age and sex differences became a dominant children's marketing strategy, that pink fully came into its own, when it began to seem inherently attractive to girls, part of what defined them as female, at least for the first few critical years.
Social media can amplify public anxiety by spreading unverified information at remarkable speed.
examples.cn: 社交媒体能以惊人速度传播未经核实的信息，从而加剧公众焦虑。

examples.quote: The new evidence served only to amplify doubts about the reliability of the witness.
examples.cn: 新证据只是加深了人们对证人可靠性的怀疑。

confusables.diff: analytic 是形容词（分析的），analyst 是名词（分析师）。
analysis 是名词（分析），analyst 指从事分析的人。

examples.quote: Parents need to remind their children that their needs and desires may change over time, said Julie Gurner, a real estate analyst with FitSmallBusiness.com.
The analyst predicted that the company's earnings would rise by 10% next year.
examples.cn: 分析师预测该公司明年收益将增长10%。

examples.quote: As a data analyst, she spends hours interpreting trends from consumer behavior.
examples.cn: 作为数据分析师，她花大量时间解读消费者行为趋势。

meanings.cn: 使匿名；对……作匿名处理（anonymize 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: anonymous 强调本身不具名，anonymized 强调经处理去除身份信息。
anonymity 是名词，指匿名状态；anonymized 是形容词或动词过去式。

examples.quote: Then, unknown to the students, the researchers studied their anonymized meal-card purchases for that semester—nearly 14,000 receipts for almost 500 students.
Researchers analyzed the anonymized data to identify patterns without revealing individual identities.
examples.cn: 研究人员分析了匿名化数据以识别模式，同时不泄露个人身份。

examples.quote: All patient records were anonymized before being shared with the research team.
examples.cn: 所有患者记录在与研究团队共享之前都经过了匿名化处理。

meanings.cn: 无特色的；缺乏个性特征的

confusables.diff: anonymous 指匿名的，unanimous 指全体一致的，拼写相近但词义不同。
anonymous 强调无名无姓，anomalous 强调反常、不规则。

examples.quote: Then the kids were handed chocolate coins, and given a chance to share them with an anonymous child.
The charity received a large donation from an anonymous donor.
examples.cn: 该慈善机构收到了一位匿名捐赠者的大笔捐款。

examples.quote: Employees can report misconduct through an anonymous hotline.
examples.cn: 员工可以通过匿名热线举报不当行为。

meanings.cn: 预料，预期（anticipate 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: expected 侧重按常规推测的“预料之中”，anticipated 更强调事先主动预见并做准备。
anticipatedly 是副词“预期地”，而 anticipated 是形容词或动词过去式。

examples.quote: Without additional protections in place, companies may share (and potentially monetize) personal health information in a way consumers may not have authorized or anticipated.
The results were broadly in line with what economists had anticipated.
examples.cn: 结果与经济学家此前的预期基本一致。

examples.quote: The anticipated rise in demand has prompted firms to expand production.
examples.cn: 预期的需求增长促使企业扩大生产。

confusables.diff: expectation 侧重基于概率的预料，anticipation 更强调提前采取行动或充满情感的期盼。
participation 意为参与，与 anticipation 拼写相近但含义无关。

examples.quote: The company has invested heavily in new technology in anticipation of future demand.
examples.cn: 公司已大量投资新技术，以应对未来的需求。

examples.quote: There was a sense of eager anticipation among the students before the results were announced.
examples.cn: 成绩公布前，学生们满怀热切的期盼。

confusables.diff: nondiscrimination 强调不歧视的中立原则，antidiscrimination 强调主动反对和消除歧视。
discrimination 指歧视行为，antidiscrimination 指反对歧视的行动或政策。

examples.quote: West Virginia, the practice of selecting so-called elite or blue-ribbon juries provided a convenient way around this and other antidiscrimination laws.
The new antidiscrimination law requires employers to treat all applicants equally regardless of age or gender.
examples.cn: 新的反歧视法要求雇主平等对待所有求职者，不论其年龄或性别。

examples.quote: Public support for antidiscrimination measures has grown steadily over the past decade.
examples.cn: 过去十年里，公众对反歧视措施的支持稳步增长。

confusables.diff: appeal 意为呼吁、上诉或有吸引力，appease 意为平息怒气或满足要求以换取和平。
pacify 侧重使平静、恢复秩序，appease 常含为求安宁而让步的贬义。

examples.quote: Children aren't born knowing how to say "I'm sorry"; rather, they learn over time that such statements appease parents and friends – and their own consciences.
The government offered subsidies to appease angry farmers protesting against the new tax.
examples.cn: 政府提供补贴以安抚抗议新税的愤怒农民。

examples.quote: Critics argue that granting such concessions merely appeases the aggressor instead of deterring further demands.
examples.cn: 批评者认为，给予此类让步只会姑息侵略者，而无法阻止其更多要求。

confusables.diff: fertile 强调土地肥沃、产量高，arable 只强调土地可被耕作，不涉及肥力。
arable 侧重可耕作性，arid 侧重气候干旱缺水，二者形近但含义不同。

examples.quote: Only a small proportion of the region's land is arable, which limits agricultural output.
examples.cn: 该地区只有一小部分土地是可耕种的，这限制了农业产量。

examples.quote: As the population grows, pressure on arable land to produce more food continues to increase.
examples.cn: 随着人口增长，可耕地生产更多粮食的压力持续增加。

confusables.diff: 注意与名词 architect（建筑师）区分，architectural 是形容词形式。
structural 泛指结构上的，architectural 侧重建筑设计与风格。

examples.quote: But they were popular because of their airy glass walls, the views they afforded and the elegance of the buildings' details and proportions, the architectural equivalent of the abstract art so popular at the time.
The city's architectural heritage attracts millions of tourists every year.
examples.cn: 这座城市的建筑遗产每年吸引数百万游客。

examples.quote: Preserving architectural diversity is essential to maintaining a community's cultural identity.
examples.cn: 保护建筑多样性对维系社区文化认同至关重要。

meanings.cn: 可论证地；可以说；按理说

confusables.diff: arguable 是形容词，表示“可论证的、有争议的”；arguably 是副词，修饰整个判断。
probably 表示单纯的“很可能”，arguably 强调“有理由认为、可以说”而非单纯概率。

examples.quote: Efforts in Canada and elsewhere have been arguably languid at best, and have given us a situation where we frequently hear of employers begging for workers, even at times and in regions where unemployment is high.
This is arguably the most important decision the committee has ever made.
examples.cn: 这可以说是委员会有史以来做出的最重要的决定。

examples.quote: He is arguably the finest writer of his generation.
examples.cn: 他可以说是他那一代中最优秀的作家。

confusables.diff: 拼写变体，罕见且多被视为不规范，考试中用 argumentative。
指话题本身有争议，而非人的性格好争辩。

examples.quote: One of the biggest barriers to gaining buy-in occurs when the owner of an idea is viewed as argumentative, defensive, or close-minded.
He became increasingly argumentative whenever the discussion turned to politics.
examples.cn: 每当讨论转向政治，他就变得越发好争辩。

examples.quote: Students are required to write an argumentative essay on a controversial issue.
examples.cn: 学生须就一个有争议的话题写一篇议论文。

meanings.cn: 有艺术天赋的；有审美情趣的

confusables.diff: artful 指狡黠或精巧的，artistic 指与艺术相关或有艺术气质的。
artificial 指人造的、非自然的，artistic 指艺术的。

examples.quote: On top of this, they produce value from their extensive educational programs, their positive impact on the climate through carbon sequestration, their contribution to our cultural and artistic life, and of course through tourism.
The museum's collection reflects the artistic achievements of the Renaissance.
examples.cn: 这家博物馆的藏品反映了文艺复兴时期的艺术成就。

examples.quote: Her artistic sensibility allows her to appreciate details that others often overlook.
examples.cn: 她的艺术感受力使她能够欣赏他人常常忽略的细节。

confusables.diff: artifact 指具有历史或考古价值的器物，artwork 强调艺术创作的作品。
artiste 指专业表演者（如歌手、演员），artwork 指作品本身而非人。

examples.quote: When younger kids learn computer science, they learn that it's not just a confusing, endless string of letters and numbers – but a tool to build apps, or create artwork, or test hypotheses.
The museum's collection includes artwork from the Renaissance period.
examples.cn: 该博物馆的藏品包括文艺复兴时期的艺术作品。

examples.quote: Designers submitted their artwork for the exhibition catalogue.
examples.cn: 设计师们提交了作品用于展览图录。

confusables.diff: inspiration 指鼓舞人心的人或事物，aspiration 指自身渴望达到的目标。
ambition 更强调对成功、权力或财富的雄心，aspiration 更侧重对理想境界的向往。

examples.quote: Confor is now calling for much greater impetus behind those aspirations to ensure we have enough wood to meet increasing demand."
Many graduates find that their career aspirations do not match the realities of the job market.
examples.cn: 许多毕业生发现自己的职业抱负与就业市场的现实并不相符。

examples.quote: Her aspirations to become a writer were encouraged by a teacher who recognized her talent.
examples.cn: 她成为作家的志向受到一位赏识她才干的老师的鼓励。

confusables.diff: attacked 泛指任何攻击，assaulted 多指人身暴力袭击或法律意义上的侵犯。
assailed 强调连续猛烈抨击或困扰，assaulted 侧重突然的身体攻击。

examples.quote: Parks feature, particularly in the earlier works, such as John Hilliard's very funny Across the Park, in which a long-haired stroller is variously smiled at by a pretty girl and unwittingly assaulted in a sequence of images that turn out to be different parts of the same photograph.
The report says the woman was assaulted outside her home late at night.
examples.cn: 报道称这名女子深夜在自家门外遭到袭击。

examples.quote: Voters were assaulted by a barrage of negative advertisements during the campaign.
examples.cn: 竞选期间，选民们被铺天盖地的负面广告所困扰。

meanings.cn: 断言，声称（assert 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: assertive 是形容词，意为“自信坚定的”；asserted 是“被声称的”或 assert 的过去式。
alleged 指“据称的（未经证实）”，语气偏存疑；asserted 强调说话者主动、坚定地声称。

examples.quote: Instead of saying: "If we set an end-of-quarter deadline, we will never make it," say, "This is just my opinion, but I don't see how we will make that deadline." Having asserted your opinion (as a position, not as a fact), demonstrate equal curiosity about other views.
The report asserted that the new policy had significantly reduced unemployment.
examples.cn: 该报告声称新政策已大幅降低失业率。

examples.quote: Despite the asserted benefits, critics argued that the evidence was far from conclusive.
examples.cn: 尽管有人声称有诸多好处，批评者仍认为证据远非确凿。

confusables.diff: property 多指具体房产、地产等财物，assets 泛指全部可变现的资产。
capital 侧重用于投资的资金，assets 指拥有的一切财产资源。

examples.quote: The company's total assets exceeded its liabilities by a wide margin last year.
examples.cn: 去年该公司的总资产远远超过其负债。

examples.quote: Fluency in a second language is a valuable asset in today's job market.
examples.cn: 在当今就业市场，掌握第二语言的流利能力是一项宝贵优势。

confusables.diff: allocate 强调按计划分配资源或资金，assign 更强调分派任务或指派人员。
appoint 指正式任命职位，assign 指分派任务或工作，不涉及正式任命。
designate 指正式指定或命名，assign 侧重实际分派任务或分配物品。

examples.quote: District administrators say that homework will still be a part of schooling; teachers are allowed to assign as much of it as they want.
The manager assigned the most challenging project to the new employee.
examples.cn: 经理把最具挑战性的项目分派给了这位新员工。

examples.quote: Researchers assigned the participants to two groups at random.
examples.cn: 研究人员将参与者随机分配到两个组中。

confusables.diff: allocation 强调资源、资金等的按比例划拨，assignment 强调任务或人员的指派。
appointment 指约定的会面或职位任命，assignment 指分派的任务。

examples.quote: A fifth grader gets a homework assignment to select his future career path from a list of occupations.
Students who fail to submit the assignment by Friday will lose part of their grade.
examples.cn: 未能在周五前提交作业的学生将损失部分成绩。

examples.quote: She was sent on a difficult assignment to the remote mountainous region.
examples.cn: 她被派往偏远山区执行一项艰巨任务。

confusables.diff: alleviate 侧重减轻痛苦或问题的严重程度，assuage 更强调安抚情绪、平息感受。
assume 意为假定、承担，与 assuage 拼写相近但词义无关。

examples.quote: The booming economy seems to have done little to assuage this underlying generational sense of anxious urgency, especially for those who have college debt.
The government's new measures failed to assuage public anxiety about rising food prices.
examples.cn: 政府的新措施未能缓解公众对食品价格上涨的焦虑。

examples.quote: She tried to assuage her guilt by donating generously to the charity.
examples.cn: 她试图通过慷慨捐款给慈善机构来减轻自己的内疚。

confusables.diff: assured 是形容词或过去分词，assure 是动词，意为“向……保证”。
assured 强调自信或确定，secure 强调安全或稳固。

examples.quote: The Biotechnology Industry Organisation (BIO), a trade group, assured members that this was just a "preliminary step" in a longer battle.
Rest assured that your application will be treated in strict confidence.
examples.cn: 请放心，你的申请将被严格保密。

examples.quote: Her assured manner convinced the interviewers that she was the right person for the job.
examples.cn: 她自信的举止让面试官们相信她是这份工作的合适人选。

meanings.cn: （对某事物）熟悉的，适应的，能理解的

confusables.diff: attended 是 attend 的过去式，意为出席、照料；attuned 意为适应、熟悉，二者形近但义异。
tuned 强调调音或调整（设备）；attuned 强调人心对事物的适应与敏感。

examples.quote: Rats and other animals need to be highly attuned to social signals from others so they can identify friends to cooperate with and enemies to avoid.
A good manager stays attuned to the shifting moods of the team.
examples.cn: 优秀的管理者会敏锐地察觉团队情绪的变化。

examples.quote: Children raised in bilingual homes are often attuned to subtle differences in sound.
examples.cn: 在双语家庭长大的孩子往往对声音的细微差别很敏感。

confusables.diff: auction 指拍卖活动本身，auctioneer 指主持拍卖的拍卖师。

examples.quote: Within weeks the world's two biggest auction houses, Sotheby's and Christie's, had to pay out nearly $200m in guarantees to clients who had placed works for sale with them.
The painting was sold at auction for a record price, far exceeding the estimate.
examples.cn: 这幅画在拍卖会上以创纪录的价格售出，远超估价。

examples.quote: Rare manuscripts from the collection will be auctioned next month to raise funds.
examples.cn: 该藏品中的珍稀手稿将于下月拍卖以筹集资金。

confusables.diff: 最通用，指数量、程度等的增加；augment 更正式，常指通过添加使某物变大或增强。
强调补充不足，使更完整；augment 强调增大原有规模或数量。

examples.quote: In other words, we need to look at the ways in which machines can augment human labor rather than replace it.
Many students take part-time jobs to augment their income while studying at university.
examples.cn: 许多学生在大学期间做兼职来增加收入。

examples.quote: The company plans to augment its workforce by hiring more engineers next year.
examples.cn: 该公司计划明年通过招聘更多工程师来扩充员工队伍。

meanings.cn: 鉴定，证实（某物为真品或真实）
验证（身份、文件、数据等的真实性）

confusables.diff: verify 侧重核对信息是否准确无误，authenticate 强调证明其为真品或本人所为。
validate 多指使某事物具有法律效力或确认其有效性，authenticate 侧重真伪鉴定。
confirm 泛指确认某事属实，语气较弱；authenticate 含权威鉴定意味。

examples.quote: Experts were called in to authenticate the painting before it was put up for auction.
examples.cn: 这幅画在拍卖前请专家进行了真伪鉴定。

examples.quote: The system authenticates users by scanning their fingerprints before granting access.
examples.cn: 该系统在允许访问前通过扫描指纹来验证用户身份。

meanings.cn: 授权；批准（authorize 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: authoritative 强调“权威性的、可信的”，而 authorized 强调“获得授权的”。
official 指“官方的、正式的”，侧重来源；authorized 侧重经许可或委托。

examples.quote: Without additional protections in place, companies may share (and potentially monetize) personal health information in a way consumers may not have authorized or anticipated.
Only authorized personnel are allowed to enter the laboratory after midnight.
examples.cn: 午夜过后，只有获得授权的人员才允许进入实验室。

examples.quote: The company was authorized to issue new shares to raise additional capital.
examples.cn: 该公司获准发行新股以筹集额外资金。

confusables.diff: automatic 指“自动的”，强调无需人工操作；automotive 专指“与汽车相关的”。
mobile 泛指“可移动的”；automotive 特指机动车及其工业。

examples.quote: Part of the problem in keeping older drivers safe is that the difficulties are addressed piecemeal by different professions with different focuses, including gerontologists, highway administration officials, automotive engineers and others, said gerontologist Elizabeth Dugan.
The automotive industry has invested heavily in electric vehicles to cut carbon emissions.
examples.cn: 汽车工业已在电动汽车上投入巨资，以减少碳排放。

examples.quote: Stricter regulations are forcing automotive manufacturers to rethink their production strategies.
examples.cn: 更严格的法规正迫使汽车制造商重新考虑其生产策略。

meanings.cn: 反对的；不乐意的；厌恶的

confusables.diff: adverse 指不利的、有害的（如 adverse effects）；averse 指不乐意的，常与 to 连用。
avert 是动词，意为避免、转移（目光）；averse 是形容词，表示反对的。

examples.quote: They have trouble seeing a financial future and they are quite risk averse."
Many consumers remain averse to sharing personal data with unfamiliar online platforms.
examples.cn: 许多消费者仍不愿与陌生的网络平台分享个人数据。

examples.quote: She is not averse to hard work, but she expects fair compensation.
examples.cn: 她并不排斥辛苦工作，但期望得到公平的报酬。

confusables.diff: wait 多作不及物动词，需接 for；await 为及物动词，直接接宾语且更正式。
expect 强调预料某事会发生；await 强调处于等待状态。

examples.quote: This isn't surprising, considering the basic mandatory high school curriculum leaves students with a poor understanding of the vast academic possibilities that await them in college.
The committee is still awaiting a formal reply from the government.
examples.cn: 委员会仍在等待政府的正式答复。

examples.quote: A warm welcome awaits you at the conference.
examples.cn: 会议现场将热情欢迎你的到来。

meanings.cn: 醒来；唤醒（awake 的过去分词）

confusables.diff: awaken 是原形动词，awoken 是其过去分词，强调已被唤醒的结果。
awoke 是 awake 的过去式，awoken 是过去分词，前者用于一般过去时。

examples.quote: At the very least, it has awoken us from our national fever dream of easy riches and bigger houses, and put a necessary end to an era of reckless personal spending.
She was awoken by the sound of heavy rain beating against the window.
examples.cn: 她被大雨敲打窗户的声音吵醒了。

examples.quote: Having awoken early, he decided to review his notes before the exam.
examples.cn: 他早早醒来，决定在考试前复习笔记。

confusables.diff: background 泛指个人经历、教育等背景或画面后景；backdrop 多指事件发生的宏观背景或舞台后幕，更具比喻性和场景感。

examples.quote: Against a backdrop of drastic changes in economy and population structure, younger Americans are drawing a new 21st-century road map to success, the latest poll has found.
Against the backdrop of rising inflation, consumers have become more cautious about spending.
examples.cn: 在通胀上升的背景下，消费者对支出变得更加谨慎。

examples.quote: The mountains provided a stunning backdrop for the outdoor wedding ceremony.
examples.cn: 群山为这场户外婚礼提供了迷人的背景。

confusables.diff: knock 指敲击并常含连续声，bang 强调沉重响亮的一击声。
blast 多指爆炸或气流冲击，bang 侧重撞击发出的短促巨响。

examples.quote: This slim volume is packed with tips to help wage slaves as well as lottery winners get the most "happiness bang for your buck." It seems most people would be better off if they could shorten their commutes to work, spend more time with friends and family and less of it watching television (something the average American spends a whopping two months a year doing, and is hardly jollier for it).
The door slammed shut with a loud bang, startling everyone in the quiet office.
examples.cn: 门砰的一声关上了，把安静办公室里的人都吓了一跳。

examples.quote: He banged his fist on the table to emphasize his point during the debate.
examples.cn: 辩论中他猛捶桌子以强调自己的观点。

meanings.cn: （某种价值、信念等的）彻底丧失，崩溃

confusables.diff: bankrupt 是形容词或动词，指“破产的/使破产”；bankruptcy 是名词，指破产这一状态或程序。
collapse 泛指倒塌、崩溃，范围更广；bankruptcy 特指法律或财务上的破产。

examples.quote: As the auctioneer called out bids, in New York one of the oldest banks on Wall Street, Lehman Brothers, filed for bankruptcy.
The company was forced to file for bankruptcy after years of mounting debts.
examples.cn: 由于多年债务不断累积，这家公司被迫申请破产。

examples.quote: Rising costs pushed many small firms to the edge of bankruptcy.
examples.cn: 成本上升把许多小公司推到了破产边缘。

confusables.diff: beckon 是动词“招手示意”，beacon 是名词“灯塔、信标”，形近但词性不同。

examples.quote: Madrid was hailed as a public health beacon last November when it rolled out ambitious restrictions on the most polluting cars.
The old lighthouse served as a beacon for ships navigating the treacherous waters.
examples.cn: 那座古老的灯塔为在险恶水域航行的船只充当信标。

examples.quote: Her courage became a beacon of hope for the entire community.
examples.cn: 她的勇气成为整个社区希望的灯塔。

confusables.diff: ahead 指时间或空间上在前，常与 of 搭配；beforehand 强调事先做好准备或安排。
previously 指以前、先前发生过；beforehand 指在某一事件之前预先做某事。

examples.quote: It's becoming more common for tips to be requested beforehand.
Applicants are advised to gather all the required documents beforehand to avoid delays.
examples.cn: 建议申请者事先准备好所有必需文件，以免延误。

examples.quote: Had we known beforehand about the traffic, we would have left much earlier.
examples.cn: 要是我们事先知道交通状况，就会早得多出发。

confusables.diff: 与befriend同形，无易混词，注意勿与befriend混淆
fraternize指与（尤指不该亲近的）人结交，常含贬义；befriend为中性

examples.quote: The readiness of the rats to befriend the social robot was surprising given its minimal design.
She often befriends newcomers at school, helping them settle in.
examples.cn: 她常在学校里与新来的人交朋友，帮助他们适应环境。

examples.quote: The old man befriended the stray dog and fed it every day.
examples.cn: 老人与那只流浪狗交上了朋友，每天喂它。

confusables.diff: behavioural 是形容词，behavior 是对应的名词（美式拼写）。
behavioural 修饰行为本身，behave 是动词，表示“表现、举止”。

examples.quote: Psychologist and behavioural scientist Nicholas Epley oversaw a key study into self-enhancement and attractiveness.
Researchers found that behavioural interventions were more effective than financial incentives in changing habits.
examples.cn: 研究人员发现，在改变习惯方面，行为干预比经济激励更有效。

examples.quote: The study explores the behavioural patterns of consumers faced with too many choices.
examples.cn: 该研究探讨了面对过多选择时消费者的行为模式。

confusables.diff: malignant 指恶性的、致命的，与 benign（良性的）意义相对。

examples.quote: It is an ambitious attempt to blunt the sharpest edges of globalisation, and make capitalism benign.
The doctor assured her that the tumor was benign and required no surgery.
examples.cn: 医生向她保证肿瘤是良性的，无需手术。

examples.quote: Despite his stern appearance, he had a benign smile that put everyone at ease.
examples.cn: 尽管外表严肃，他温和的笑容让每个人都放松下来。

confusables.diff: 带连字符为规范拼写，bestselling 为常见合并拼写，二者同义。
bestseller 是名词（畅销书/畅销品），bestselling 是形容词。

examples.quote: 5 that most bestselling authors began writing when they were doing other things to earn a living.
Her bestselling novel has been translated into more than thirty languages worldwide.
examples.cn: 她的畅销小说已被翻译成三十多种语言在世界各地出版。

examples.quote: The bestselling author will sign copies of his new book at the bookstore tomorrow.
examples.cn: 这位畅销书作家明天将在书店为新书签名。

confusables.diff: bet 是动词或单数名词，betting 是 bet 的动名词或形容词形式
gambling 泛指赌博行为，范围更广；betting 侧重对具体结果下注打赌

examples.quote: The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes such as free-range, non-GMO, and pasture-raised eggs will embrace sustainability.
Online betting has grown rapidly, raising concerns about addiction among young people.
examples.cn: 网络赌博迅速发展，引发了人们对年轻人上瘾的担忧。

examples.quote: He lost a large sum of money on betting, which ruined his family life.
examples.cn: 他因赌博输掉了一大笔钱，这毁了他的家庭生活。

meanings.cn: 饮料（尤指除水以外的饮品）

confusables.diff: drink 泛指任何可饮用的液体，最常用；beverage 更正式，多用于菜单、广告或食品工业语境。

examples.quote: Then beverage companies started bottling the production of far-off springs, and now office workers unthinkingly sip bottled water all day long.
The company has expanded its product line to include a variety of healthy beverages.
examples.cn: 该公司已扩展产品线，纳入多种健康饮料。

examples.quote: Consumers are increasingly willing to pay more for beverages that claim to boost energy.
examples.cn: 消费者越来越愿意为宣称能补充能量的饮料支付更高价格。

meanings.cn: 令人困惑地；使人不知所措地

confusables.diff: bewilderedly 表示“感到困惑地”（主语自身困惑），bewilderingly 表示“令人困惑地”（使他人困惑）。

examples.quote: The world art market had already been losing momentum for a while after rising bewilderingly since 2003.
The regulations are bewilderingly complex, leaving even experts unsure of how to comply.
examples.cn: 这些法规复杂得令人困惑，连专家都不确定该如何遵守。

examples.quote: She spoke bewilderingly fast, so the audience struggled to follow her argument.
examples.cn: 她语速快得令人困惑，听众很难跟上她的论证。

confusables.diff: prejudiced 强调先入为主的成见，biased 强调不公平的倾向或偏差
partial 指偏袒一方，也可指不完整的；biased 只指倾向性不公

examples.quote: Outside directors are supposed to serve as helpful, yet less biased, advisers on a firm's board.
The survey was criticized for asking biased questions that favored one side.
examples.cn: 该调查因提出偏袒一方的有倾向性问题而受到批评。

examples.quote: People tend to be biased towards information that confirms their existing beliefs.
examples.cn: 人们往往偏向于支持印证自身既有观念的信息。

confusables.diff: 本身为 bidder 的复数形式，注意与 bidder（单数）区分
buyers 指买方/购买者，bidders 强调在拍卖或投标中出价的人
形近词 bidder 单复数易混，注意词尾 -s

examples.quote: The Olympic bidders, by contrast, wanted to get more people doing sport and to produce more elite athletes.
The auction house attracted bidders from across the world who competed for the rare painting.
examples.cn: 拍卖行吸引了来自世界各地的竞买人，他们竞相争夺这幅珍稀画作。

examples.quote: Only qualified bidders were allowed to submit proposals for the government contract.
examples.cn: 只有合格的投标者才被允许为该政府合同提交标书。

meanings.cn: 广告牌；大幅宣传牌（billboard 的复数）

confusables.diff: poster 指张贴的较小海报，billboard 指路边大型户外广告牌。
signboard 泛指指示或招牌类标识牌，billboard 专指大型商业广告牌。

examples.quote: and limiting them on billboards or in cinemas.
Along the highway, billboards advertise products to millions of passing drivers every day.
examples.cn: 沿高速公路，广告牌每天向数百万过往司机宣传产品。

examples.quote: Critics argue that billboards clutter the urban landscape and distract drivers.
examples.cn: 批评者认为广告牌使城市景观杂乱，并分散司机的注意力。

confusables.diff: millionaire 指百万富翁，财富量级比 billionaire（十亿富翁）低。
billion 是数词“十亿”，billionaire 指拥有十亿以上财富的人。

examples.quote: "An economy of tech millionaires or billionaires and gig workers, with middle-income jobs undercut by automation, will not be politically sustainable."
A handful of tech billionaires now control a market worth trillions of dollars.
examples.cn: 少数几位科技界亿万富翁如今掌控着价值数万亿美元的市场。

examples.quote: Critics argue that billionaires should pay a larger share of tax.
examples.cn: 批评者认为亿万富翁应当缴纳更高比例的税款。

meanings.cn: 数十亿（billion 的复数形式）

confusables.diff: millions 指数百万，数量级比 billions 小三个数量级。
同词，注意其为复数形式，单数 billion 前有具体数字时不加 s。

examples.quote: These habits have helped companies earn billions of dollars when customers eat snacks or wipe counters almost without thinking, often in response to a carefully designed set of daily cues.
Billions of dollars are spent each year on research that may never yield practical results.
examples.cn: 每年有数十亿美元被花在可能永远不会产生实际成果的研究上。

examples.quote: The internet connects billions of people, yet many still lack basic digital skills.
examples.cn: 互联网连接着数十亿人，但许多人仍缺乏基本的数字技能。

meanings.cn: 由两部分组成的；二元的
二进制（数系）；二进制文件

confusables.diff: dual 强调双重并存（如 dual role），binary 强调非此即彼的两分或二进制。
bilateral 指双方之间的（如双边协议），binary 指二元的、二进制的。

examples.quote: "There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve," says Amrisha Vaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary – feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another.
Computers process information by converting it into a binary code of zeros and ones.
examples.cn: 计算机通过将信息转换成由 0 和 1 组成的二进制代码来处理信息。

examples.quote: Critics argue that framing the debate as a binary choice oversimplifies a complex issue.
examples.cn: 批评者认为，把这场辩论框定为二选一，过于简化了一个复杂的问题。

meanings.cn: 有约束力的，必须遵守的

confusables.diff: binding 强调约束力或装订，bonding 指情感联结或粘合过程。

examples.quote: "But I like what the quotas do." Quotas get action: they "open the way to equality and they break through the glass ceiling," according to Reding, a result seen in France and other countries with legally binding provisions on placing women in top business positions.
The agreement is legally binding on both parties.
examples.cn: 该协议对双方具有法律约束力。

examples.quote: The binding of the book was damaged after years of use.
examples.cn: 这本书的装订在使用多年后损坏了。

meanings.cn: 生物燃料（由动植物有机物质制成的燃料）

confusables.diff: fossil fuel 指煤、石油等化石燃料，biofuel 指可再生的生物质燃料。

examples.quote: The strategy also aims to ensure that carbon in woody material removed from the forests is locked away in the form of solid lumber or burned as biofuel in vehicles that would otherwise run on fossil fuels.
Governments are investing heavily in biofuels as a way to reduce carbon emissions.
examples.cn: 各国政府正大力投资生物燃料，以此作为减少碳排放的一种途径。

examples.quote: Critics argue that growing crops for biofuel may compete with food production.
examples.cn: 批评者认为，种植作物用于生物燃料可能会与粮食生产形成竞争。

confusables.diff: biological 意为“生物的、生物学的”，而 biographical 意为“传记的、生平的”。
biographic 与 biographical 同义，但 biographical 更常用。

examples.quote: This was the biographical tradition which Niccolò Machiavelli turned on its head.
The documentary offers a biographical account of the scientist's early years and struggles.
examples.cn: 这部纪录片记述了这位科学家早年的生活和奋斗经历。

examples.quote: Her latest novel is largely biographical, drawing on her childhood in a small coastal town.
examples.cn: 她的最新小说带有很强的自传色彩，取材于她在海滨小镇的童年生活。

confusables.diff: biography 意为“传记”，与 biologist 词形相近但词义无关。
ecologist 研究生态系统与环境关系，biologist 泛指研究一切生物。

examples.quote: "The federal government is giving responsibility for managing the bird to the same industries that are pushing it to extinction," says biologist Jay Lininger.
The biologist spent years observing how these species adapt to extreme environments.
examples.cn: 这位生物学家花了数年时间观察这些物种如何适应极端环境。

examples.quote: As a biologist, she argues that protecting habitats matters more than saving individual animals.
examples.cn: 作为一名生物学家，她认为保护栖息地比拯救单个动物更重要。

confusables.diff: biotech 是其口语缩略形式，更常用于行业、公司等语境
bioethics 指生物伦理学，与 biotech 词形相近但含义完全不同

examples.quote: In 2010, a federal judge shook America's biotech industry to its core.
The biotech company raised millions to develop new gene therapies.
examples.cn: 这家生物科技公司筹集了数百万资金用于开发新的基因疗法。

examples.quote: Investors remain optimistic about the long-term prospects of the biotech sector.
examples.cn: 投资者对生物科技板块的长期前景仍持乐观态度。

confusables.diff: dissect 意为解剖、仔细分析，bisect 仅指分成两等份，词形相近但含义不同。
intersect 指相交、交叉，bisect 指平分，前缀 inter- 与 bi- 不同。

examples.quote: Often appearing as trodden dirt tracks through otherwise neat green spaces, these routes of collective disobedience cut corners, bisect lawns and cross hills, representing the natural capability of people (and animals) to go from point A to point B most effectively.
The road bisects the village, separating the old quarter from the new housing estate.
examples.cn: 这条路把村庄一分为二，将老城区与新建住宅区分隔开来。

examples.quote: A diagonal line bisects the square into two identical triangles.
examples.cn: 一条对角线把正方形平分成两个全等的三角形。

confusables.diff: plan 泛指任何计划，blueprint 强调具体详尽的行动框架或技术图纸。
sketch 指粗略的草图，blueprint 指精确的工程图或详细方案。

examples.quote: Whether the separation distances involved would satisfy air-traffic-control regulations is another matter, although a working group at the International Civil Aviation Organisation has included the possibility of formation flying in a blueprint for new operational guidelines.
The report offers a detailed blueprint for reforming the country's pension system.
examples.cn: 该报告为改革国家养老金体系提供了一份详尽的蓝图。

examples.quote: Engineers studied the blueprint carefully before construction began.
examples.cn: 工程师们在动工前仔细研究了设计图。

meanings.cn: （粗心造成的）大错，愚蠢的错误
犯大错；笨拙地做，踉跄地走

confusables.diff: mistake 泛指一般错误，blunder 强调因粗心或愚蠢造成的严重错误。
error 偏正式、中性，多指技术或判断差错；blunder 含明显责备意味。

examples.quote: Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders.
The government's handling of the crisis was widely seen as a series of costly blunders.
examples.cn: 政府对该危机的处理被普遍视为一连串代价惨重的失误。

examples.quote: Without careful planning, small firms often blunder into markets they cannot sustain.
examples.cn: 缺乏周密规划时，小公司常会莽撞地闯入自己无法维持的市场。

confusables.diff: brusque 强调态度粗鲁生硬，blunt 侧重说话直白不客气但未必无礼。
dull 指物体不锋利或反应迟钝，blunt 更常用于刀刃等具体器物。

examples.quote: It is an ambitious attempt to blunt the sharpest edges of globalisation, and make capitalism benign.
To be blunt, the report's conclusions are based on rather weak evidence.
examples.cn: 坦率地说，这份报告的结论所依据的证据相当薄弱。

examples.quote: Years of budget cuts have blunted the agency's ability to respond quickly.
examples.cn: 多年的预算削减削弱了该机构快速反应的能力。

meanings.cn: 模糊化；模糊处理；模糊不清
（使）变模糊；使难以区分（blur 的现在分词）

confusables.diff: blur 是动词原形或名词，blurring 是现在分词或动名词形式。
blurred 是形容词或过去分词，表示已模糊的状态；blurring 表示正在模糊的过程。

examples.quote: With the blurring of roles, and the fact that the home front lags well behind the workplace in making adjustments for working women, it's not surprising that women are more stressed at home.
The blurring of the line between work and private life has become a growing concern.
examples.cn: 工作与私人生活之间界限的模糊已成为一个日益受关注的问题。

examples.quote: Digital technology is blurring the distinction between producers and consumers.
examples.cn: 数字技术正在模糊生产者与消费者之间的区别。

confusables.diff: boastful 是形容词（爱自夸的），boasting 是名词或动名词（自夸行为）。
bragging 更口语化，常指令人反感的吹嘘；boasting 语体较正式，可指对成就的自豪陈述。

phrases.cn: 毫不夸张地说；并非自夸

examples.quote: A Reddit webpage devoted to the phenomenon, boasting nearly 50,000 members, showcases images of local desire paths adorned with signs instructing pedestrians to adhere to designated walkways, underscoring the rebellious nature inherent in these human-made tracks.
Without boasting, he is the most qualified candidate for the position.
examples.cn: 毫不夸张地说，他是这个职位最合适的人选。

examples.quote: His constant boasting about his achievements annoyed his colleagues.
examples.cn: 他不断吹嘘自己的成就，令同事们很反感。

meanings.cn: 大胆的，勇敢的；鲜明的，醒目的

confusables.diff: brave 强调面对危险时的勇气，bold 更侧重敢想敢做、无所顾忌。
bald 意为秃头的，与 bold 拼写相近但词义无关。

phrases.en: be bold enough to do sth

examples.quote: "If we were really bold, we might even begin to think of high-calorie fast food in the same way as cigarettes – by setting strict limits on advertising, product placement and sponsorship of sports events," he said.
It was a bold decision to launch the product during an economic downturn.
examples.cn: 在经济低迷时期推出该产品是一个大胆的决定。

examples.quote: The report's bold conclusion challenged the assumptions held by most economists.
examples.cn: 该报告大胆的结论挑战了大多数经济学家的既有假设。

confusables.diff: bravery 强调面对危险时的英勇无畏，褒义明确；boldness 可褒可贬，兼指大胆与冒失。
audacity 常含厚颜无耻、放肆无礼的贬义；boldness 中性偏褒，语气较轻。

examples.quote: In The Prince, he championed cunning, ruthlessness, and boldness, rather than virtue, mercy and justice, as the skills of successful leaders.
It takes considerable boldness to challenge the conventional wisdom of one's own field.
examples.cn: 挑战自己领域内的传统观念需要相当大的胆量。

examples.quote: Her boldness in raising awkward questions unsettled the committee.
examples.cn: 她大胆提出棘手问题，令委员会感到不安。

confusables.diff: rhetoric 指修辞或华而不实的言辞，语气中性；bombast 强调空洞夸张，含贬义。
grandiloquence 指大而空的表达风格，较正式；bombast 更直指内容浮夸、缺乏实质。

examples.quote: Not everyone was convinced by such bombast.
Stripped of its bombast, the proposal offers little more than vague promises and recycled ideas.
examples.cn: 去掉浮夸之词后，这项提案不过是含糊的承诺和旧调重弹。

examples.quote: Critics dismissed the speech as political bombast that masked the government's failure to act.
examples.cn: 批评者认为那篇演讲不过是政治上的夸夸其谈，掩盖了政府的不作为。

meanings.cn: 训练营（短期强化培训班）

confusables.diff: workshop 侧重动手实践的工作坊，bootcamp 强调短期高强度的系统集训。
seminar 以研讨交流为主，bootcamp 以技能强化训练为主。

examples.quote: The Flatiron School, where people pay to learn programming, started as one of the many coding bootcamps that have become popular for adults looking for a career change.
Coding bootcamps have become a popular route into the tech industry for career changers.
examples.cn: 编程训练营已成为转行者进入科技行业的热门途径。

examples.quote: Many firms now run intensive bootcamps to help new hires acquire practical skills quickly.
examples.cn: 许多公司如今举办强化训练营，帮助新员工快速掌握实用技能。

confusables.diff: boring 是形容词，指事物令人厌烦；boredom 是名词，指无聊的状态或感受。
tedium 强调冗长乏味的过程，boredom 更侧重主观上的无聊感。

examples.quote: Other reasons, according to the study, include personal fulfillment such as staying mentally fit, preventing boredom or avoiding depression.
Many employees quit not because of low pay but because of the boredom of repetitive tasks.
examples.cn: 许多员工辞职不是因为工资低，而是因为重复性任务带来的无聊感。

examples.quote: To escape the boredom of rural life, he immersed himself in books and travel.
examples.cn: 为了摆脱乡村生活的乏味，他沉浸于书籍和旅行。

meanings.cn: 资产阶级分子；中产阶级一员
资产阶级的；中产阶级的；追求物质享受的

confusables.diff: bourgeois 强调社会阶层与价值观，capitalist 强调资本所有权与制度。
petty bourgeois 特指小资产阶级，bourgeois 可泛指整个资产阶级或中产阶级。

examples.quote: This was all a bit bourgeois for Thomas Carlyle, who focused his biographies on the truly heroic lives of Martin Luther, Oliver Cromwell and Napoleon Bonaparte.
The novel satirizes the bourgeois obsession with status and material comfort.
examples.cn: 这部小说讽刺了中产阶级对地位和物质享受的痴迷。

examples.quote: Critics argued that the reform mainly benefited the bourgeois class rather than workers.
examples.cn: 批评者认为，这项改革主要惠及资产阶级而非工人。

meanings.cn: 头脑风暴；集体讨论以激发创意
进行头脑风暴；集思广益

confusables.diff: brainstorm 是可数名词或动词，brainstorming 是不可数名词，指头脑风暴这一活动或方法。

examples.quote: So, instead of saying, "Martha, our current slogan is confusing and should be updated," you could try, "Martha raises a great point that our current slogan has a long history for our stakeholders, but I wonder if we might be able to brainstorm a tagline that could build on that—and be clearer for new customers."
The team spent the morning brainstorming ways to cut costs without reducing quality.
examples.cn: 团队花了一上午集思广益，寻找既能降低成本又不影响质量的办法。

examples.quote: A quick brainstorm produced several practical solutions to the traffic problem.
examples.cn: 一次快速的头脑风暴提出了几个解决交通问题的可行方案。

confusables.diff: break 泛指打破、折断，breach 多指违反法规或冲开缺口，较正式。
breech 指枪炮后膛或臀位，与 breach 拼写相近但含义无关。

phrases.cn: 安全漏洞，违反安全规定

examples.quote: "Some states require physicians to report, others allow but do not mandate reports, while a few consider a report a breach of confidentiality.
The company was sued for breach of contract after failing to deliver the goods on time.
examples.cn: 该公司因未能按时交货而被起诉违约。

examples.quote: Hackers breached the bank's security system and stole thousands of customer records.
examples.cn: 黑客攻破了银行的安全系统，窃取了数千条客户记录。

confusables.diff: rim指圆形物体的边缘，范围更广；brim多指容器口部或帽子的边缘。
edge泛指物体的一般边缘或刀刃；brim特指杯碗的口沿或帽檐。
brink指悬崖等陡峭边缘，常用于比喻濒临某状态；brim无此陡峭含义。

examples.quote: Students also benefit from learning something about coding before they get to college, where introductory computer-science classes are packed to the brim, which can drive the less-experienced or less-determined students away.
She was filled to the brim with confidence before the interview.
examples.cn: 面试前她信心满满。

examples.quote: His eyes brimmed with tears as he watched the farewell ceremony.
examples.cn: 观看告别仪式时，他眼中盈满泪水。

confusables.diff: bandwidth 指传输带宽（容量），broadband 指高速宽带接入方式。

examples.quote: When the government talks about infrastructure contributing to the economy the focus is usually on roads, railways, broadband and energy.
The government has pledged to expand broadband access in rural areas.
examples.cn: 政府已承诺扩大农村地区的宽带接入。

examples.quote: Reliable broadband is now essential for remote work and online education.
examples.cn: 可靠的宽带如今对远程办公和在线教育至关重要。

meanings.cn: 拓宽，扩大（范围、视野、兴趣等）

confusables.diff: widen 侧重物理宽度或差距的加大，broaden 更常用于视野、范围、兴趣等抽象意义的拓展。
expand 强调体积、规模或数量的膨胀扩大，broaden 强调广度与覆盖面的拓宽。

examples.quote: A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing.
Studying abroad can broaden students' horizons and enhance their cross-cultural communication skills.
examples.cn: 出国留学能开阔学生的视野，并提升他们的跨文化交际能力。

examples.quote: The company plans to broaden the scope of its research to include environmental issues.
examples.cn: 该公司计划扩大研究范围，将环境问题纳入其中。

confusables.diff: cauliflower 指白色花椰菜，broccoli 指绿色西兰花，颜色和外形不同。

examples.quote: If the sustainable-egg rollout is successful, it could open the floodgates for regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond.
Nutritionists recommend eating broccoli regularly because it is rich in vitamins and fiber.
examples.cn: 营养学家建议经常食用西兰花，因为它富含维生素和纤维。

examples.quote: She steamed the broccoli for five minutes to keep it crisp and bright green.
examples.cn: 她把西兰花蒸了五分钟，使其保持脆嫩和鲜绿。

confusables.diff: broken 是 break 的过去分词，多作形容词表“破碎的、损坏的”，而 broke 作形容词只表“没钱”。
broke 为 break 的过去式，作谓语动词；broken 为过去分词，用于完成时或被动语态。

examples.quote: Facebook promised the European commission then that it would not link phone numbers to Facebook identities, but it broke the promise almost as soon as the deal went through.
After years of bad investments, the once wealthy entrepreneur went broke and had to start over.
examples.cn: 多年投资失误后，这位曾经富有的企业家破了产，不得不从头再来。

examples.quote: Many students are flat broke at the end of the month, living on instant noodles.
examples.cn: 许多学生到了月底就一贫如洗，靠方便面度日。

meanings.cn: 严酷的；令人不快且毫不留情的
直截了当的；不加掩饰的

confusables.diff: cruel 侧重施虐或冷漠地造成痛苦，brutal 更强调如野兽般的暴力与无情。
harsh 指条件、言语或处理方式严厉刺耳，brutal 程度更重，含暴力或极端无情意味。
brutish 强调举止像野兽般粗野愚钝，brutal 强调暴力残忍或严酷无情。

examples.quote: The brutal truth is that many workers will lose their jobs as the industry shrinks.
examples.cn: 残酷的事实是，随着行业萎缩，许多工人将失去工作。

examples.quote: Critics condemned the regime's brutal suppression of peaceful protests.
examples.cn: 批评者谴责该政权对和平抗议的残酷镇压。

meanings.cn: 烦扰；激怒（第三人称单数）

confusables.diff: insects 是昆虫的正式总称，bugs 泛指小虫且更口语。
errors 泛指错误，bugs 特指软件或系统中的缺陷。
bothers 指使人烦恼，bugs 作动词时更口语且程度较轻。

examples.quote: Just as some ants farm the bugs called aphids for the honeydew they produce when they feed, so Google farms us for the data that our digital lives yield.
The development team spent weeks tracking down the bugs that caused the system to crash.
examples.cn: 开发团队花了几周时间追踪导致系统崩溃的缺陷。

examples.quote: She bugs me with constant questions whenever I am trying to concentrate.
examples.cn: 每当我试图集中注意力时，她就不断提问烦我。

confusables.diff: mass 强调物质的质量或成团状态，bulk 强调数量之大或体积之大。
volume 多指容器容积或液体体积，也可指总量，bulk 更强调主体或大部分。

examples.quote: That is before we look for the space to grow the grains, sugars, seeds and oils that provide us with the vast bulk of our current calorie intake.
The bulk of the company's revenue still comes from its traditional manufacturing sector.
examples.cn: 公司的大部分收入仍来自其传统制造业。

examples.quote: Buying raw materials in bulk can significantly reduce production costs.
examples.cn: 大量购买原材料可以显著降低生产成本。

confusables.diff: bear指股市看跌者（空头），与bull（多头）相对。
ox指阉割过的公牛，常用于役用；bull指未阉割的公牛。
bull是名词，bullish是形容词，表示看涨的。

phrases.en: take the bull by the horns
phrases.cn: 不畏艰险；勇敢面对困难

examples.quote: Investors remain optimistic as the bull market continues to push stock prices to new highs.
examples.cn: 随着牛市持续将股价推至新高，投资者保持乐观。

examples.quote: He decided to take the bull by the horns and confront the problem directly.
examples.cn: 他决定勇敢面对困难，直接解决这个问题。

meanings.cn: 项目符号（列表中用的小圆点等）

confusables.diff: ballot 指无记名投票或选票，与子弹无关，但拼写相近易混。
