confusables.diff: occur 意为“发生”，与 incur 拼写相近但含义无关。
acquire 意为“获得”，而 incur 多指招致负面结果。

examples.quote: The company incurred substantial losses during the economic downturn.
examples.cn: 在经济衰退期间，该公司遭受了巨大损失。

examples.quote: Any expenses incurred during the trip will be reimbursed.
examples.cn: 旅途中产生的任何费用都将予以报销。

meanings.cn: 索引；（物价、工资等的）指数
为……编索引；使……与指数挂钩

confusables.diff: index 是名词“索引/指数”或动词“编索引”，indicate 是动词“表明、指示”，拼写形近但词性与词义不同。
indicator 指“指标、指示器”，是具体可数名词；index 侧重“指数”这一统计比值或书后索引。

examples.quote: The consumer price index rose by 2.3 percent last month, slightly above market expectations.
examples.cn: 上月消费者价格指数上涨2.3%，略高于市场预期。

examples.quote: Pensions are indexed to inflation so that retirees do not lose purchasing power over time.
examples.cn: 养老金与通胀挂钩，以免退休人员随时间推移丧失购买力。

meanings.cn: 迹象；表明（某事存在的）证据

confusables.diff: indicator 是可数名词，指具体的指标、指示器；indications 多指抽象的迹象或征候。
单数形式指单个迹象；复数 indications 常指多方面的迹象或证据。

examples.quote: There are some indications that it is preparing to do just that.
There are clear indications that the economy is recovering from the recent downturn.
examples.cn: 有明显迹象表明，经济正在从近期的不景气中复苏。

examples.quote: Doctors should consider the patient's age and other indications before prescribing the drug.
examples.cn: 医生在开药前应考虑患者的年龄及其他适应症。

confusables.diff: indexes 指索引或指数（如价格指数），indicators 更泛指衡量或显示情况的指标。
signals 强调传递信息的信号，indicators 强调反映某种状况的量化或客观标志。

examples.quote: Rising unemployment and falling consumer spending are clear indicators of an economic slowdown.
examples.cn: 失业率上升和消费支出下降是经济放缓的明显迹象。

examples.quote: Researchers use various indicators to measure the effectiveness of public health policies.
examples.cn: 研究人员使用多种指标来衡量公共卫生政策的有效性。

meanings.cn: 不感兴趣的；无动于衷的

confusables.diff: different 意为“不同的”，indifferent 则指“漠不关心的”，前缀 in- 并非否定“不同”。
uninterested 指“不感兴趣的”，indifferent 还可含“冷淡、无动于衷”之意，语义更宽。
impartial 强调“公正不偏的”，indifferent 强调“漠不关心的”，二者情感色彩不同。

examples.quote: As a linguist once said, "You can get people to think it's nonsense at the same time that you buy into it." In a workplace that's fundamentally indifferent to your life and its meaning, office speak can help you figure out how you relate to your work – and how your work defines who you are.
Many young people seem indifferent to the political issues that once aroused their parents' passion.
examples.cn: 许多年轻人似乎对曾经激起他们父辈热情的政治议题漠不关心。

examples.quote: A good teacher cannot afford to be indifferent to the emotional needs of students.
examples.cn: 一位好老师不能对学生情感上的需求无动于衷。

meanings.cn: 愤怒的，愤慨的（尤指因不公正之事）

confusables.diff: indignant 是形容词，indignation 是对应的名词，表“愤慨”。
indignant 意为“愤慨的”，indigenous 意为“本土的、土著的”，二者形近但义异。

examples.quote: So, if people disagree with you, don't be indignant.
She was indignant at the way her colleagues had been treated.
examples.cn: 她对同事们所受的待遇感到愤慨。

examples.quote: Many readers were indignant about the newspaper's one-sided report.
examples.cn: 许多读者对这家报纸片面的报道感到愤慨。

meanings.cn: 必不可少的，不可或缺的

confusables.diff: essential 强调事物本质必需，indispensable 强调缺了就无法运转，语气更强。
vital 侧重对生存或成功至关重要，indispensable 更强调不可替代性。

examples.quote: "Idleness is not just a vacation, an indulgence or a vice; it is as indispensable to the brain as vitamin D is to the body…[idleness] is, paradoxically, necessary to getting any work done," he argues.
A reliable public transport system is indispensable to the sustainable development of large cities.
examples.cn: 可靠的公共交通系统对于大城市的可持续发展不可或缺。

examples.quote: In modern research, statistical literacy has become an indispensable tool for scholars in almost every discipline.
examples.cn: 在现代研究中，统计素养已成为几乎所有学科学者不可或缺的工具。

meanings.cn: 诱因；刺激物；促使某人做某事的事物

confusables.diff: inducements 是其复数形式，单数指单个诱因，复数强调多种激励因素。
incentive 侧重鼓励努力或购买的外部奖励，inducement 更强调诱使某人采取行动。
temptation 侧重内心想做的欲望，inducements 多为外部提供的诱因或条件。

examples.quote: Fast-food chains should also stop offering "inducements" such as toys, cute animals and mobile phone credit to lure young customers, Stephenson said.
The company offered generous financial inducements to attract experienced engineers to the remote branch.
examples.cn: 该公司提供了优厚的经济激励，以吸引有经验的工程师前往偏远的分公司。

examples.quote: Economists argue that such inducements may distort market competition rather than improve efficiency.
examples.cn: 经济学家认为，此类诱因可能扭曲市场竞争，而非提高效率。

meanings.cn: 沉迷于，尽情享受（常与 in 连用）

confusables.diff: indulge 是动词，indulgent 是形容词，表示“纵容的、宽容的”。
indulge 是动词，indulgence 是名词，指“放纵、沉溺或嗜好”。

examples.quote: If we adults could indulge in a bit of silliness and giggling, we would reduce the stress hormones in our bodies, increase good hormones like endorphins, improve blood flow to our hearts and even have a greater chance of fighting off infection.
Parents who indulge their children too much may hamper their independence.
examples.cn: 过分纵容孩子的父母可能会妨碍孩子独立。

examples.quote: After the exam, she indulged in a long, uninterrupted sleep.
examples.cn: 考试结束后，她尽情地睡了个长久安稳的觉。

confusables.diff: indulgence 是名词，indulgent 是形容词，表示纵容的、溺爱的。
tolerance 指对异己的容忍度，indulgence 指对自己欲望的放纵。

examples.quote: "Idleness is not just a vacation, an indulgence or a vice; it is as indispensable to the brain as vitamin D is to the body…[idleness] is, paradoxically, necessary to getting any work done," he argues.
Excessive indulgence in screen time has been linked to declining attention spans among teenagers.
examples.cn: 过度沉溺于屏幕使用已被认为与青少年注意力持续时间下降有关。

examples.quote: His parents' indulgence left him ill-prepared for the frustrations of adult life.
examples.cn: 父母的纵容使他对成年生活的挫折缺乏准备。

confusables.diff: industrial 指工业的，industrious 指勤奋的。
industrial 指工业的，industrialized 指已实现工业化的。

examples.quote: The concept of man versus machine is at least as old as the industrial revolution, but this phenomenon tends to be most acutely felt during economic downturns and fragile recoveries.
The government has introduced new policies to reduce industrial pollution.
examples.cn: 政府已出台新政策以减少工业污染。

examples.quote: Many industrial areas have suffered from economic decline in recent decades.
examples.cn: 近几十年来，许多工业区遭受了经济衰退。

meanings.cn: 工业家；实业家；产业界人士

confusables.diff: industrialism 指工业主义或工业化制度，而 industrialists 指从事工业的人。
entrepreneurs 强调创办企业、承担风险的创业者，industrialists 更侧重工业领域的实业经营者。

examples.quote: By contrast, the Victorian author Samuel Smiles wrote Self-Help as a catalogue of the worthy lives of engineers, industrialists and explorers.
Several prominent industrialists urged the government to reduce taxes on manufacturing.
examples.cn: 几位知名实业家敦促政府降低制造业税收。

examples.quote: The conference attracted industrialists from across the country to discuss energy policy.
examples.cn: 这次会议吸引了全国各地实业家前来讨论能源政策。

confusables.diff: ineffective 指达不到预期效果，inefficient 指效率低、耗费多。
ineffectual 更强调人做事徒劳无功，ineffective 更常用于方法、措施或药物。
futile 强调努力本身注定徒劳，ineffective 强调手段未能产生效果。

examples.quote: Harford argues that inevitable distractions often render the daily to-do list ineffective, while leaving room for improvisation in such a list can reap the best results.
The agency concluded that the current policy had been largely ineffective in curbing speculation, and urged a more targeted approach.
examples.cn: 该机构得出结论，认为现行政策在遏制投机方面基本无效，并敦促采取更有针对性的办法。

examples.quote: Punitive measures alone are often ineffective, as they fail to address the underlying causes of the problem.
examples.cn: 仅靠惩罚性措施往往无效，因为它们未能解决问题的根本原因。

meanings.cn: （具体的）效率低下的环节或做法

confusables.diff: inefficiency 强调投入产出比低、浪费时间资源，ineffectiveness 强调未能达到预期效果。
inefficiency 指效率低下，ineptitude 指能力不足、笨拙无能。

examples.quote: Immersive reading, by contrast, depends on being willing to risk inefficiency, goallessness, even time-wasting.
The report blamed bureaucratic inefficiency for the delay in delivering public services.
examples.cn: 该报告将公共服务交付延迟归咎于官僚机构的低效率。

examples.quote: Managers are under pressure to cut costs by eliminating inefficiency in the production process.
examples.cn: 管理者面临压力，需通过消除生产过程中的低效来削减成本。

meanings.cn: 不公平的事；不公正待遇

confusables.diff: inequality 泛指不平等、差距（如收入差距），inequity 强调不公正、不公平，带有道德评判色彩。
iniquity 指邪恶、极不道德的行为，语气比 inequity 重得多，且拼写少一个 e。

examples.quote: In my own research, complaints from women about their husbands most often focused not on tangible inequities such as having given up the chance for a career to accompany a husband to his, or doing far more than their share of daily life-support work like cleaning, cooking and social arrangements.
The report highlights persistent inequities in access to higher education across rural and urban areas.
examples.cn: 该报告凸显了城乡地区在获得高等教育方面持续存在的不平等。

examples.quote: Policymakers must confront the structural inequities that keep disadvantaged groups trapped in poverty.
examples.cn: 决策者必须正视使弱势群体陷入贫困的结构性不平等。

confusables.diff: infectious 是形容词“传染性的”，infection 是名词“感染”。
contagion 强调疾病接触传染，infection 泛指病原体侵入引起的感染。

examples.quote: If we adults could indulge in a bit of silliness and giggling, we would reduce the stress hormones in our bodies, increase good hormones like endorphins, improve blood flow to our hearts and even have a greater chance of fighting off infection.
Hospitals are taking stricter measures to reduce the risk of infection among patients.
examples.cn: 医院正采取更严格的措施以降低患者的感染风险。

examples.quote: The infection spread rapidly through crowded neighborhoods before health workers could respond.
examples.cn: 在卫生工作者做出反应之前，这种传染病在拥挤的社区迅速蔓延。

confusables.diff: inferior 是形容词或指“地位较低者”，inferiority 是抽象名词，指低劣或自卑的状态。

examples.quote: Working with your hands is seen as almost a mark of inferiority.
Comparing yourself constantly with others can breed a deep sense of inferiority.
examples.cn: 不断将自己与他人比较会滋生深深的自卑感。

examples.quote: The inferiority of the material was obvious once the product began to wear out quickly.
examples.cn: 产品很快磨损后，这种材料的劣质便显而易见。

meanings.cn: （人、政策等）不灵活的；固执的；不可变更的

confusables.diff: inflexion 是名词，指屈折变化或语调变化，与形容词 inflexible 形近但词性不同。
reflexible 意为可反射的、可折回的，前缀不同，含义与 inflexible 相反。
unyielding 强调不屈服、不让步，多指态度强硬；inflexible 更侧重缺乏弹性、不可改变。

examples.quote: Unified has produced an inflexible policy which mandates that with the exception of some advanced courses, homework may no longer count for more than 10% of a student's academic grade.
The company's inflexible policies have alienated many talented employees.
examples.cn: 公司僵化的政策已经让许多有才华的员工心生疏远。

examples.quote: Critics argue that an inflexible approach to reform will only deepen the crisis.
examples.cn: 批评者认为，改革方式缺乏灵活性只会加深危机。

meanings.cn: 轻松友好的；不拘礼节的

confusables.diff: formal 指正式的、拘谨的，informal 是其反义词，指非正式、随意的。
casual 强调随意、随便（也可指偶然的），informal 侧重不符合正式规范或礼节。

examples.quote: "A useful map can be created by looking at even a few key parameters." For example, neighborhoods with a large elderly population or informal dwellings that cope poorly with heat could get special warnings or be bolstered with cooling centers.
The two leaders held an informal discussion before the formal summit began.
examples.cn: 正式峰会开始前，两位领导人进行了非正式讨论。

examples.quote: Informal language is acceptable in personal emails but not in academic writing.
examples.cn: 口语体语言在私人邮件中可以接受，但在学术写作中则不行。

confusables.diff: unfrequent 为少见变体，通常用 infrequent 表示“不常发生的”。
rare 强调稀有、珍贵或极少出现；infrequent 强调发生间隔长、次数少。

examples.quote: People complained that buses were late and infrequent.
Although infrequent, such errors can seriously damage a company's reputation.
examples.cn: 尽管不常发生，这类错误仍可能严重损害公司声誉。

examples.quote: His infrequent visits to the library made it hard for him to keep up with the reading.
examples.cn: 他很少去图书馆，因此很难跟上阅读进度。

confusables.diff: instill 强调逐步灌输观念或品质，infuse 强调注入活力、情感等使之充满。
与 suffuse 形近，suffuse 指（色彩、光线等）弥漫、布满，多用于被动。

examples.quote: These terms are also intended to infuse work with meaning – and, as Rakesh Khurana, another professor, points out, increase allegiance to the firm.
The new coach infused the team with confidence and energy.
examples.cn: 新教练给球队注入了信心和活力。

examples.quote: Her words infused a sense of hope into the discouraged students.
examples.cn: 她的话给灰心的学生们注入了一种希望感。

confusables.diff: elements 泛指元素或要素，ingredients 特指混合物中的成分或烹饪原料。
components 强调组成整体的部件，多用于机械或系统；ingredients 多用于食物或抽象因素。

examples.quote: Impulsive spending isn't an option, so plan your week's menu in advance, making shopping lists for your ingredients in their exact quantities.
The recipe calls for simple ingredients that are readily available in any supermarket.
examples.cn: 这道菜谱所需的原料很简单，在任何超市都能买到。

examples.quote: Trust and communication are the key ingredients of a successful partnership.
examples.cn: 信任与沟通是成功合作的关键要素。

meanings.cn: 使初步了解，引导（某人）加入

confusables.diff: begin 最通用，强调起点；initiate 更正式，常指发起或启动复杂过程或仪式。
launch 强调推出（产品、活动）或发射；initiate 强调使某过程开始。

phrases.cn: 引导某人加入（某团体或活动）

examples.quote: The company initiated a new training program for fresh employees.
examples.cn: 公司为应届员工发起了一项新的培训计划。

examples.quote: New members were initiated into the club at a formal ceremony.
examples.cn: 新成员在正式仪式上被引入俱乐部。

confusables.diff: ignorance 指无知、不了解，innocence 指无罪或天真。
innocuous 是形容词，指无害的；innocence 是名词，指清白。

examples.quote: Then it presents that connection, even among two-year-olds, between girls as not only innocent but as evidence of innocence.
The lawyer fought for years to prove his client's innocence.
examples.cn: 律师多年来一直努力证明当事人无罪。

examples.quote: She asked the question in all innocence, unaware of the tension it would cause.
examples.cn: 她完全是天真地发问，没有意识到这会引起多大的紧张。

confusables.diff: invent 指发明前所未有的东西，innovate 强调在现有基础上引入新方法或改进。
renovate 指修复翻新旧建筑等，innovate 指方法、技术或观念上的创新。
imitate 是模仿照搬，innovate 是创造新事物，二者语义相反。

examples.quote: So then the problem is not really about technology, but rather, "how do we innovate our institutions and our work practices?"
Firms that fail to innovate are likely to lose ground to more agile competitors.
examples.cn: 未能创新的公司很可能在与更灵活的竞争对手的较量中落败。

examples.quote: The company encourages employees to innovate rather than follow established routines.
examples.cn: 该公司鼓励员工创新，而不是遵循既定常规。

confusables.diff: unfortunate 指不幸的、令人遗憾的，inopportune 强调时机不恰当而非运气不好。
untimely 侧重过早或不合时宜地发生，常含负面结果；inopportune 更强调时机选择不当。

examples.quote: Hard times may hold you down at what usually seems like the most inopportune time, but you should remember that they won't last forever.
The announcement came at an inopportune moment, just as the company was struggling to reassure investors.
examples.cn: 这一声明发布得极不合时宜，正值公司努力安抚投资者之际。

examples.quote: He regretted making such an inopportune remark during the delicate negotiations.
examples.cn: 他后悔在微妙的谈判期间说了如此不合时宜的话。

meanings.cn: 输入；投入（资源、信息、意见等）
输入（数据）；提供（意见、信息）

confusables.diff: input 指输入或投入，output 指产出或输出，二者方向相反。
input 为输入；impute 意为把……归咎于，形近但义异。

examples.quote: While these apps have a great deal to offer, it is not always clear how the personal information we input is collected, safeguarded and shared online.
Public input is essential before the government finalizes the new policy.
examples.cn: 政府在最终确定新政策之前，公众意见至关重要。

examples.quote: Researchers input the survey data into a statistical model for analysis.
examples.cn: 研究人员将调查数据输入统计模型进行分析。

meanings.cn: 贪得无厌的（对欲望、好奇心等）

confusables.diff: unsatisfied 指需求未被满足的状态，insatiable 指欲望本身无法被满足。
insatiate 为较罕用的同义词，语体更书面古旧，insatiable 更常用。

examples.quote: Since technology has such an insatiable appetite for eating up human jobs, this phenomenon will continue to restructure our economy in ways we cannot immediately foresee.
Consumers seem to have an insatiable appetite for new electronic gadgets.
examples.cn: 消费者对新款电子产品的欲望似乎永无止境。

examples.quote: Her insatiable curiosity about the natural world drove her into a career in science.
examples.cn: 她对自然界永不满足的好奇心促使她投身科学事业。

meanings.cn: 不安全感；无把握；局促不安

confusables.diff: uncertainties 侧重客观情况的不确定性，insecurities 侧重主观心理上的不安全感。
insecurity 是单数形式，指不安全感本身；insecurities 为复数，常指种种具体的不安或自卑之处。

examples.quote: Nor was there any evidence that those who self-enhanced the most (that is, the participants who thought the most positively doctored pictures were real) were doing so to make up for profound insecurities.
Many young graduates conceal their insecurities behind an air of confidence.
examples.cn: 许多年轻毕业生用自信的姿态掩饰内心的不安全感。

examples.quote: Social media often amplifies people's insecurities about appearance and status.
examples.cn: 社交媒体常常放大人们对外貌和地位的不安全感。

meanings.cn: 暗中为害的；潜伏的；不知不觉间造成严重危害的

confusables.diff: invidious 意为招人嫉妒的、令人反感的，侧重引发不满；insidious 侧重隐蔽渐进地造成危害。
insinuating 指含沙射影的、暗示的，侧重言语暗示；insidious 强调危害的隐蔽渐进。

examples.quote: But he's also found a kind of insidious prejudice.
The insidious spread of misinformation online has undermined public trust in science.
examples.cn: 网络虚假信息的暗中蔓延已削弱了公众对科学的信任。

examples.quote: Ageism can be so insidious that even its victims fail to recognize it.
examples.cn: 年龄歧视可能极其隐蔽，以至于连受害者都未能察觉。

confusables.diff: insistency 为罕见变体，现代英语中几乎只用 insistence。
persistence 强调持续不懈的努力或状态，insistence 强调坚决主张或要求。

examples.quote: As desire paths criss-cross through both physical and virtual landscapes, they stand as a proof of the collective insistence on forging unconventional routes and embracing the spirit of communal choice.
Her insistence on strict adherence to the rules often frustrated her colleagues.
examples.cn: 她坚持严格遵守规则，这常常让同事们感到沮丧。

examples.quote: At the insistence of the manager, the meeting was postponed until next week.
examples.cn: 在经理的坚决要求下，会议被推迟到下周。

confusables.diff: aspiration 指志向、渴望，inspiration 指灵感或鼓舞。
perspiration 指汗水，与 inspiration 形近但义异。
motivation 指行动的动力，inspiration 侧重创作灵感或精神鼓舞。

examples.quote: Today, we want empathy, not inspiration.
Many designers draw inspiration from nature, translating its forms into practical products.
examples.cn: 许多设计师从自然中汲取灵感，将其形态转化为实用产品。

examples.quote: Her courage in adversity became an inspiration to colleagues facing similar difficulties.
examples.cn: 她在逆境中的勇气鼓舞了面临类似困难的同事。

meanings.cn: 安装（install 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: install 是动词原形，installed 是过去式/过去分词或形容词。
installment 是名词，指分期付款或连载的一部分，与“安装”无关。

examples.quote: Brian Berry, chief executive of the Federation of Master Builders, says the measures will require new materials, testing methods, products and systems to be installed.
The newly installed equipment has significantly reduced energy consumption in the factory.
examples.cn: 新安装的设备显著降低了工厂的能耗。

examples.quote: Once installed, the software automatically updates itself to guard against new threats.
examples.cn: 一旦安装完成，该软件会自动更新以防范新的威胁。

confusables.diff: intuition 侧重基于经验的直觉判断，instinct 强调与生俱来的本能反应。
impulse 指一时的冲动，instinct 指稳定的内在本能。

examples.quote: Birds build nests by instinct rather than by learning from their parents.
examples.cn: 鸟类筑巢是出于本能，而非向父母学习。

examples.quote: Her instinct told her that something was wrong, even before the evidence appeared.
examples.cn: 她的直觉告诉她出了问题，甚至在证据出现之前。

confusables.diff: intuitively 强调基于经验与感觉的直觉判断，instinctively 强调与生俱来的本能反应。
instinctive 是形容词，instinctively 是对应的副词。

examples.quote: Instead, they look after their wellbeing instinctively, and usually more effectively than we do as grownups.
When the car suddenly swerved, she instinctively grabbed the handle and braced herself.
examples.cn: 当汽车突然转向时，她本能地抓住把手，稳住身体。

examples.quote: Experienced doctors often instinctively sense that something is wrong before tests confirm it.
examples.cn: 经验丰富的医生常常在检查证实之前就本能地感到情况不对。

confusables.diff: teacher 泛指教师，instructor 更强调技能训练或专业指导。
professor 指大学教授，instructor 在美国大学中常指级别较低的讲师。

examples.quote: The high-schoolers get the same curriculum, but "we try to gear lessons toward things they're interested in," said Victoria Friedman, an instructor.
The instructor advised us to practice the presentation until we felt completely confident.
examples.cn: 导师建议我们反复练习演讲，直到完全自信为止。

examples.quote: As a part-time instructor, she teaches two writing courses each semester.
examples.cn: 作为兼职讲师，她每学期教两门写作课。

meanings.cn: 起重要作用地；作为手段地；在乐器演奏方面

confusables.diff: instrumental 是形容词（起作用的；乐器的），instrumentally 是其副词形式。
intentionally 意为“故意地”，与 instrumentally 词形相近但含义无关。

examples.quote: Thinking of time as a resource to be maximised means you approach it instrumentally, judging any given moment as well spent only in so far as it advances progress toward some goal.
Education is valued not only instrumentally but also for its intrinsic worth.
examples.cn: 教育不仅因其工具价值而受到重视，也因其内在价值而受到重视。

examples.quote: She was instrumentally involved in negotiating the agreement between the two firms.
examples.cn: 她在两家公司协议的谈判中发挥了关键作用。

confusables.diff: isolated 强调孤立、分离的状态，insulated 强调被隔离保护或绝缘隔热。
insular 指思想狭隘或岛屿的，insulated 指物理隔绝或受保护。

examples.quote: "There are new rules concerning the amount of glazing used in extensions, and any new windows or doors must be highly insulated."
The wealthy community remains insulated from the economic hardships facing the rest of the country.
examples.cn: 这个富裕社区与全国其他地方面临的经济困难相隔绝。

examples.quote: Properly insulated buildings can significantly reduce energy consumption in winter.
examples.cn: 隔热良好的建筑能显著降低冬季的能源消耗。

meanings.cn: 绝缘（材料）；隔热（材料）；隔音（材料）
隔离；保护（免受不良影响）

confusables.diff: isolation 指人或群体的孤立、隔离状态，insulation 多指物质上的绝缘隔热或对不良影响的保护。
insulator 是可数名词，指绝缘体、绝缘子这类具体物体；insulation 指绝缘材料或绝缘状态。

examples.quote: "The biggest changes relate to heating and insulation," he explains.
Proper insulation of the roof can significantly reduce heat loss in winter.
examples.cn: 屋顶恰当的隔热措施能显著减少冬季的热量流失。

examples.quote: Many families live in social insulation, cut off from the support of relatives and friends.
examples.cn: 许多家庭处于社会孤立之中，与亲友的支持相隔绝。

meanings.cn: 完好无损的，完整无缺的
未受损伤的，未被破坏的

confusables.diff: integral 意为“不可或缺的、完整的组成部分的”，强调必要性；intact 强调未经损坏的完整状态。
entire 指“全部的、整个的”，侧重范围完整；intact 侧重未受损伤、保持原样。

examples.quote: An economic survey of 700 U.S. taxpayers found that people would be willing to pay a significant amount of money to make sure the parks and their programs are kept intact.
Despite the earthquake, the ancient temple remained largely intact.
examples.cn: 尽管发生了地震，这座古庙大体上仍完好无损。

examples.quote: Preserving the original manuscript intact is essential for future research.
examples.cn: 保持原稿完整无损对未来的研究至关重要。

confusables.diff: combine 强调把事物混合在一起，integrate 强调各部分结合成一个协调的整体。
merge 指两个事物合为一个，常含消失个体界限之意；integrate 强调在保持各自功能的前提下形成统一体系。

examples.quote: Yet, reluctance persists among other planners to integrate desire paths into formal plans, citing concerns about safety, environmental impact, or primarily, aesthetics.
The new system is designed to integrate data from various sources into a single platform.
examples.cn: 新系统旨在将来自不同来源的数据整合到一个平台中。

examples.quote: Immigrants often struggle to integrate into the local community.
examples.cn: 移民往往难以融入当地社区。

confusables.diff: honesty 指不说谎、不欺骗的诚实品质；integrity 更强调道德原则上的坚定与不受腐蚀。
integration 指整合、融合的过程；integrity 指完整或正直，二者形近但义异。

examples.quote: "The valuable examples which they furnish of the power of self-help, of patient purpose, resolute working, and steadfast integrity, issuing in the formation of truly noble and manly character, exhibit," wrote Smiles, "what it is in the power of each to accomplish for himself." His biographies of James Watt, Richard Arkwright and Josiah Wedgwood were held up as beacons to guide the working man through his difficult life.
Public trust depends on the integrity of officials who hold power.
examples.cn: 公众的信任取决于掌权官员的正直。

examples.quote: The scandal raised serious doubts about the integrity of the election.
examples.cn: 这起丑闻使人们对选举的公正性产生了严重怀疑。

meanings.cn: 才智出众的人；知识分子

confusables.diff: intelligence 侧重智能、情报或理解力，intellect 更强调理性思维能力与学术才智。
intellectual 是形容词“智力的”或名词“知识分子”，intellect 只作名词指智力本身。

examples.quote: Facebook, therefore, is a self-enhancer's paradise, where people can share only the most flattering photos, the cream of their wit, style, beauty, intellect and lifestyles.
The debate was less an appeal to emotion than a challenge to the intellect.
examples.cn: 这场辩论与其说是诉诸情感，不如说是对智力的挑战。

examples.quote: She was admired not for her wealth but for her formidable intellect.
examples.cn: 她受人钦佩的不是财富，而是她过人的才智。

confusables.diff: intense 指程度强烈，intensive 指集中密集、短时间内强化。
intense 是形容词表强烈，intent 作形容词意为专注的、坚决的，作名词意为意图。

examples.quote: And if Sadiq Khan wins and extends it to the North and South Circular roads in 2021 as he intends, it is sure to spark intense opposition from the far larger number of motorists who will then be affected.
The intense competition for scarce resources has forced companies to rethink their strategies.
examples.cn: 对稀缺资源的激烈竞争迫使公司重新思考其战略。

examples.quote: She felt intense pressure to meet the deadline while maintaining high standards.
examples.cn: 她在保持高标准的同时，感受到了赶在截止日期前完成的巨大压力。

confusables.diff: intently 强调注意力专注地，intensively 强调强度大、密度高。
extensively 指范围广泛地，intensively 指在有限范围内高强度地进行。

examples.quote: To become much more self-sufficient, the UK would need to drastically reduce its consumption of animal foods, and probably also farm more intensively—meaning fewer green fields and more factory-style production.
Students who study intensively for short periods often retain more than those who cram for hours.
examples.cn: 短时间高强度学习的学生，往往比连续苦读数小时的学生记得更牢。

examples.quote: The land has been farmed so intensively that its soil is now severely depleted.
examples.cn: 这片土地被如此集约化地耕作，以致其土壤如今已严重贫瘠。

confusables.diff: intent 强调专注或决心，常作名词；intentional 强调故意性，作形容词。
deliberate 强调经过深思熟虑的故意，语气更正式；intentional 泛指有意的。

examples.quote: Although the Supreme Court of the United States had prohibited intentional racial discrimination in jury selection as early as the 1880 case of Strauder v.
The court ruled that the damage was intentional and awarded compensation to the plaintiff.
examples.cn: 法院裁定该损害是故意的，并判给原告赔偿。

examples.quote: Her silence was not accidental but intentional, designed to provoke a response.
examples.cn: 她的沉默并非偶然，而是有意的，旨在引发回应。

meanings.cn: 跨学科的；涉及多学科的

confusables.diff: multidisciplinary 强调多学科并列参与，interdisciplinary 强调学科间交叉融合。

examples.quote: The university encourages interdisciplinary research that bridges computer science and biology.
examples.cn: 这所大学鼓励连接计算机科学与生物学的跨学科研究。

examples.quote: Solving climate change requires an interdisciplinary approach involving economics, physics and policy.
examples.cn: 解决气候变化需要融合经济学、物理学和政策的跨学科方法。

confusables.diff: interface 指连接或交互，interfere 指干涉、妨碍，二者形近但义不同。
surface 指表面，interface 指两事物之间的交界面或连接点。

phrases.cn: A 与 B 之间的接口

examples.quote: Businesses should engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams to review their privacy policy, and include in the discussion the customer/user experience designers and coders responsible for the company's user interface, as well as the marketers and advertisers responsible for sign-ups, checkout baskets, pricing, and promotions.
The new software provides a simple interface that allows users to access data quickly.
examples.cn: 这款新软件提供了一个简洁的界面，使用户能够快速访问数据。

examples.quote: Researchers are studying how the interface between technology and education affects learning.
examples.cn: 研究人员正在研究技术与教育之间的交互如何影响学习。

confusables.diff: intervene 指介入以调停或阻止，interfere 多指无权或不当的干涉。
disturb 强调扰乱安宁或进程，interfere 强调对他人事务的妨碍。

examples.quote: There is no experimental evidence showing that it interferes with our ability to focus, for instance, wrote psychologists Christopher Chabris and Daniel J.
Constant noise from the construction site interferes with residents' sleep and work.
examples.cn: 建筑工地持续的噪音妨碍了居民的睡眠和工作。

examples.quote: Parents should guide their children rather than interfere in every decision they make.
examples.cn: 父母应当引导孩子，而不是干涉他们所做的每一个决定。

confusables.diff: temporary 泛指临时性的，interim 特指两阶段之间过渡期的临时安排。
provisional 强调暂定、有待正式确认，interim 强调时间上的过渡与衔接。

examples.quote: An interim government was formed to oversee the country until elections could be held.
examples.cn: 一个过渡政府成立，负责在举行选举前管理国家。

examples.quote: The committee published an interim report, with the final findings due next year.
examples.cn: 委员会发布了一份中期报告，最终结论将于明年公布。

confusables.diff: intermittent 是形容词，intermittently 是对应的副词。
occasionally 侧重“偶尔发生”，intermittently 强调“时断时续、有间歇”。

examples.quote: Our ability to mute our hard-wired reactions by pausing is what differentiates us from animals: dogs can think about the future only intermittently or for a few minutes.
The disease has recurred intermittently over the past decade, puzzling doctors.
examples.cn: 过去十年间，这种疾病间歇性复发，令医生们困惑不解。

examples.quote: Signals from the remote station were received intermittently because of atmospheric interference.
examples.cn: 由于大气干扰，来自偏远站点的信号只能断断续续地收到。

confusables.diff: personal 强调个人的、私人的，interpersonal 特指人与人之间相互关系的。
intrapersonal 指个人内心的，interpersonal 指人际之间的，前缀 intra- 与 inter- 相反。

examples.quote: But snap decisions in reaction to rapid stimuli aren't exclusive to the interpersonal realm.
Good interpersonal skills are essential for teamwork and career advancement.
examples.cn: 良好的人际交往技能对团队合作和职业发展至关重要。

examples.quote: The study examines how interpersonal relationships affect employees' mental health.
examples.cn: 该研究考察人际关系如何影响员工的心理健康。

confusables.diff: interaction 泛指相互影响或交流，interplay 更强调多个因素彼此交织、相互制约的动态关系。
interweave 是动词，指编织或交织在一起；interplay 多为名词，侧重相互作用的过程。

phrases.en: the interplay between A and B

examples.quote: Ambady suspected that deliberation focused them on vivid but misleading cues, such as certain gestures or utterances, rather than letting the complex interplay of subtle signals form a holistic impression.
The study examines the interplay between economic policy and social change.
examples.cn: 该研究考察经济政策与社会变迁之间的相互作用。

examples.quote: Success often depends on the subtle interplay of talent and opportunity.
examples.cn: 成功往往取决于才能与机遇之间微妙的相互作用。

confusables.diff: explain 侧重说明原因或机理，interpret 侧重对含义、意图的主观理解与阐释。
translate 指书面或语言的逐字转换，interpret 多指口头即时翻译。
interrupt 意为打断、中断，与 interpret 拼写相近但意义无关。

examples.quote: Urban planners interpret desire paths as more than just convenient shortcuts; they offer valuable insights into the dynamics between planning and behaviour.
Scholars still disagree about how to interpret the ambiguous wording of the clause.
examples.cn: 学者们对该条款含糊措辞的解读仍存在分歧。

examples.quote: She was asked to interpret for the foreign delegation at the negotiation.
examples.cn: 她被安排在那场谈判中为外国代表团做口译。

confusables.diff: interception 指拦截、截取（如传球、信息），interruption 指打断或中断。
disruption 强调造成混乱的扰乱、中断，语气更重；interruption 多指一般性的打断。

examples.quote: The modern mind, Tim Parks, a novelist and critic, writes, "is overwhelmingly inclined toward communication… It is not simply that one is interrupted; it is that one is actually inclined to interruption." Deep reading requires not just time, but a special kind of time which can't be obtained merely by becoming more efficient.
He worked on the report for three hours without interruption.
examples.cn: 他不间断地写了三个小时报告。

examples.quote: Frequent interruptions made it difficult for her to concentrate on the task.
examples.cn: 频繁的打扰使她难以专心完成任务。

meanings.cn: （时间或空间上）介于其间的，中间的

confusables.diff: intervenient 更强调‘起干预作用的’，极少用；intervening 侧重‘介于中间的’。
intermediate 指等级或阶段居中的；intervening 强调夹在两个时间点或事物之间。

examples.quote: Translated, that means politicians intervening in monetary policy and a system of redistribution from richer to poorer members, via cheaper borrowing for governments through common Eurobonds or complete fiscal transfers.
In the intervening years, the small town has grown into a bustling city.
examples.cn: 在其间的这些年里，这个小镇已发展成一座繁华的城市。

examples.quote: The intervening distance between the two villages is less than a mile.
examples.cn: 两个村庄之间的间隔距离不到一英里。

confusables.diff: intimate 意为暗示或亲密，intimidate 意为恐吓威胁，拼写相近但词义截然不同。
作形容词时重音在首音节，作动词时重音在末音节，词性与读音需区分。

examples.quote: Dr. Kroo points out that the aircraft could be separated by several nautical miles, and would not be in the intimate groupings favoured by display teams like the Red Arrows.
She has an intimate knowledge of the workings of the legal system.
examples.cn: 她对法律体系的运作有深入的了解。

examples.quote: He intimated that he might resign if the proposal was rejected.
examples.cn: 他暗示如果提议被否决，他可能会辞职。

confusables.diff: imitations 意为“模仿、仿制品”，而 intimations 指“暗示、预感”，二者形近但词义无关。
hints 是普通意义上的“提示、线索”，intimations 更强调含蓄、间接的暗示或预感。

phrases.cn: 对即将发生变化的隐约感觉

examples.quote: Blue, with its intimations of the Virgin Mary, constancy and faithfulness, symbolised femininity.
The novel offers subtle intimations of the tragedy that will eventually unfold.
examples.cn: 这部小说对最终将发生的悲剧作出了微妙的暗示。

examples.quote: She ignored the first intimations that her health was beginning to fail.
examples.cn: 她忽视了健康开始衰退的最初迹象。

meanings.cn: 令人望而生畏的；气势逼人的

confusables.diff: intimidated 表示“感到害怕的”，主语是人；intimidating 表示“使人害怕的”，修饰事物。
timid 指人天生胆怯、羞怯；intimidating 指外部事物给人造成威慑感。

examples.quote: The dual aim was mixed up: The stress on success over taking part was intimidating for newcomers.
For many candidates, the sheer volume of reading required for the exam can be intimidating.
examples.cn: 对许多考生而言，这场考试所需的庞大阅读量可能令人望而生畏。

examples.quote: She found the interview panel surprisingly intimidating despite their friendly tone.
examples.cn: 尽管面试官语气友善，她仍觉得整个面试小组令人意外地有压迫感。

meanings.cn: 错综复杂的；难以理解的

confusables.diff: complex 强调由多个部分组成而复杂，intricate 强调细节繁多、交织缠绕而难以理清。
complicated 多指因环节多而麻烦难处理，intricate 更侧重结构精细、盘根错节。

examples.quote: What WhatsApp offered Facebook was an intricate and finely detailed web of its users' friendships and social lives.
The novel's plot is so intricate that readers must trace several storylines at once.
examples.cn: 这部小说的情节错综复杂，读者必须同时追踪好几条故事线。

examples.quote: Researchers are still trying to understand the intricate workings of the human brain.
examples.cn: 研究人员仍在努力理解人脑精妙复杂的运作机制。

confusables.diff: intrinsically 强调事物本身固有的、不依赖外部条件的属性；inherently 更侧重作为必然组成部分而天然存在。
intrinsically 强调内在本质属性；essentially 侧重从根本或主要方面来说。

examples.quote: It is not that pink is intrinsically bad, but it is such a tiny slice of the rainbow and, though it may celebrate girlhood in one way, it also repeatedly and firmly fuses girls' identity to appearance.
The task is intrinsically difficult and cannot be made easy by external incentives alone.
examples.cn: 这项任务本身就很困难，仅靠外部激励无法使其变得容易。

examples.quote: Researchers argue that curiosity is intrinsically rewarding, driving people to explore without external pressure.
examples.cn: 研究人员认为好奇心本身具有回报性，促使人们在无外部压力下进行探索。

confusables.diff: intruding 强调正在闯入的动作，intrusive 更常作定语描述侵入性质。
invasive 多指疾病、物种的侵袭扩散，intrusive 侧重对私人空间或安宁的打扰。

examples.quote: We're fairly good at judging people based on first impressions, thin slices of experience ranging from a glimpse of a photo to five-minute interaction, and deliberation can be not only extraneous but intrusive.
Constant notifications make smartphones intrusive companions that fragment our attention throughout the day.
examples.cn: 不断弹出的通知使智能手机成为扰人的伙伴，整天分散我们的注意力。

examples.quote: The new regulations are intended to curb intrusive data collection by technology companies.
examples.cn: 新规旨在遏制科技公司侵入式的数据收集行为。

meanings.cn: 有创造力的；善于创新的

confusables.diff: innovative 强调引入新事物或新方法，inventive 强调发明创造的才能本身。
creative 泛指有创造力，范围更广；inventive 更侧重发明、设计的巧思。

examples.quote: The company encourages an inventive approach to problem-solving rather than relying on conventional methods.
examples.cn: 该公司鼓励用有创意的方法解决问题，而不是依赖传统方法。

examples.quote: Her inventive use of everyday materials impressed the judges at the design competition.
examples.cn: 她对日常材料的创造性运用给设计比赛的评委留下了深刻印象。

confusables.diff: inverse 侧重数量或关系上的反比/相反，而 inverted 强调物理位置或顺序的颠倒。
reverse 指方向或顺序完全相反，inverted 常指上下倒置。
invert 是动词，inverted 是其形容词形式，表示被动或状态。

examples.quote: Dr. Kroo and his team modeled what would happen if three passenger jets departing from Los Angeles, San Francisco and Las Vegas were to assemble over Utah, assume an inverted V-formation, occasionally change places so all could have a turn in the most favourable positions, and proceed to London.
The chart shows an inverted U-shape, suggesting that performance improves up to a point and then declines.
examples.cn: 图表呈倒U形，表明绩效提高到一定程度后便会下降。

examples.quote: An inverted yield curve is often viewed as a warning sign of an impending recession.
examples.cn: 收益率曲线倒挂常被视为经济衰退即将来临的预警信号。

confusables.diff: inquiry 侧重询问、探究原因，investigation 侧重系统调查以查明真相或取证。
examination 强调检查、审查细节，investigation 强调对事件或问题的调查过程。

examples.quote: In 2021, Flo Health faced a Federal Trade Commission (FTC) investigation.
The government has launched an investigation into the causes of the financial crisis.
examples.cn: 政府已对金融危机的原因展开调查。

examples.quote: A thorough investigation is needed before any conclusions can be drawn.
examples.cn: 在得出任何结论之前，需要进行彻底的调查。

confusables.diff: investment 是名词，指投资行为或投入的资金；investing 侧重投资这一持续过程。
inventing 意为发明创造，与 investing 拼写相近但词义无关。

examples.quote: "For decades we have not taken responsibility for investing in our domestic wood supply, leaving us exposed to fluctuating prices and fighting for future supplies of wood as global demand rises and our own supplies fall."
Investing in education yields returns that far exceed those of any financial asset.
examples.cn: 投资教育所带来的回报远超任何金融资产。

examples.quote: Many young people are investing heavily in technology stocks despite the obvious risks.
examples.cn: 尽管风险明显，许多年轻人仍在大量投资科技股。

confusables.diff: investment 是投入的资金或资产，investor 是投入资金的人或机构。
同词根但词性不同：investor 指人，invest 是动词，表示投资行为。

examples.quote: When you remember such things you can automatically become an investor in their wellbeing.
The company reassured investors that the merger would not affect jobs.
examples.cn: 公司向投资者保证合并不会影响就业。

examples.quote: Foreign investors have shown growing interest in the country's tech sector.
examples.cn: 外国投资者对该国科技行业表现出日益浓厚的兴趣。

confusables.diff: irritation 指被激怒的状态或刺激物本身，irritability 指容易发怒的性情倾向。
anger 是一时的愤怒情绪，irritability 是持续易被激怒的脾性。

examples.quote: Lack of sleep can lead to increased irritability and poor concentration.
examples.cn: 睡眠不足会导致烦躁加剧和注意力下降。

examples.quote: The patient's irritability made it difficult for the nurses to communicate with him.
examples.cn: 这位病人脾气暴躁，使护士很难与他沟通。

confusables.diff: article 多指文章或物品，item 更强调清单或系列中的一项。
element 指构成整体的要素，item 指可逐条列出的事项或物件。

examples.quote: Try to slot it in as a to-do list item and you'll manage only goal-focused reading – useful, sometimes, but not the most fulfilling kind.
The committee examined each item on the agenda before reaching a final decision.
examples.cn: 委员会在做出最终决定前逐项审查了议程上的每个项目。

examples.quote: A small item in the newspaper caught her attention and changed her plans.
examples.cn: 报纸上的一则小新闻引起了她的注意，并改变了她的计划。

meanings.cn: 意外的大收获，极大的成功

confusables.diff: prize 泛指奖品或奖项，jackpot 特指累积的头奖或巨额奖金。
lottery 指抽奖或彩票活动本身，jackpot 指其中累积的头奖金额。

examples.quote: This is now a question for Gloria MacKenzie, an 84-year-old widow who recently emerged from her small, tin-roofed house in Florida to collect the biggest undivided lottery jackpot in history.
After years of failed investments, she finally hit the jackpot with a small tech startup.
examples.cn: 在多年投资失败后，她终于靠一家小型科技初创公司大获成功。

examples.quote: The lottery jackpot has grown to a record fifty million dollars.
examples.cn: 彩票头奖已累积到创纪录的五千万美元。

confusables.diff: unemployment 更正式、多指宏观失业率或失业状况，joblessness 更口语化，强调个人没有工作的状态。
jobless 是形容词（失业的），joblessness 是对应名词。

examples.quote: The great recession may be over, but this era of high joblessness is probably beginning.
Long-term joblessness can erode workers' skills and confidence, making re-entry into the labour market even harder.
examples.cn: 长期失业会削弱劳动者的技能和信心，使重新进入劳动力市场变得更加困难。

examples.quote: The government has pledged to tackle youth joblessness through expanded training programmes.
examples.cn: 政府已承诺通过扩大培训项目来解决青年失业问题。

meanings.cn: 更快乐的；更愉快的（jolly 的比较级）
更爱开玩笑的人；更快活的人

confusables.diff: jolly 是原级，表示“快乐的”；jollier 是比较级，表示“更快乐的”。
joker 指爱开玩笑的人或纸牌中的王牌；jollier 指更快乐的人，侧重情绪状态。

examples.quote: This slim volume is packed with tips to help wage slaves as well as lottery winners get the most "happiness bang for your buck." It seems most people would be better off if they could shorten their commutes to work, spend more time with friends and family and less of it watching television (something the average American spends a whopping two months a year doing, and is hardly jollier for it).
The party grew jollier as the evening wore on.
examples.cn: 随着夜晚渐深，聚会变得更加欢乐。

examples.quote: He is the jollier of the two brothers, always ready with a joke.
examples.cn: 他是两兄弟中更爱开玩笑的那个，总是随时准备讲笑话。

confusables.diff: jog 指慢跑或轻推，jolt 强调剧烈震动或惊吓
jar 指发出刺耳声的震动或使不适，jolt 侧重突然猛烈的冲击

examples.quote: Honestly, if we got stuck in the rut of "hi", "hello", "how are you?" and "what is going on?", you will fail to give the initial jolt to the conversation that can make it so memorable.
The news jolted her out of her complacency and forced her to reconsider her plans.
examples.cn: 这个消息使她不再自满，迫使她重新考虑自己的计划。

examples.quote: The bus jolted violently as it hit a pothole, waking the sleeping passengers.
examples.cn: 公交车撞上坑洞时剧烈颠簸，惊醒了睡着的乘客。

confusables.diff: journal 指期刊或日志，journalism 指新闻行业与新闻写作本身。
journalist 指从事新闻工作的人，journalism 指这一行业或学科。

examples.quote: Before applying for university I told everyone that I would study journalism, because writing was, and still is, one of my favourite activities.
She decided to pursue a career in journalism after graduating from university.
examples.cn: 大学毕业后，她决定从事新闻业。

examples.quote: The rise of citizen journalism has challenged the authority of traditional news outlets.
examples.cn: 公民新闻的兴起挑战了传统新闻媒体的权威。

meanings.cn: 新闻业的；新闻工作者的
新闻文体特有的；新闻笔法的

confusables.diff: journalist 是名词指记者，journalistic 是形容词指新闻业的。
journalism 是名词指新闻业或新闻写作，journalistic 是其形容词形式。

examples.quote: There are a number of approaches to mastering the art of deep work – be it lengthy retreats dedicated to a specific task; developing a daily ritual; or taking a "journalistic" approach to seizing moments of deep work when you can throughout the day.
The scandal raised serious questions about journalistic ethics in the digital age.
examples.cn: 这起丑闻引发了人们对数字时代新闻职业道德的严重质疑。

examples.quote: Her journalistic style is concise, objective and free from emotional language.
examples.cn: 她的新闻文风简洁、客观，不带感情色彩。

confusables.diff: justifiable 指“可辩护的、情有可原的”，justified 则强调已被证明有理、正当。
just 作形容词指“公正的、正义的”，justified 强调有充分理由或依据。

examples.quote: This practice was justified by the claim that women were needed at home, and it kept juries unrepresentative of women through the 1960s.
The government argued that the new tax was justified by the need to fund public health care.
examples.cn: 政府辩称，这项新税因需要为公共医疗提供资金而是合理的。

examples.quote: Her anger was entirely justified, given how badly she had been treated.
examples.cn: 考虑到她受到的恶劣对待，她的愤怒完全有理。

meanings.cn: 证明…正当（或有理）；为…辩护

confusables.diff: testify 意为“作证、证明”，指在法庭等场合提供证词；justify 强调证明某事合理或正当。
verify 意为“核实、查证”，侧重确认事实的真实性；justify 侧重为行为或决定提供正当理由。

phrases.cn: 为做某事辩护；证明做某事有理
目的正当即可不择手段

examples.quote: It is curious that Stephen Koziatek feels almost as though he has to justify his efforts to give his students a better future.
The government struggled to justify the huge increase in military spending to an increasingly skeptical public.
examples.cn: 政府难以向日益怀疑的公众解释军费大幅增加的理由。

examples.quote: No amount of economic growth can justify the permanent destruction of the region's natural habitats.
examples.cn: 再多的经济增长也无法为该地区自然栖息地遭受永久破坏提供正当理由。

confusables.diff: canoe 指用单叶桨划的独木舟，kayak 指用双叶桨划、人坐其中的皮艇

examples.quote: Paddle like you're in a kayak or canoe.
We rented a kayak and paddled along the quiet river at dawn.
examples.cn: 我们租了一条皮划艇，在黎明时分沿着安静的河划行。

examples.quote: The kayak capsized in the rapids, but the paddler managed to swim ashore.
examples.cn: 皮划艇在急流中翻了，但划艇者设法游到了岸边。

meanings.cn: 致命物；致死因素（如疾病、物质）

confusables.diff: murderer 强调犯谋杀罪的人，killers 范围更广，可指任何致死者或致命事物
killers 为复数名词；killer 单数形式，注意主谓一致

examples.quote: "There are fundamental public health problems, like dirty hands instead of a soap habit, that remain killers only because we can't figure out how to change people's habits," said Dr. Curtis, the director of the Hygiene Center at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine.
The police are searching for the killers who attacked the elderly couple in their home.
examples.cn: 警方正在搜捕在老人家中袭击这对老夫妇的凶手。

examples.quote: Scientists warn that antibiotic-resistant bacteria could become one of the leading killers worldwide.
examples.cn: 科学家警告，耐抗生素细菌可能成为全球主要致死因素之一。

confusables.diff: kinesiatrics 指运动疗法，侧重治疗；kinesiology 指研究人体运动的学科。

examples.quote: "Too much too soon either results in injury or burnout," says Mary Yoke, PhD, a faculty member in the kinesiology department at Indiana University in Bloomington.
She majored in kinesiology because she wanted to understand how exercise affects the human body.
examples.cn: 她主修运动学，因为她想了解运动如何影响人体。

examples.quote: Advances in kinesiology have helped athletes improve performance and avoid injury.
examples.cn: 运动学的进步帮助运动员提高成绩并避免受伤。

confusables.diff: knits 是 knit 的第三人称单数，指编织；knots 指打结或节速。

examples.quote: There are, of course, knots to be worked out.
The ship was sailing at twenty knots when the storm struck.
examples.cn: 暴风雨来袭时，这艘船正以二十节的速度航行。

examples.quote: The sailors had to learn how to tie various knots before the voyage.
examples.cn: 航行前，水手们必须学会打各种绳结。

confusables.diff: knuckles 是其复数形式，单数指单个指关节。
knuckles 指手指关节，knees 指膝关节。
knobs 指球形突起物，knuckles 专指手指关节。

phrases.cn: 因紧张而发白的手关节

examples.quote: Soon you'll feel comfortable asking if they've any knuckles of ham for soups and stews, or beef bones, chicken carcasses and fish heads for stock which, more often than not, they'll let you have for free.
The teacher gave him a rap on the knuckles for being late again.
examples.cn: 老师因他再次迟到而训斥了他。

examples.quote: She gripped the steering wheel so hard that her knuckles turned white.
examples.cn: 她紧握方向盘，指关节都发白了。

meanings.cn: 贴标签于；把……称为，归类为

confusables.diff: tag 多指临时系挂的价格牌或电子标签，label 指固定贴附、注明信息的标签。
brand 指企业或商品的品牌，label 侧重标识信息的标签或唱片公司。
categorize 强调按类别归入某类，label 常含主观贴标签、简单定性的意味。

examples.quote: Products must be clearly labelled with their ingredients and expiry dates.
examples.cn: 产品必须清楚地标明成分和保质期。

examples.quote: Critics were quick to label the policy a failure before any results emerged.
examples.cn: 结果尚未出现，批评者就急于把该政策称为失败之举。

meanings.cn: （竞争或晋升的）阶梯，等级体系

confusables.diff: stair 指楼梯的一级台阶，ladder 指可移动的梯子。
latter 意为“后者”，与 ladder 拼写相近但词义无关。

examples.quote: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?
Many young graduates believe that hard work alone will help them climb the corporate ladder.
examples.cn: 许多年轻毕业生认为，仅靠努力工作就能帮助他们在公司里步步高升。

examples.quote: He leaned the ladder against the wall and began painting the ceiling.
examples.cn: 他把梯子靠在墙上，开始粉刷天花板。

meanings.cn: 落后；滞后；（ insulating material）保温材料，隔热层

confusables.diff: 与 lag（滞后，动词/名词）相关，但 lagging 常指落后状态或保温材料，注意区分。
sluggish 为形容词“迟缓的”，lagging 多为名词或现在分词，词性不同。

examples.quote: From life expectancy to cancer and infant mortality rates, we are lagging behind many of our peers.
The region's lagging economy has prompted the government to offer tax incentives.
examples.cn: 该地区经济滞后，促使政府提供税收优惠。

examples.quote: Lagging behind in technology, the firm struggled to compete with its rivals.
examples.cn: 由于技术落后，该公司难以与对手竞争。

meanings.cn: 滞后；延迟；（时间上的）间隔
落后；滞后（lag 的第三人称单数）

confusables.diff: lag 是原形动词或名词单数，lags 是第三人称单数或复数形式。
delay 强调使某事推迟发生，lag 强调发展或进度落在后面。

examples.quote: With the blurring of roles, and the fact that the home front lags well behind the workplace in making adjustments for working women, it's not surprising that women are more stressed at home.
Wages have failed to keep pace with productivity, and the gap lags far behind official projections.
examples.cn: 工资未能跟上生产率的步伐，这一差距远远落后于官方预测。

examples.quote: In many rural areas, internet access lags behind that of urban centers by several years.
examples.cn: 在许多农村地区，互联网接入比城市中心落后好几年。

meanings.cn: 层压的；层制的；用薄片覆盖的

confusables.diff: laminar 指流体呈层流状态的，是物理术语，与 laminated（层压的）形近但义异。

examples.quote: Like other modern architects, he employed metal, glass and laminated wood – materials that we take for granted today but that in the 1940s symbolized the future.
The documents were sealed in a laminated pouch to protect them from moisture.
examples.cn: 这些文件被封在一个覆膜袋中以防受潮。

examples.quote: Laminated glass, which holds together when shattered, is widely used in car windshields.
examples.cn: 碎裂时仍能保持一体的夹层玻璃广泛用于汽车挡风玻璃。

confusables.diff: milestone 侧重发展进程中的阶段性节点，landmark 强调具有标志性、转折性意义的重大事件或建筑。
benchmark 指用于比较衡量的基准或标准，landmark 指标志性事件或实物地标。

phrases.cn: 具有里程碑意义的决定

examples.quote: In the landmark 1975 decision Taylor v.
The court's ruling is regarded as a landmark decision in environmental law.
examples.cn: 法院的这一裁决被视为环境法领域具有里程碑意义的判决。

examples.quote: The tower has become a landmark of the city and attracts thousands of tourists.
examples.cn: 这座塔已成为该城市的地标，吸引了成千上万的游客。

confusables.diff: lines 指线条或队列，lanes 指划分出的通道，两者拼写相近但含义不同。
paths 泛指小径或路线，lanes 多指道路中划定的车道或乡间窄路。

examples.quote: The city plans to add dedicated bus lanes to ease congestion during rush hour.
examples.cn: 该市计划增设公交专用道，以缓解高峰时段的拥堵。

examples.quote: Cyclists complained that parked cars often block the narrow bike lanes along the road.
examples.cn: 骑车人抱怨停放的汽车常常堵塞路边狭窄的自行车道。

confusables.diff: languorous 更强调惬意的慵懒氛围，languid 更偏虚弱无力的倦怠。
languish 是动词，指变得衰弱或受煎熬；languid 是形容词。

examples.quote: Efforts in Canada and elsewhere have been arguably languid at best, and have given us a situation where we frequently hear of employers begging for workers, even at times and in regions where unemployment is high.
The heat of the afternoon left the entire town in a languid mood.
examples.cn: 午后的炎热让整个小镇都陷入一种慵懒的氛围。

meanings.cn: 发射；（新产品的）推出，上市；（事业的）启动，开创

confusables.diff: launch 是动词或单数名词原形，launching 是其动名词/名词形式，强调进行或过程。
release 多指影片、产品、消息的发行或发布；launching 更强调首次投放市场或正式启动。

examples.quote: That is why the Reform think tank is launching a new programme of work entitled "Reimagining health", supported by ten former health ministers.
The launching of the new satellite was postponed because of bad weather.
examples.cn: 由于天气恶劣，新卫星的发射被推迟了。

examples.quote: The company spent millions on the launching of its latest smartphone.
examples.cn: 该公司为最新款智能手机的上市投入了数百万美元。

confusables.diff: litigation 指诉讼程序或打官司这一整体活动，不可数；lawsuit 指一件具体的诉讼案件，可数。
prosecution 多指刑事公诉及控方；lawsuit 通常指民事诉讼。

examples.quote: The likelihood of being named in a federal class-action lawsuit also increases, and the stock is likely to perform worse.
The company faces a lawsuit from consumers who claim its advertising was misleading.
examples.cn: 该公司面临消费者的诉讼，他们声称其广告具有误导性。

examples.quote: Rather than settle the lawsuit, the firm chose to defend itself in court.
examples.cn: 该公司没有选择和解，而是决定在法庭上为自己辩护。

confusables.diff: idleness 强调无事可做、闲置状态，laziness 强调主观上不愿付出努力。
laxity 指纪律或管理上的松懈，不指个人性格上的懒惰。

examples.quote: His failure in the exam was attributed not to a lack of ability but to sheer laziness.
examples.cn: 他考试不及格并非因为能力不足，而纯粹是因为懒惰。

examples.quote: Critics argue that intellectual laziness, rather than ignorance, is the root of much misinformation.
examples.cn: 批评者认为，许多错误信息的根源是思想上的惰性，而非无知。

confusables.diff: leader 指领导者个人，leadership 指领导能力或领导集体。
guidance 侧重指导、引导，leadership 强调带领与决策的统御力。

examples.quote: Social psychologists have amassed oceans of research into what they call the "above average effect", or "illusory superiority", and shown that, for example, 70% of us rate ourselves as above average in leadership, 93% in driving and 85% at getting on well with others – all obviously statistical impossibilities.
Effective leadership requires the ability to listen as well as to decide.
examples.cn: 有效的领导既需要决断能力，也需要倾听能力。

examples.quote: Under his leadership, the company expanded rapidly into overseas markets.
examples.cn: 在他的领导下，公司迅速拓展到海外市场。

confusables.diff: remains 多指遗迹、残骸或尸体，leftovers 通常指吃剩的食物或未用完的东西。
residue 强调化学或物理过程留下的残余物，leftovers 更日常，指剩余的食物或物品。

examples.quote: Mine is filled with leftovers, bread, stock, meat and fish.
She packed the leftovers into containers and put them in the fridge.
examples.cn: 她把剩饭装进保鲜盒，放进了冰箱。

examples.quote: The leftovers of the old system still hinder reform in some regions.
examples.cn: 旧制度的残余在一些地区仍然阻碍改革。

confusables.diff: legislation 是名词，指法律或立法行为本身；legislating 侧重立法这一动作过程。
regulate 指依规管理、调节；legislate 专指制定法律。

examples.quote: It added: "We prefer to help people and organisations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters.
Legislating on complex technological issues requires input from experts outside government.
examples.cn: 就复杂的技术问题立法，需要政府之外专家的意见。

examples.quote: Critics argue that legislating morality is neither practical nor desirable.
examples.cn: 批评者认为，用立法来规范道德既不现实也不可取。

meanings.cn: 大斋期，四旬期（基督教复活节前的四十天）

confusables.diff: lent 是 lend 的过去式和过去分词，也可作名词指大斋期；lend 是动词原形，意为借出。
lent 指借出或大斋期；rent 指租金或租用，词形相近但意义无关。

examples.quote: Many Christians give up certain foods during Lent as a form of self-discipline.
examples.cn: 许多基督徒在大斋期戒除某些食物，作为一种自律。

examples.quote: He lent me his notes, which proved invaluable for the final exam.
examples.cn: 他把笔记借给了我，这些笔记对期末考试极为宝贵。

confusables.diff: reduce 侧重人为地使数量或程度下降，及物用法更常见；lessen 更强调程度、影响或痛苦的自然减弱。
diminish 强调数量、重要性或力量逐渐变小，语体更正式；lessen 更常用于痛苦、风险、影响等抽象事物。
lesson 是名词，意为“课程、教训”，与动词 lessen 拼写形近但词性和意义完全不同。

examples.quote: Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders.
Simple changes in daily habits can significantly lessen the risk of heart disease.
examples.cn: 日常习惯的简单改变可以显著降低患心脏病的风险。

examples.quote: The new policy is intended to lessen the burden on small businesses.
examples.cn: 这项新政策旨在减轻小企业的负担。

meanings.cn: 征收；征税； levied 的名词形式
征收（税捐等）；征集（levy 的现在分词）

confusables.diff: 本身即 levy 的 -ing 形式，注意与 levy（原形/单数）区分。
发音相近但意义完全不同，leaving 意为“离开、留下”。

examples.quote: A judge has now overruled the city's decision to stop levying fines, ordering them reinstated.
The government is considering levying a new tax on high-income earners.
examples.cn: 政府正考虑对高收入者征收一项新税。

examples.quote: Local authorities began levying fines on factories that violated emission standards.
examples.cn: 地方当局开始对违反排放标准的工厂处以罚款。

meanings.cn: 责任；义务（法律上应承担的责任）

confusables.diff: reliability 指可靠性、可信度，liability 指责任、债务或不利因素，二者形近义异。
responsibility 泛指职责或道义责任，liability 多指法律上应负的赔偿责任或财务债务。
asset 指资产或有利条件，与 liability（负债、累赘）意义相对。

examples.quote: There could be liability and penalties if a physician does not act in accordance with state laws on reporting and confidentiality," she counseled.
The company denied liability for the damage caused by its faulty products.
examples.cn: 该公司否认对其缺陷产品造成的损害负有责任。

examples.quote: Excessive regulation can become a liability rather than an asset for small firms.
examples.cn: 过度监管对小企业而言可能成为累赘而非有利条件。

meanings.cn: 自由的；开明的；支持变革的

confusables.diff: liberal 是形容词，表示开明或慷慨；liberate 是动词，意为解放。
liberal 指思想开放或数量慷慨；literal 指字面上的、逐字的。

examples.quote: The college offers a liberal education that encourages students to question assumptions.
examples.cn: 这所学院提供通识教育，鼓励学生质疑既有观念。

examples.quote: He holds liberal views on social issues such as immigration and education.
examples.cn: 他在移民和教育等社会问题上持开明的观点。

confusables.diff: liberty 指具体的自由权利或自由状态，liberalism 指一套思想体系或政治主张。
liberality 指慷慨、开明或宽容的品质，liberalism 指自由主义思潮。
liberal 是形容词或指自由主义者个人，liberalism 是抽象的思想体系。

examples.quote: Classical liberalism emphasizes individual freedom and limited government intervention in the economy.
examples.cn: 古典自由主义强调个人自由以及政府对经济的有限干预。

examples.quote: The debate between liberalism and conservatism has shaped American politics for decades.
examples.cn: 自由主义与保守主义之间的争论数十年来塑造了美国政治。

meanings.cn: 轻量级选手；无足轻重的人

confusables.diff: light 泛指重量轻或光线、颜色浅，lightweight 强调相对于同类而言重量极小或分量不足。

examples.quote: Their clever designs and lightweight composites certainly make a difference.
The company has developed a lightweight material that could significantly reduce fuel consumption.
examples.cn: 该公司研发出一种轻质材料，有望大幅降低燃料消耗。

examples.quote: Critics dismissed the proposal as a lightweight reform that would change little in practice.
examples.cn: 批评者认为该提案只是一项无足轻重的改革，实际上不会带来什么改变。

confusables.diff: 语义相近，但 likelihood 是更常用、更标准的表达，likeliness 较少使用且多指‘相似性’。
probability 更强调可计算的概率，likelihood 更侧重主观或一般意义上的可能性。

examples.quote: The likelihood of being named in a federal class-action lawsuit also increases, and the stock is likely to perform worse.
The likelihood of a recession has increased as consumer spending slows.
examples.cn: 随着消费支出放缓，经济衰退的可能性已经上升。

examples.quote: Regular exercise reduces the likelihood of developing heart disease later in life.
examples.cn: 经常锻炼可以降低晚年患心脏病的可能性。

confusables.diff: limits 指具体的界限或上限，limitations 更强调自身条件造成的局限或不足。
restrictions 多指外部施加的约束规定，limitations 侧重事物本身固有的局限。

examples.quote: Changes in the light, the limitations of your painting materials, and the lack of experience and technique mean that what you start out trying to achieve may not come to life the way that you expected.
Despite its limitations, the study offers valuable insights into how consumers make decisions.
examples.cn: 尽管存在局限，这项研究仍为消费者如何做决策提供了有价值的见解。

examples.quote: The new policy imposes strict limitations on the amount of data companies can collect.
examples.cn: 新政策对公司可收集的数据量施加了严格限制。

confusables.diff: 带连字符的拼写多见于英式英语，lineup 为美式常见拼法，词义相同。
layup 指篮球中的上篮或船舶停靠，与 lineups（阵容）形近但义异。

examples.quote: Rather than have people simply rate their beauty compared with others, he asked them to identify an original photograph of themselves from a lineup including versions that had been altered to appear more and less attractive.
The coach changed the starting lineup after two consecutive defeats.
examples.cn: 连续两场失利后，教练更换了首发阵容。

examples.quote: Organizers unveiled a strong lineup for this year's music festival.
examples.cn: 主办方公布了今年音乐节强大的演出阵容。

meanings.cn: 舌；语言（尤用于复合词中）

confusables.diff: language 是日常通用词“语言”，lingua 多作构词成分或学术用语，指舌或语言。
lingual 是形容词“舌的；语言的”，lingua 是名词。

examples.quote: English has become the lingua franca of international business and science.
examples.cn: 英语已成为国际商业与科学的通用语。

examples.quote: The term derives from the Latin word lingua, meaning tongue or language.
examples.cn: 该术语源自拉丁语单词 lingua，意为舌头或语言。

confusables.diff: linguistic 是形容词（语言的、语言学的），linguist 是名词，指人。
bilingual 指会说两种语言的人或双语的，linguist 尤指研究语言的学者。

examples.quote: As a linguist once said, "You can get people to think it's nonsense at the same time that you buy into it." In a workplace that's fundamentally indifferent to your life and its meaning, office speak can help you figure out how you relate to your work – and how your work defines who you are.
As a linguist, she studies how children acquire language in bilingual households.
examples.cn: 作为一名语言学家，她研究儿童在双语家庭中如何习得语言。

examples.quote: He is a talented linguist who speaks five languages fluently.
examples.cn: 他是一位有天赋的语言通，能流利地说五种语言。

confusables.diff: lining 是单数形式，linings 只用于复数语境，如多种衬里或多层内壁。
leanings 指倾向、偏好，与 linings 拼写相近但含义完全不同。

phrases.cn: 一线希望；不幸中的万幸（源自 every cloud has a silver lining）

examples.quote: No one tries harder than the jobless to find silver linings in this national economic disaster.
Even in hardship, she tried to find the silver linings in every situation.
examples.cn: 即使在艰难中，她也努力在每种境况里寻找一线希望。

examples.quote: Researchers found that certain chemicals can irritate the linings of the lungs.
examples.cn: 研究人员发现某些化学物质会刺激肺部内壁。

meanings.cn: 连篇累牍的诉说（或列举）；冗长的一串

confusables.diff: list 指普通清单，中性；litany 强调冗长重复、带有抱怨意味的一串事物。
liturgy 指宗教礼拜仪式整体；litany 是其中一种应答式祈祷文。

examples.quote: High school students eager to stand out in the college application process often participate in a litany of extracurricular activities hoping to bolster their chances of admission to a selective undergraduate institution.
The report offers a litany of complaints about the city's transport system.
examples.cn: 该报告对该市交通系统提出了一连串的抱怨。

examples.quote: She recited a litany of excuses for missing the deadline.
examples.cn: 她为错过截止日期列举了一长串借口。

confusables.diff: literature 指文学作品或文献，literacy 指读写能力。
literate 是形容词，意为识字的、有文化的；literacy 是对应名词。

examples.quote: Many Americans regard the jury system as a concrete expression of crucial democratic values, including the principles that all citizens who meet minimal qualifications of age and literacy are equally competent to serve on juries; that jurors should be selected randomly from a representative cross section of the community; that no citizen should be denied the right to serve on a jury on account of race, religion, sex, or national origin; that defendants are entitled to trial by their peers; and that verdicts should represent the conscience of the community and not just the letter of the law.
Programs aimed at improving adult literacy have produced measurable results in rural areas.
examples.cn: 旨在提高成人读写能力的项目在农村地区已取得可测量的成果。

examples.quote: Digital literacy is now regarded as essential for success in the modern workplace.
examples.cn: 数字素养如今被视为在现代职场取得成功的关键。

meanings.cn: 确实地；真正地（用于强调）

confusables.diff: literarily 意为“文学上地”，与文学相关；literally 意为“字面上地/确实地”。
figuratively 意为“比喻地”，与 literally 的字面义相对。

examples.quote: Because writing a new script—literally or figuratively—means that other team members will have to adapt to something new.
The term is often used loosely, but literally it refers to a specific legal procedure.
examples.cn: 该术语常被宽泛使用，但严格说来它指的是特定的法律程序。

examples.quote: She was literally shaking with anger after hearing the news.
examples.cn: 听到这个消息后，她确实气得发抖。

confusables.diff: poultry 专指家禽（鸡、鸭等），livestock 统称牛、羊、猪等家畜。
cattle 仅指牛类，livestock 是牲畜总称，范围更广。

examples.quote: Rising demand for meat has encouraged farmers to expand livestock production in many developing countries.
examples.cn: 肉类需求的增长促使许多发展中国家的农民扩大畜牧生产。

examples.quote: Intensive livestock farming can cause serious environmental damage if waste is not properly managed.
examples.cn: 如果粪便处理不当，集约化畜牧业可能造成严重的环境破坏。

confusables.diff: broadcast 泛指电视、电台等广播播出，livestream 特指通过互联网实时直播。
webcast 多指正式的、单向的网络直播；livestream 强调实时互动，更口语化。

examples.quote: You can also join a livestream or on-demand exercise class.
Millions of viewers tuned in to the livestream as the spacecraft landed.
examples.cn: 航天器着陆时，数百万观众收看了这场直播。

examples.quote: The company plans to livestream its annual product launch to reach a younger audience.
examples.cn: 该公司计划对年度产品发布会进行直播，以吸引更年轻的受众。

confusables.diff: lend 是动词“借出”，loan 可作名词指“贷款”，美式英语中也作动词。
borrow 指“借入”，方向与 loan（借出/贷款）相反。
debt 指所欠债务，loan 指借来的具体款项。

examples.quote: College loan balances in the U.S. now stand at a record $1.5 trillion, according to the Federal Reserve.
Students who take out large loans often struggle to repay them after graduation.
examples.cn: 申请大额贷款的学生毕业后往往难以偿还。

examples.quote: The museum has loaned several paintings to the exhibition.
examples.cn: 博物馆已将几幅画作出借给该展览。

meanings.cn: （资源、信息等）本地化的，地方性的

confusables.diff: local 泛指“当地的、地方的”，localized 强调“局限于某一局部的、范围有限的”。
located 意为“位于……的”，强调位置；localized 强调范围局限于某处。

examples.quote: Mumbai's April heatstroke deaths highlighted the need for more nuanced and localized warnings, researchers say.
The damage was localized to the southern part of the region, leaving the rest largely unaffected.
examples.cn: 损失局限于该地区的南部，其余大部分地区基本未受影响。

examples.quote: Researchers found that the disease was localized rather than widespread across the country.
examples.cn: 研究人员发现该疾病是局部性的，而非在全国范围内广泛传播。

confusables.diff: situated 更强调所处位置或处境，located 更侧重具体地点。

phrases.cn: 位于中心的；地段优越的

examples.quote: Companies located in places with happier people invest more, according to a recent research paper.
The new research center is located in a suburb that has easy access to the highway.
examples.cn: 新的研究中心位于一个交通便利、可快速上高速公路的郊区。

examples.quote: Most of the company's factories are located near coastal cities to reduce transport costs.
examples.cn: 该公司的大多数工厂位于沿海城市附近，以降低运输成本。

meanings.cn: （由旧工厂或仓库改造的）宽敞的公寓
把（球）高高击出；将…向上抛

confusables.diff: attic 特指屋顶下的阁楼空间，loft 可指任何顶层或改造的宽敞空间。
lofty 是形容词，意为“高耸的；崇高的”，loft 是名词或动词。

examples.quote: New building regulations aimed at improving energy efficiency are set to increase the price of new homes, as well as those of extensions and loft conversions on existing ones.
They converted the old warehouse into a spacious loft with high ceilings and exposed brick walls.
examples.cn: 他们把旧仓库改造成了一个宽敞的阁楼，有高高的天花板和裸露的砖墙。

examples.quote: The artist lives in a loft downtown, using the open space as both studio and home.
examples.cn: 这位艺术家住在市中心的一个阁楼里，把开阔的空间同时用作工作室和家。

confusables.diff: logic 是名词，logical 是形容词，意为“合乎逻辑的”。
logic 指逻辑体系或道理，reasoning 侧重推理的过程。

examples.quote: Looking beyond the culture war logic of right or wrong means opening up the middle ground and understanding that managing immigration today requires multiple paths and multiple outcomes, including some that are not easy to accomplish legally in the existing system.
There is a certain logic in his argument, even if the conclusion seems odd.
examples.cn: 他的论证有一定的逻辑，即便结论显得奇怪。

examples.quote: The logic behind the policy is that lower taxes will stimulate spending.
examples.cn: 该政策背后的逻辑是降低税收将刺激消费。

confusables.diff: logical 指逻辑上的合理，logistic 指物流或后勤的。
logical 强调推理严密、符合逻辑规则，rational 强调理智、不感情用事。

examples.quote: On one hand, that viewpoint is a logical product of America's evolution.
It is logical to assume that consumers will choose cheaper alternatives when prices rise.
examples.cn: 认为价格上涨时消费者会选择更便宜的替代品，这是合乎逻辑的。

examples.quote: Her argument was so logical that few could find fault with it.
examples.cn: 她的论证如此合乎逻辑，几乎没人能挑出毛病。

meanings.cn: 标识；徽标；（企业或组织的）标志

confusables.diff: label 指贴在商品上的标签或说明文字，logo 是代表品牌形象的图形标志。
emblem 多指象征国家、团体或机构的纹章式图案，logo 更侧重商业品牌的识别符号。

examples.quote: The company spent millions redesigning its logo to appeal to younger consumers.
examples.cn: 该公司斥资数百万重新设计标识，以吸引年轻消费者。

examples.quote: A recognizable logo can help a firm stand out in a crowded market.
examples.cn: 一个易于识别的标识能帮助公司在激烈的市场中脱颖而出。

meanings.cn: 降低；放下（lower 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: lower 是原形动词/形容词，lowered 是其过去式或过去分词，也可作形容词表示“降低的”。
lowering 是现在分词，多指“使降低的”或“阴沉的天色”，lowered 侧重已完成或状态。

examples.quote: But if the district is essentially giving a pass to students who do not do their homework because of complicated family lives, it is going riskily close to the implication that standards need to be lowered for poor children.
The company lowered its prices to attract more customers during the economic downturn.
examples.cn: 经济低迷期间，该公司降低价格以吸引更多顾客。

examples.quote: She spoke in a lowered voice so that no one else could hear the secret.
examples.cn: 她压低声音说话，以免别人听到这个秘密。

meanings.cn: 降低；减少（lower 的第三人称单数）

confusables.diff: 与 lowers（lower 的复数名词义“较低者”）同形，需依上下文区分。
形近但义为“允许”，与“降低”无关。

examples.quote: This temporarily lowers carbon-carrying capacity.
The new policy lowers the cost of higher education for low-income families.
examples.cn: 新政策降低了低收入家庭接受高等教育的成本。

examples.quote: Regular exercise lowers the risk of heart disease significantly.
examples.cn: 经常锻炼能显著降低患心脏病的风险。

confusables.diff: profitable 泛指有盈利、有益处；lucrative 特指收入或报酬丰厚，多修饰职业、生意、合同。
lucky 意为运气好，与 lucrative 拼写相近但语义无关。

examples.quote: There's always a constant fear of falling behind everyone else on the socially perpetuated "race to the finish line," whether that be toward graduate school, medical school or a lucrative career.
Consulting has proved a lucrative career for many former executives.
examples.cn: 对许多前高管来说，咨询已被证明是一份收入丰厚的职业。

examples.quote: The company turned down the offer because the terms were not lucrative enough.
examples.cn: 公司拒绝了这一提议，因为条件不够有利可图。

confusables.diff: timber 指建筑用木材（英式）或树木（美式），lumber 指伐倒锯好的木料（美式）。
lumbar 意为“腰部的”，与 lumber 拼写相近但词义无关。

examples.quote: The strategy also aims to ensure that carbon in woody material removed from the forests is locked away in the form of solid lumber or burned as biofuel in vehicles that would otherwise run on fossil fuels.
The truck lumbered along the narrow mountain road, its cargo of lumber shifting with each turn.
examples.cn: 卡车沿着狭窄的山路笨重地行驶，车上装载的木材在每次转弯时都来回滑动。

examples.quote: After the storm, volunteers helped clear the lumber that blocked the entrance to the village.
examples.cn: 风暴过后，志愿者们帮助清理了堵住村口的木材。

meanings.cn: 茂盛的，繁茂的（植物或毛发）
华丽的，丰富的（文体、装饰等）

confusables.diff: luxurious 指奢华舒适的，luxuriant 指生长茂盛或风格华丽。
lush 强调草木青翠多汁，luxuriant 更强调生长繁密旺盛。

examples.quote: But fear is a choice." I do completely agree that fears are just the product of our luxuriant imagination.
The valley was covered with luxuriant vegetation, which made it a perfect habitat for rare birds.
examples.cn: 山谷被茂密的植被覆盖，这使它成为珍稀鸟类的理想栖息地。

examples.quote: Her luxuriant prose, full of elaborate metaphors, sometimes obscures the simple argument beneath.
examples.cn: 她华丽的文风充满精巧的隐喻，有时反而掩盖了底下简单的论点。

confusables.diff: 形容词，意为“奢华的、豪华的”，而 luxuries 是名词复数，指奢侈品本身。
意为“必需品”，与 luxuries（奢侈品）语义相对。

examples.quote: Buying gifts or giving to charity is often more pleasurable than purchasing things for oneself, and luxuries are most enjoyable when they are consumed sparingly.
Many consumers are cutting back on luxuries as living costs continue to rise.
examples.cn: 随着生活成本持续上升，许多消费者正在削减奢侈品开支。

examples.quote: What was once regarded as a luxury has now become a daily necessity for most families.
examples.cn: 曾经被视为奢侈品的东西，如今已成为大多数家庭的日常必需品。

meanings.cn: 奢侈品；奢华；难得的享受

confusables.diff: luxuriant 意为茂盛、繁密的，多形容植物或毛发；luxury 指奢华或奢侈品。
extravagance 强调挥霍浪费，含贬义；luxury 侧重高品质的享受，不一定含贬义。

examples.quote: But as adults we also have the luxury of being able to control our own diaries and it's important that we schedule in time to enjoy the things we love.
Few graduates can afford the luxury of choosing a job purely out of personal interest.
examples.cn: 很少有毕业生能有纯粹出于个人兴趣选择工作的奢侈条件。

examples.quote: The rapid growth of the luxury market reflects rising incomes among the urban middle class.
examples.cn: 奢侈品市场的快速增长反映了城市中产阶级收入的提高。

meanings.cn: 魔法般地；神奇地，不可思议地

confusables.diff: magic 是名词或形容词，magically 是对应的副词，修饰动词或形容词。

examples.quote: The guilt-prone ones shared more, even though they hadn't magically become more sympathetic to the other child's deprivation.
The heavy debt magically disappeared after the company was restructured.
examples.cn: 公司重组后，那笔沉重的债务神奇地消失了。

examples.quote: She magically transformed a plain room into an elegant study.
examples.cn: 她神奇地把一间普通的房间变成了雅致的书房。

meanings.cn: 有吸引力的人或物；吸引源

confusables.diff: magnet 是名词指磁铁，magnetic 是形容词指有磁性的或迷人的。

examples.quote: High school students who have had a strong positive influence on their community through an extracurricular activity may impress a college and win a scholarship, says Erica Gwyn, a former math and science magnet program assistant at a public high school who is now executive director of the Kaleidoscope Careers Academy in Atlanta, a nonprofit organization.
The park has become a magnet for tourists seeking quiet natural scenery.
examples.cn: 这座公园已成为寻求宁静自然风光的游客的向往之地。

examples.quote: Cheap labor acted as a magnet drawing foreign manufacturers to the region.
examples.cn: 廉价劳动力像磁铁一样吸引外国制造商来到该地区。

confusables.diff: enlarge 强调尺寸或规模的增大，magnify 强调使看起来更大，常指光学放大。
amplify 多指声音、信号等的增强，magnify 强调视觉或程度上的放大。
exaggerate 指夸大事实，magnify 侧重使事物显得比实际更大或更重要。

examples.quote: And one of the easiest ways to segment a market is to magnify gender differences – or invent them where they did not previously exist.
The media often magnifies minor issues into major crises.
examples.cn: 媒体常把次要问题夸大成重大危机。

examples.quote: A microscope can magnify objects up to a thousand times.
examples.cn: 显微镜能将物体放大上千倍。

confusables.diff: maintain 是动词，表示“维持/保养”；maintenance 是对应名词。
conservation 强调对资源、环境的保护，不用于设备日常保养。

examples.quote: Collectively, they have a maintenance backlog of more than $12 billion.
Regular maintenance of the equipment can significantly reduce the risk of sudden breakdowns.
examples.cn: 设备的定期保养能显著降低突发故障的风险。

examples.quote: The company cut its maintenance budget, which later proved to be a costly mistake.
examples.cn: 公司削减了维护预算，后来证明这是一个代价高昂的错误。

meanings.cn: （任务、问题等）可应付的，不棘手的

confusables.diff: manage 是动词，指管理或设法完成；manageable 是形容词，描述可被管理的性质。
manageability 是名词，指可管理性；manageable 是形容词。

phrases.cn: 使某事保持在可控范围内

examples.quote: As we grow up, we learn to control our emotions so they are manageable and don't dictate our behaviours, which is in many ways a good thing.
By breaking the project into smaller tasks, the team made the workload manageable.
examples.cn: 通过把项目分解成更小的任务，团队使工作量变得可控。

examples.quote: The report is long but its clear structure makes it manageable for readers.
examples.cn: 这份报告很长，但清晰的结构使读者容易应对。

confusables.diff: handle 指一般性地拿取或处理，manipulate 强调需技巧的精细操作或带有操控意图。
maneuver 侧重巧妙移动或策略性周旋，manipulate 侧重对人、信息或局势的暗中控制。
manipulative 是形容词，指善于操纵他人的；manipulate 是动词，指操纵行为本身。

examples.quote: First coined in 2010 by user experience expert Harry Brignull, "dark patterns" is a catch-all term for practices that manipulate user interfaces to influence the decision-making ability of users.
Some companies manipulate consumers into buying products they do not really need.
examples.cn: 一些公司操纵消费者购买他们并不真正需要的产品。

examples.quote: Researchers must be careful not to manipulate the data to support their own conclusions.
examples.cn: 研究人员必须小心，不要篡改数据来支持自己的结论。

meanings.cn: 制造（manufacture 的过去式和过去分词）

confusables.diff: man-made 强调非自然形成，manufactured 更强调经工业生产加工。
fabricated 常含捏造、虚构之意，manufactured 侧重实际生产制造。

examples.quote: If you look hard enough, you'll find that many of the products we use every day – chewing gums, skin moisturizers, disinfecting wipes, air fresheners, water purifiers, health snacks, teeth whiteners, fabric softeners, vitamins – are results of manufactured habits.
The report shows that manufactured exports rose sharply last year.
examples.cn: 报告显示，去年制成品出口大幅增长。

examples.quote: Consumers increasingly distrust manufactured claims about product safety.
examples.cn: 消费者越来越不信任关于产品安全的编造说法。

meanings.cn: （社会群体中的）边缘地位；差距

confusables.diff: margins 是复数形式；margin 单数常指利润空间或页边，复数多指利润总额或边缘地带。
margin 强调留出的余量或利润空间，edge 更强调具体的边线或刀刃。

examples.quote: Not the 20% profit margins that were routine a few years ago, but profit all the same.
Small retailers often operate on thin profit margins, leaving them little room to absorb rising costs.
examples.cn: 小型零售商往往利润空间微薄，几乎没有余地消化不断上升的成本。

examples.quote: The report argues that young people on the margins of the labor market need targeted support.
examples.cn: 该报告认为，处于劳动力市场边缘的年轻人需要有针对性的支持。

confusables.diff: 本身为副词，无同形易混词。
remarkably 强调“非同寻常地、惊人地”，markedly 强调“可察觉地、显著地”，程度较轻。
noticeably 侧重“容易注意到”，markedly 更强调程度上的显著差异。

examples.quote: But such feelings of connection markedly dip when entering a long gap.
The two groups differed markedly in their response to the treatment.
examples.cn: 两组对治疗的反应明显不同。

examples.quote: Living standards have improved markedly over the past decade.
examples.cn: 过去十年间生活水平显著提高。

confusables.diff: marks 指分数或痕迹本身，markers 指用于标记的物品或阅卷人。
signs 侧重可观察的迹象或信号，markers 强调用于标示位置或特征的物体。

examples.quote: In fact, those who thought that the images higher up the attractiveness scale were real directly corresponded with those who showed other markers for having higher self-esteem.
Researchers identified specific genetic markers associated with the disease.
examples.cn: 研究人员确定了与该疾病相关的特定遗传标记。

examples.quote: The exam markers were instructed to apply the same criteria consistently.
examples.cn: 阅卷人被要求一致地采用相同的评分标准。

meanings.cn: 标记；记号；斑纹（marking 的复数形式）

confusables.diff: marks 指标记或分数、痕迹，泛指结果；markings 多指表面形成的条纹、斑纹或成套标线。
signs 指符号、迹象或招牌，表意更广；markings 强调物体表面上可见的印记或图案。

examples.quote: The robot rats were quite minimalist, resembling a chunkier version of a computer mouse with wheels to move around and colourful markings.
The bird's distinctive black and white markings make it easy to identify in the wild.
examples.cn: 这种鸟独特的黑白斑纹使它在野外很容易被辨认。

examples.quote: Faded road markings can confuse drivers, especially at night or in heavy rain.
examples.cn: 褪色的道路标线会使司机困惑，尤其是在夜间或大雨中。

confusables.diff: male 侧重生理性别，masculine 侧重社会文化所定义的男性特质。
manly 常含褒义，强调勇敢、坚毅等正面品质；masculine 更中性，仅指男性特征。
feminine 指女性特质或语法阴性，与 masculine 在性别和语法意义上相对。

examples.quote: When nursery colours were introduced, pink was actually considered the more masculine colour, a pastel version of red, which was associated with strength.
The study suggests that traditional masculine norms may discourage men from seeking help.
examples.cn: 该研究表明，传统的男性规范可能会阻碍男性寻求帮助。

examples.quote: In some languages, nouns are classified as masculine, feminine, or neuter.
examples.cn: 在某些语言中，名词被分为阳性、阴性或中性。

confusables.diff: classmate 特指同班同学，mate 泛指伙伴或配偶。
match 指比赛或相配之物，mate 指人或动物的伴侣/同伴。

examples.quote: It's common to have a "cubicle mate" or special confidant in a work setting.
Research suggests that people tend to choose a mate who shares similar values and backgrounds.
examples.cn: 研究表明，人们倾向于选择价值观和背景相似的伴侣。

examples.quote: The two birds mate in spring and build their nests near the river.
examples.cn: 这两只鸟在春天交配，并在河边筑巢。

meanings.cn: 物质主义的；崇尚物质的
实利主义的；追求物质享受的

confusables.diff: material 意为“物质的、材料的”，中性描述；materialistic 含贬义，指过度看重金钱财物。
realistic 意为“现实的、切合实际的”，与物质主义无关，仅词形相近。

examples.quote: Many said that unemployment, while extremely painful, had improved them in some ways: they had become less materialistic and more financially prudent; they were more aware of the struggles of others.
Critics argue that a materialistic culture encourages people to measure success by wealth rather than by personal growth.
examples.cn: 批评者认为，物质主义文化促使人们以财富而非个人成长来衡量成功。

examples.quote: Although he grew up in a materialistic environment, he chose a simple life devoted to research.
examples.cn: 尽管他在崇尚物质的环境中长大，他仍选择了投身研究的简朴生活。

meanings.cn: 最大的，最高的；最大限度的

confusables.diff: maximum 多作名词或定语指最大值，maximal 强调达到最大程度，常修饰抽象概念。

examples.quote: "Tech is designed to really suck you in," says Jenny Radesky in her study of digital play, "and digital products are there to promote maximal engagement.
The company aims to achieve maximal efficiency with minimal cost.
examples.cn: 该公司力求以最低成本实现最高效率。

examples.quote: Researchers observed the maximal effect of the drug at a low dose.
examples.cn: 研究人员观察到该药物在低剂量下的最大效应。

confusables.diff: maximise 是英式拼写，maximize 是美式拼写，词义完全相同。
optimize 强调找到最佳平衡点，maximise 强调把数量或程度推到最大。
minimise 是 maximise 的反义词，表示使最小化。

examples.quote: This must begin with the question of how we maximise the health of the nation, rather than "fix" the NHS.
Companies are under pressure to maximise profits while reducing their environmental impact.
examples.cn: 企业面临压力，要在提高利润的同时减少对环境的影响。

examples.quote: To maximise the benefits of the training, employees should apply new skills immediately.
examples.cn: 为使培训收益最大化，员工应立刻运用新技能。

meanings.cn: 最大化；使达到最大（动词 maximize 的动名词/现在分词形式）

confusables.diff: 与 maximum（n. 最大值）形近，但 maximizing 是动词形式，表示“使最大化”的动作或过程。
optimizing 强调“优化、寻求最佳”，maximizing 强调“使达到最大量”，后者只关注数量增长。

examples.quote: Among the most popular ways they are doing this, the company said, is by reducing their overall expenses, securing life insurance or maximizing their contributions to retirement accounts.
Firms focused on maximizing short-term profits often neglect long-term innovation.
examples.cn: 专注于短期利润最大化的企业往往忽视长期创新。

examples.quote: The policy aims at maximizing the benefits of digital technology while minimizing its risks.
examples.cn: 该政策旨在使数字技术的效益最大化，同时将其风险降到最低。

confusables.diff: mayor 是名词“市长”，mayoral 是其形容词形式，表示“市长的”。

examples.quote: The new ultra-low emission zone (Ulez) is likely to be a big issue in next year's mayoral election.
The mayoral election drew record turnout as residents debated housing and transit.
examples.cn: 市长选举吸引了创纪录的投票人数，居民们就住房和交通问题展开了辩论。

examples.quote: She launched her mayoral campaign after a decade of service on the city council.
examples.cn: 在市议会任职十年后，她启动了市长竞选活动。

confusables.diff: majors 指专业/主修或少校，mayors 指市长，拼写仅一字母之差。

examples.quote: But mayors and councilors can only do so much about a problem that is far bigger than any one city or town.
Several mayors from coastal cities gathered to discuss how to cope with rising sea levels.
examples.cn: 来自沿海城市的几位市长齐聚一堂，讨论如何应对海平面上升。

examples.quote: Local mayors are under pressure to improve public transport before the next election.
examples.cn: 地方市长们面临压力，须在下次选举前改善公共交通。

meanings.cn: 进餐时间，用餐时间（mealtime 的复数形式）

confusables.diff: meal times 是分开书写的同义说法，意思基本相同，但 mealtimes 作为一个词更常用于泛指日常用餐时段。
dinnertime 特指晚餐或正餐时间，而 mealtimes 泛指一日三餐的各个用餐时间。

examples.quote: Radesky has studied the use of mobile phones and tablets at mealtimes by giving mother-child pairs a food-testing exercise.
Doctors advise keeping regular mealtimes and avoiding snacks late at night to improve digestion.
examples.cn: 医生建议保持规律的用餐时间并避免深夜吃零食，以改善消化。

examples.quote: For many families, mealtimes are the only occasion when members can talk to one another at leisure.
